About the Role
AI has made coding dramatically faster. Enterprise software delivery hasn’t kept up.
Intelli-Q, Nomiso’s AI-powered product positioned as Enterprise Quality Intelligence, is built to bridge this gap — helping engineering organisations gain visibility into software quality, test coverage, SDLC health and delivery readiness.
We are looking for a Product Manager who has experienced these challenges firsthand and wants to build the solution.

Key Responsibilities
Define and drive the product vision, strategy and roadmap for Intelli-Q.
Identify and prioritise high-value problems across Software Engineering, QA, DevOps and SDLC.
Conduct customer discovery, market research and competitive analysis to identify unmet needs and opportunities.
Engage directly with Engineering, QA, DevOps and technology leaders to understand and validate customer problems.
Translate customer and market insights into product requirements, user stories and specifications.
Own product backlog prioritisation based on customer value, business impact and technical feasibility.
Partner closely with Engineering, AI/ML and Design teams through the complete product lifecycle — discovery to launch and adoption.
Participate in technical discussions and understand architecture, APIs, integrations and engineering trade-offs.
Define and track product metrics, adoption, engagement and customer outcomes.
Develop and execute go-to-market strategies in partnership with Sales and Marketing.
Support product positioning, demos, customer enablement and adoption.
Continuously iterate the product based on customer feedback, data and market evolution.

What We're Looking For
8–10 years of experience across Product and Engineering.
Strong foundation in Software Engineering, QA, DevOps, SRE or Platform Engineering.
Experience building or managing B2B, Enterprise or SaaS products.
Strong understanding of software development, testing, deployment and the broader SDLC.
Experience with product strategy, roadmap planning, prioritisation and backlog management.
Strong customer discovery and problem-validation skills.
Experience working with cross-functional Engineering, Design, Sales and Marketing teams.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management and influencing skills.
Exposure to AI/ML, DevOps, developer tools, engineering productivity or software quality is a strong advantage.

The Person We're Looking For
You are:
A builder, not just a manager.
Outcome-driven — you own results, not tasks.
Restless — you constantly look for a better way.
Technically curious — you can go deep with engineers.
Customer-obsessed — you solve problems before building features.
Fast-moving — you are comfortable with ambiguity and making decisions.
Ambitious — you want to build something that matters.

You'll help build it.
You will work directly with the CEO, have significant ownership of product direction, and operate at the intersection of: AI × Software Engineering × Quality × DevOps × Enterprise Technology

If you want to help build an AI-first product that changes how enterprises understand and improve software quality, we'd like to hear from you.

Modlix is an AI-powered marketing operating system for SMBs, offering an all-in-one platform that integrates website creation, digital marketing, CRM, post-sales management, and analytics. We empower businesses to scale their digital presence under one unified system.

About the Role
We are looking for a Product Manager with strong experience in MarTech, AdTech, or B2B SaaS to join our early-stage team and help build products from 0→1.
You will work closely with Engineering, Design, Marketing, Sales, and Leadership to identify customer problems, define product strategy, and take products from idea to execution and scale.

What You’ll Do
Own the product roadmap from discovery to execution.
Understand customer needs, market trends, and competitive landscape to identify product opportunities.
Define product requirements, user stories, PRDs, and product priorities.
Work closely with Engineering and Design to build and launch features.
Drive 0→1 product development, from problem discovery to MVP and iteration.
Use customer feedback and product data to continuously improve the product.
Collaborate with Sales & Marketing on GTM, positioning, and product adoption.
Track product performance, user behaviour, and key product metrics.

What We’re Looking For
4–8 years of Product Management experience in MarTech, AdTech, B2B SaaS, or related technology products.
Startup/high-growth experience with a strong 0→1 / builder mindset.
Experience owning products/features end-to-end, not just project management.
Strong understanding of SMB/B2B customer needs and SaaS business models.
Ability to work closely with Engineering, Design, Sales, and Business teams.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, ambiguous startup environment.
Experience with AI-powered products, automation, CRM, marketing technology, or analytics is a strong plus.

Ideal Candidate: A hands-on Product Manager from a MarTech/AdTech/B2B SaaS startup who has built products/features from 0→1 and enjoys solving customer problems in a fast-moving environment.

About Fam (previously FamPay)










Fam is India’s first payments app for everyone above 11. FamApp helps make online and offline payments through UPI and FamCard. We are on a mission to raise a new, financially aware generation, and drive 250 million+ young users in India to kickstart their financial journey super early in their life.

We’re reimagining how the next generation experiences fintech—going beyond payments to build a lifestyle brand that blends money, identity, and everyday experiences into one seamless, intuitive journey.

Founded in 2019 by IIT Roorkee alumni, Fam is backed by some of the most respected investors around the world like Elevation Capital, Y-Combinator, Peak XV (Sequoia Capital) India, Venture Highway, Global Founder’s Capital and the likes of Kunal Shah, Amrish Rao as angel investors.










About this role


We're looking for a Product Manager to own Fam's product experience end-to-end — from discovering the problem to shipping the fix to iterating on what's live. This is a hands-on, data-driven role that sits at the intersection of users, engineering, and design, demanding someone who can move fast, prototype with AI tools, and turn sharp user insights into a roadmap that actually ships. If you're the kind of person who rolls up their sleeves, influences with evidence, and wants their work to show up in a product people love — we would like to talk.

On the Job :-

• Drive product execution: Partner with the product team to translate vision into execution using data and past learnings. 
• Own product areas end-to-end: From problem discovery → roadmap → execution → iteration
• User-first thinking: Deeply understand users, identify pain points, and build delightful solutions
• Collaborate cross-functionally:
• Work with Engineering to understand constraints and build scalable systems
• Work with Design on UX, flows, and brand consistency
• Build and manage roadmaps: Prioritize based on business goals, user needs, and data insights
• Be data-driven: Analyze funnels, user behavior, and metrics to guide decisions
• Get hands dirty: Contribute across analysis, design discussions, and execution
• Influence stakeholders: Drive alignment using data and user insights
• Full-stack builder mindset: Comfortable with AI tools and shipping small features to production
• Prototype fast: Use AI tools to build, iterate, and collaborate via show-and-tell


Must-haves (Min. qualifications) :- 

• 2–4 years of experience in Product Management, preferably in FinTech or B2C consumer products
• Strong understanding of consumer behavior with the ability to build user-loved products
• Experience owning features or product areas end-to-end with measurable impact
• Strong analytical mindset: Comfortable using data to drive decisions and validate hypotheses
• Good understanding of product, design, and engineering collaboration
• Ability to define and track key product metrics (activation, retention, engagement, etc.)
• Strong documentation skills: Clear, structured PRDs with attention to detail
• Proven ability to prioritize and execute in fast-paced environments


Good to have :- 

• Experience in FinTech, Payments, or Banking products
• Familiarity with growth, activation, and retention-focused problem statements
• Exposure to experimentation frameworks (A/B testing, cohort analysis, funnel optimization)
• Hands-on experience with analytics tools like Mixpanel, Amplitude, Google Analytics, or similar
• Basic understanding of SQL or data querying for self-serve analysis
• Experience working in 0→1 or fast-scaling startup environments
• Strong understanding of consumer product patterns across leading apps (onboarding, engagement loops, etc.)
• Familiarity with AI tools for prototyping, analysis, or productivity
• Exposure to design systems and UX principles
• Experience collaborating with growth/marketing teams on campaigns and lifecycle journeys (push, email, CRM)


Why join us?

• Be part of a high-energy, creatively driven team shaping the future of a growing brand
• High-impact role: Your work will directly influence the experience for the next 50M+ users
• Creative freedom: Plenty of room to experiment and bring bold ideas to life
• Collaborative culture: Work with a team that values creativity, ownership, and good vibes










Perks That Go Beyond the Paycheck

• Relocation assistance to make your move seamless.

• Free office meals (lunch & dinner).

• Generous leave policy, including birthday leave, period leave, paternity and maternity support, and more.

• Salary advance and loan policies for any financial help.

• Quarterly rewards and recognition programs, and a referral program with great incentives.

• Access the latest gadgets and tools.

• Comprehensive health insurance for you and your family, mental health support.

• Tax benefits with options like food coupons, phone allowances, car/device leasing.

• Retirement perks like PF contribution, leave encashment and gratuity.


Here’s all the tea on FamApp ☕️

FamApp focuses on financial inclusion of the next generation by providing UPI & card payments to everyone above 11 years old. Our flagship Spending Account, FamX, seamlessly integrates UPI and card payments, enabling users to manage, save, and learn about their finances effortlessly.


Revolutionizing Payments and FinTech

FamApp has enabled 10 million+ users to make UPI and card payments across India, removing the inconvenience of carrying cash everywhere. Users get to customise their FamX card with doodles, which lets them add a personal touch to their payments.


Trusted by leading investors

We’re proud to be supported by renowned investors like Elevation Capital, Y-Combinator, Peak XV (formerly Sequoia Capital India), Venture Highway, Global Founder’s Capital, and esteemed angels Kunal Shah and Amrish Rao.


Join Our Dynamic Team

At Fam, our people-first approach is reflected in our generous leave policies, flexible work schedules, comprehensive health benefits, and free mental health sessions. We don’t mean to brag, but we promise you’ll be surrounded by some of the most fun, talented and passionate people in the startup space.


Want to see what makes life at Fam so awesome? Check out our shenanigans at @lifeatfam 😛

PS - We’re looking for someone with an AI-native mindset, who actively leverages AI in their day-to-day work, as we encourage and embed it across every level at Fam.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Wrike is the most powerful work management platform. Built for teams and organizations looking to collaborate, create, and exceed every day, Wrike brings everyone and all work into a single place to remove complexity, increase productivity, and free people up to focus on their most purposeful work.

Wrike is our people, not a place. As a distributed team, we own our growth, stay globally connected, and rely on the product we build to deliver impactful work alongside brilliant minds. You'll have real ownership over meaningful work, a global team that has your back, and the flexibility to do your best work your way. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

Our vision: A world where everyone is free to focus on their most purposeful work, together.

About the Role:

Wrike is seeking a highly adaptable Senior Product Manager to join our global product organization. As a strategic leader, you will own the end-to-end lifecycle of your product area, driving measurable business impact and solving complex problems for millions of users.

We are looking for a versatile generalist who is comfortable tackling diverse challenges as business needs evolve, but who is ready to immediately dive into a high-impact, transformative domain: AI-driven Work Intake.

Your Impact:


Deliver Innovation: Validate and ship solutions that revolutionize how work flows into systems, saving customers time and boosting work quality for both administrators and end-users. Evolve Wrike's work intake experience through platform and agentic capabilities within your first 6 months.
Drive Discovery & Vision: Deeply understand customer workflows and underlying business pains to uncover emerging needs. Paint a compelling product vision and propose pragmatic, innovative solutions — whether through advanced AI, platform capabilities, or a combination of both — that best solve the core problem.
Adapt & Scale: Act as a flexible product leader capable of pivoting to new, critical product domains as our overarching business strategy evolves.


Your Qualifications:


4+ years of hands-on experience in B2B SaaS Product Management, owning customer-facing digital products from ideation to launch.
Customer-Centric Mindset: Strong empathy for customers and a passion for delivering exceptional user experiences.
Product Discovery: You are experienced in conducting market research and user interviews to identify customer needs and pain points. You are also experienced in testing and validating potential solutions with real users to ensure that they effectively address the identified needs.
Practical AI experience: Hands-on experience with leveraging AI technologies to streamline work and experience with the creation of AI-powered features.
Collaboration Skills: Ability to work well with cross-functional teams and communicate effectively with many partners across different parts of the organization.
Advanced English language skills (written and spoken), with the ability to communicate complex concepts clearly to diverse stakeholders.


Standout Qualities:


Experience in the enterprise collaboration, project management, or work management domain.
Proven experience building and delivering AI or LLM-driven product experiences to market.
Demonstrated ability to balance the complex configuration needs of system administrators with a frictionless experience for end-users.


Team Dynamics:


You will operate within a core "Product Trio" model (Product, UX, and Engineering) to guide a tight-knit Scrum team of 6-8 engineers and QA to deliver the product innovations.
You will partner heavily across the organization, pulling in expertise from specialized roles such as AI/ML engineers, Data Scientists, Product Analytics, and Go-to-Market teams to ensure successful launches.
You will have direct access to enterprise customers and admins to conduct continuous research, test early prototypes, and validate hypotheses through tight feedback loops.
The opportunity to operate at the bleeding edge of AI and work management, blending complex, enterprise-grade capabilities with modern, intelligent user experiences.


Benefits & Perks:


10 days of National and Festival Holidays per year (eight fixed, two flexible)
18 days of paid vacation per year
14 days of sick leave with a medical certificate per year
5 uncertified sick days per year
Group Medical Plan: Coverage for employees, spouse, children, and parents/in-laws for Rs 5,00,000. Free health checkup for employees
Personal Accident Insurance: Rs 50,00,000
Term Life Insurance: Rs 50,00,000
Up to 26 weeks of paid maternity leave for the first two children
4 weeks of paid parental leave
2 days off for volunteering with nonprofit charities
Broadband/Internet Reimbursement: INR 1500 per month
Full-stocked pantry and complimentary lunch
Hybrid work model


What’s Next?


Interview with a Recruiter
Hiring Manager Interview
Product Case Study / Technical Interview
Cultural Fit Interview
Final interview with Product Director 


Your recruitment buddy will be Tripti Sachan, Senior Recruiter.

Who Is Wrike And Our Culture

We’re a team of innovators and creators who solve the complex work problems of today and tomorrow.

Hybrid work mode

Wrike is our people, not a place. With 1,000+ employees collaborating across nearly every time zone, we support talent through 10 global hubs — Australia, Costa Rica, Cyprus, Czechia, Estonia, France, India, Ireland, Japan, and the United States — offering flexible ways of working that include remote work, hybrid environments, and co-working spaces across many locations.

While flexibility looks different across teams and regions, employees located near certain hubs — particularly in Prague (CZ), Nicosia (CY), Bangalore (IN), and Rennes (FR) — are generally expected to collaborate in person around 2–3 days per week, balancing the flexibility of distributed work with opportunities for in-person collaboration and connection.

Our persona 

💡 Smart: We love what we do, and we’re great at it because this is our domain. Our combined knowledge in this space is unmatched.

💚 Dedicated: We get up every day focused on helping our customers win. We’re committed to helping our teammates win, too!

🤗 Approachable: We're friendly, easy to get along with, considerate, and helpful.

Our culture and Values 

🤩 Customer-Focused

We care about our customers. We understand the customer journey, experience, and value derived from Wrike. Decision-making and action-taking are done with the customer in mind.

🤝 Collaborative

We work as one and win together, each bringing unique strengths that contribute to diversity of thought for better outcomes. Leveraging our own work management platform, we foster an environment of creative collaboration and shared achievement.

🎨 Creative

We strive to succeed through continuous innovation. It’s our pursuit of novel concepts that helped us create a market category. We continue to cultivate a workplace that fosters creative thinking as a means of transcending conventional boundaries and empowers us to break new ground to deliver extraordinary work management solutions.

💪 Committed

We believe in ownership at all levels of the organization, by owning workflows from start to finish. Each member of our team is an integral part of this commitment, establishing work as a platform for personal growth and transformation, as well as collective success and growth.

Check out our LinkedIn Life Page, Company culture page, Instagram, Wrike Engineering Team, Medium, Meetup.com, Youtube for a feel for what life is like at Wrike.

We are specifically looking for a Product Manager with proven, hands-on experience in owning and building B2B SaaS / technology products.

The ideal candidate should have experience across 0-to-1 and 1-to-N product journeys—from identifying problems and validating opportunities to defining, building, launching, scaling, and continuously improving products.

We are particularly interested in candidates who have worked in startups, product-led companies, or lean product teams, with significant end-to-end product ownership. Experience as a Founding Product Manager, first/only Product Manager, or a PM working closely with founders/CEO will be highly relevant. This role requires someone who can build a new product from scratch while also owning and evolving existing products and product lines. 

About the Company

Smart Food Safe is a pioneering software company specializing in Quality, Food Safety, Regulatory, and Traceability management solutions. The company provides a customizable suite of advanced tools designed to streamline processes, ensure compliance, and improve product quality, empowering organizations of all sizes.

With a strong focus on innovation and real-time operational visibility, Smart Food Safe helps businesses address emerging food safety and regulatory challenges. By combining cutting-edge technology with an affordable and customer-centric approach, the company remains a trusted partner in optimizing food safety and quality management across the supply chain.

Role Overview

As a Product Manager, you will drive the strategy, roadmap, and end-to-end execution of Smart Food Safe’s B2B SaaS products.

You will work closely with the CEO, engineering, design, QA, marketing, sales, and functional teams to identify customer problems, define product opportunities, build new products from 0-to-1, and evolve existing products from 1-to-N.

This role requires strong product thinking, customer understanding, ownership, and execution ability. You will be expected to translate customer and business problems into practical product solutions and work closely with engineering and design teams to take them from concept to delivery.

Key Responsibilities 

Define and drive the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and priorities aligned with business goals.
Identify and validate customer problems, market opportunities, and product ideas through research, discovery, and customer interactions.
Own products end-to-end, from discovery and definition through development, launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.
Build new products from 0-to-1 and scale/refine existing products from 1-to-N.
Translate customer needs and business requirements into PRDs, BRDs, FRDs, user stories, and feature specifications.
Manage and prioritize the product backlog and work closely with engineering during sprint planning, development, testing, and releases.
Collaborate with engineering, design, and QA teams to ensure timely and high-quality product delivery.
Track product metrics, customer feedback, and usage patterns to identify improvements and measure product performance.
Work closely with sales, marketing, and functional consulting teams on product positioning, customer requirements, and go-to-market initiatives.
Engage directly with customers and stakeholders to understand problems, validate solutions, and gather product insights.
Maintain Jira or other product/project management platforms to support the technology team and ensure execution visibility.

Required Skillset

Proven experience managing and owning B2B SaaS / technology products and complete product lifecycles.
Strong understanding of 0-to-1 product development and 1-to-N product scaling.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and data-driven product decision-making skills.
Ability to work effectively in Agile/Scrum development environments.
Experience with product management tools such as Jira, Notion, Confluence, ClickUp, or similar.
Basic understanding of software development, APIs, integrations, AI, and modern web applications.
Familiarity with product design and collaboration tools such as Figma or similar platforms.
Strong communication, stakeholder management, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Ability to work independently, take ownership, and operate effectively in a fast-paced startup environment.
Prior experience working on AI-related SaaS products is a good-to-have.

Education & Experience

4+ years of experience in Product Management, preferably in B2B SaaS, technology, or product-based companies.
Demonstrated experience of end-to-end product ownership, preferably in a startup or lean product environment.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field.
IIM and IIT freshers can also apply

About Bureau

Bureau is a unified risk decisioning platform for Compliance, Fraud, and Transaction risks. Our platform is a single decision-making engine, powered by a 1 billion+ identity knowledge graph. Over 150 Banks, fintechs, retailers, and digital platforms use Bureau to verify identities faster and stop fraud earlier globally.

Bureau has raised $50M+ from renowned Silicon Valley and global investors including Sorenson Capital and PayPal Ventures and is expanding rapidly from APAC to Americas, Europe, and beyond.

Why Bureau?

Bureau is building the infrastructure that makes digital identities and transactions safe and trustworthy for billions of people. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is real.

We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, build systems from scratch, and care deeply about turning strategy into execution. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won't be your place. If you want to shape how a scaling global company operates—keep reading.

About the Role: Product Manager - RASP

You will own Bureau RASP (Runtime Application Self-Protection). It is a rare chance to take a category-defining security product from launch to scale.

Sophisticated mobile fraud now executes inside the app itself. Bureau RASP answers with a four-layer Zero Trust framework embedded in the customer's app:
Application integrity: code obfuscation, anti-tampering and anti-debugging, powered by XVM, our proprietary virtualization engine.
Runtime and environment: detection of root, jailbreak, emulators, cloned apps, hooking and overlay attacks.
Network and data channel: protection against MITM, packet sniffing, geo spoofing and VPN or proxy bypass.
Visibility and policy: monitor, warn or block per threat from a dashboard, with immutable audit logs.

It is built at the OS level, goes live in minutes with no code changes, and feeds runtime signals into Bureau's Graph Identity Network. You will decide where it goes next.

What you’ll be doing

Own the RASP vision, strategy and roadmap across Android and iOS.
Track the mobile threat landscape and turn new attack patterns into shipped protections.
Partner with security, SDK and platform engineers to deliver detections that are accurate, hard to bypass and light on app performance.
Shape the customer experience: zero-code onboarding, the policy engine, alerts and audit reporting.
Connect RASP signals with Device Intelligence, Behavioural Biometrics and the Graph Identity Network to create value no standalone RASP can match.
Work with sales, solutions and marketing on positioning, pricing, demos and competitive wins.
Spend time with CISOs, fraud heads and app teams at banks, fintechs and e-commerce firms to learn what they need.
Define success metrics such as adoption, detection efficacy, false positives and integration time, and report on them.

What You’ll Bring

Must have

4-6 years in product management, with at least 2 years on a B2B security, fraud or mobile SDK product.
Working knowledge of mobile app security: Android and iOS internals, reverse engineering, rooting, hooking and tampering.
Comfort going deep with engineers on technical trade-offs, and going wide with customers on business outcomes.
A record of taking a product from early release to enterprise adoption.
Clear writing and sharp prioritisation.

Good to have

Experience with RASP, app shielding, device fingerprinting or mobile threat defence.
Exposure to BFSI or fintech customers and regulatory expectations for app security.
An engineering or security research background.

Our Culture

We hire self-motivated people and get out of their way
We value performance, not hours worked
Speed, ownership, and impact matter most

Compensation

Competitive salary + potential equity
Health benefits, flexible PTO, learning budget

At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

About The Team And The Role

eBay is looking for an experienced, highly driven product leader to own the growth of eBay Balance - our stored-value, wallet product.

In this role, you will define how eBay Balance serves customers across non-U.S. North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific, with an initial focus on markets such as Canada, Australia, and selected European countries. You will build experiences that enable customers to receive funds, hold value, reload their balance, and spend that value back on eBay.

This is not a localization or feature-maintenance role. It is an end-to-end product ownership opportunity: identifying the highest-potential customer use cases, shaping the international strategy, launching new capabilities, and creating the adoption flywheel that makes eBay Balance an everyday part of how customers engage with eBay.

You will work at the intersection of payments, commerce, and financial services - operating at the scale and complexity of one of the world’s largest global marketplaces.

What You Will Accomplish

Own the international product strategy and roadmap for eBay Balance across Canada, Australia, Europe, and additional non-U.S. markets.
Identify the most valuable regional customer problems and determine where eBay Balance can create differentiated value for buyers and sellers.
Design and improve the complete stored-value lifecycle, including how customers:
Receive or earn funds
Add or reload money
Hold and manage their balance
Spend funds back on the eBay platform
Develop new product features, incentives, and customer experiences that increase activation, adoption, repeat usage, and spend.
Build a market expansion framework that balances customer demand, business opportunity, regulatory requirements, operational readiness, and platform scalability.
Lead products from discovery through launch and optimization, bringing structure and momentum to complex, ambiguous initiatives.
Use customer research, behavioral data, financial analysis, and experimentation to identify friction, validate opportunities, and make high-quality product decisions.
Define and own success metrics such as activation, funded accounts, reload behavior, balance retention, repeat usage, spend-through, and incremental business impact.
Partner closely with the product leader responsible for U.S. eBay Balance to build shared platform capabilities while addressing market-specific customer and regulatory needs.
Align and influence stakeholders across engineering, design, analytics, business, payments, operations, finance, risk, legal, and compliance.
Communicate strategy, priorities, tradeoffs, and business results clearly to senior leaders and executive stakeholders.
Establish repeatable capabilities that allow eBay Balance to expand efficiently into additional markets over time.

What You Will Bring

7+ years of product management experience, with meaningful experience in payments, digital wallets, stored-value products, fintech, financial services, or commerce.
A track record of shipping and scaling complex customer-facing products across multiple teams or markets.
Solid understanding of payment flows, funding methods, money movement, wallet experiences, or account-based financial products.
Demonstrated success driving product adoption, engagement, retention, or transaction growth - not simply delivering features.
Experience translating ambiguous business opportunities into a clear strategy, prioritized roadmap, and executable product plan.
Strong analytical judgment and the ability to use customer insights, experimentation, and data to make decisions.
Experience influencing engineering, design, analytics, business, risk, compliance, and operational partners without relying on direct authority.
Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to simplify complex topics and make clear recommendations to senior executives.
High ownership, urgency, and resilience. You are energized by difficult problems, move decisively, and stay accountable from strategy through measurable results.
A global approach and an appreciation for how customer behavior, regulation, payment infrastructure, and business models differ across markets.


Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center, and AI Hiring Guidelines.

jobs.sourceTitle: Product Manager, Geo, Google Maps, UGC Contributor Success
jobs.descriptionHtmlOrText:
Minimum qualifications:

Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
5 years of experience in product management or a related technical role.

Preferred qualifications:

3 years of experience in a business function or role (e.g., strategic marketing, business operations, consulting).
3 years of experience in a role preparing and delivering technical presentations to executive leadership.
2 years of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, 0 to 1, etc.).
Experience in AI/ML product management.
Experience with data analysis.

About the jobAt Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.

In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.

One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

User-Generated Content (UGC) covers a wide range of products that enable Google Maps (Geo) users to share their real-world experiences and facts of the world with others in the form of reviews/ratings, photos or videos, asking and answering questions about a place, place attributes, etc.

As the Product Manager, you will partner closely with the engineering and analyst teams to leverage Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning (AI/ML) models, user and place understanding, and platform capabilities to publish high-quality content on addresses, location, landmarks, gates from contributors across surfaces and Generative AI (GenAI) experiences.The Geo team is focused on building the most accurate, comprehensive, and useful maps for our users, through products like Maps, Earth, Street View, Google Maps Platform, and more. Every month, more than a billion people rely on Maps services to explore the world and navigate their daily lives.

The Geo team also enables developers to use the power of Google Maps platforms to enhance their apps and websites. As they plot a course for the future of mapping, they are solving complex computer science problems, designing beautiful and intuitive product experiences, and improving our understanding of the real world.

Responsibilities

Define the product idea, roadmaps, and success metrics for destinations and arrivals workstream, using data analysis and evaluations to inform both high-level strategy and day-to-day decisions.
Provide cross-functional leadership to a virtual team spanning engineering, operations, analytics, User Experience (UX), policy, legal, Public Relation (PR), privacy, and compliance across multiple product areas (e.g., Geo, Core, Trust and Safety, Commerce).
Rally stakeholders behind a common idea, backed by articulate and confident communication.

About Us

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

Visa's Client Platforms and Enterprise Tools team owns the platforms that govern how clients and partners securely connect to Visa's APIs. As Sr. Product Manager, you will drive product strategy and execution for the Visa Developer Platform's API Gateways, the encryption and key management capabilities that protect data in transit, and Visa's India data localization operations. Direct product strategy from product conception and definition through implementation. Identifies new business and market opportunities and creates appropriate business plans

All roles require digital fluency, including the ability to work with emerging technologies such as Generative AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot) to support everyday work.

Key Responsibilities

Own product strategy and the long-term roadmap for the Inbound API Gateway and its associated developer portal onboarding flows
Define the roadmap for authentication and encryption mechanisms supported at the gateway (mTLS, PQC, OAuth, JWT/JWK) and prioritize new auth capabilities against client and regulatory demand
Own security configuration capabilities such as header whitelisting, and prioritize enhancements based on emerging threat models and client requirements
Run front-door intake meetings and prioritize incoming feature, security, and integration requests from internal product teams and partners
Manage the regional deployment roadmap, ensuring gateway capabilities and security configurations are rolled out consistently across regions
Partner with security, cryptography, and platform engineering teams to validate that new authentication and encryption capabilities meet Visa's security and compliance bar
Define and track performance key results (latency, availability, onboarding time, auth failure rates) to ensure ongoing product readiness
Own documentation and enablement materials so internal teams and partners can self-serve gateway onboarding and configuration
Monitor support/incident trends related to authentication and security configuration, feeding recurring issues back into the roadmap
Present roadmap, KPIs, and key security/compliance decisions to leadership and governance forums on a recurring cadence
Support daily operational needs requiring data access and retrieval by India-localized personnel, ensuring timely turnaround for internal and client requests
Help ensure India-localized platforms and tools run reliably as a cohesive product suite, coordinating fixes and improvements across the underlying systems

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

- 9 or more years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor's Degree, or 7 or more years of relevant experience with an Advanced Degree, or 3 or more years of experience with a PhD
- Proven experience as a Product Manager owning API platforms, gateways, or security/authentication infrastructure
Working knowledge of API authentication and security standards (OAuth, mTLS, JWT/JWK) and emerging areas such as post-quantum cryptography
Familiarity with encryption concepts (message-level and field-level encryption) and key management lifecycle practices
Experience running intake/prioritization processes and setting product roadmaps for multiple concurrent workstreams
Experience partnering closely with security and cryptography engineering teams on regulated or compliance-sensitive capabilities
Understanding of data localization or data residency regulatory requirements is a plus
Strong stakeholder management skills across product, engineering, security, and compliance partners
Comfortable working with agile frameworks such as Scrum or Kanban

Visa is an EEO Employer

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

Meet the Team

Cisco is seeking a Product Manager to join the Webex Customer Experience Solutions team. This role sets a clear product direction, turns customer and market evidence into an outcome-led roadmap, and leads delivery with engineering, design, data, go-to-market, and operations partners. The successful candidate will operate with high autonomy, make deliberate tradeoffs across customer value, quality, speed, and business impact, and communicate those decisions clearly to senior leaders and delivery teams.

Your Impact

Set Product Direction and Roadmap
Own the near-term vision and prioritized roadmap, aligned to broader business and product strategy.
Translate customer problems, market shifts, technology opportunities, and operating constraints into clear product outcomes, requirements, and sequencing decisions.
Develop business cases and success measures that connect feature investments to customer adoption, commercial value, reliability, and strategic goals.

Lead Customer and Data Driven Decisions
Build direct relationships with customers, partners, and internal field teams; synthesize feedback across research, support, usage, and market inputs.
Validate early product concepts with customers and partners, then use the evidence to refine problem statements, product direction, and roadmap decisions.
Monitor industry trends, customer expectations, and competitive signals to identify opportunities, risks, and needed adjustments to product strategy.
Formulate the right business questions, use data to inform decisions, and connect project outcomes to meaningful metrics for the product area.
Make and explain tradeoffs between customer needs, commercial priorities, product quality, and delivery capacity.

Deliver High Quality Products
Partner closely with engineering and design to define specifications, resolve technical and design tradeoffs, and deliver high-quality releases.
Assess release readiness across functional, technical, customer, and business criteria; make clear decisions on whether a release meets the required bar.
Manage the lifecycle from discovery through launch and iteration, including readiness with sales, marketing, customer success, support, and operations.
Define and monitor adoption, workflow-efficiency, quality, and customer-impact measures after launch; use results to guide follow-on investment and iteration.

Influence and Lead Across the Organization
Align with Product stakeholders anticipate concerns, and build plans that balance their needs while maintaining product direction.
Engage senior internal leaders and customer to shape positioning, gain buy-in, communicate roadmap choices, and resolve escalations.
Mentor and support more junior PMs through informal coaching, stronger product artifacts, and practical delivery guidance.
Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business, or equivalent practical experience.
10 or more years of product management, product lifecycle management, solution architecture, or closely related experience in enterprise software, SaaS, communications, or customer experience products.
Demonstrated ownership of a product roadmap or substantial product area, including prioritization, requirements, delivery, launch, and post-launch iteration.
Experience translating customer needs and business goals into actionable product specifications, investment choices, and measurable outcomes.
Strong analytical judgment, including the ability to use data, customer feedback, and operational evidence to make product decisions.
Proven ability to influence engineering, design, sales, customer success, and operations partners in a matrixed environment without direct authority.
Executive communication skills, including concise roadmap, tradeoff, and business-case presentations for internal and customer audiences.
Experience defining product quality, adoption, commercial, reliability, and customer-success measures and using them to guide investment decisions.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with contact center, customer experience, communications, workflow automation, data and analytics, or AI-enabled enterprise software.
Experience working with enterprise customers, strategic partners, and globally distributed product and engineering teams.
Experience applying AI tools to enhance product insight, execution quality, and decision-making.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

We are WisdomAI.

We exist to help people unlock clarity from complexity.

WisdomAI builds AI-powered analytics that put answers directly in the hands of the people closest to the business. Our platform doesn’t just surface insights — it explains the why behind them, helping teams move from data to decisions with speed, confidence, and context.

We’re trusted by companies like Cisco, Patreon, and Rubrik — and we’re just getting started.The problems here are hard, and the expectations are high. Our team is energized by both. If you’re compelled by ambitious problems, high standards, and meaningful ownership, you’ll thrive here.

About WisdomAI

WisdomAI is on a mission to make working with data delightful. We empower businesses to unlock insights, drive innovation, and make data-driven decisions at scale. Join our rapidly growing team and be a part of a company that is shaping the future of enterprise data. We are a fast-paced, early-stage startup, currently ~30 people and growing.

The Role: A Builder, An Empath, and An Executor

This is not a traditional Product Manager position; it is a dynamic, hands-on function built for the age of AI-native product development. We are a build-first company that values execution and rapid iteration over lengthy documentation.

At WisdomAI, the Product Manager acts as a catalyst for collective intelligence, empowering engineers and designers to propose and build, keenly capture customer feedback, and continuously strive for improvement. This role requires a minimum of 4+ years of relevant experience and a deep balance of technical understanding and customer empathy.

Core Responsibilities

The PM role serves as the glue that connects the customer's needs, the market's demands, and our team's creative and technical capabilities.

Customer Empathy and Data Mastery
Cultivate deep customer empathy by spending time with prospects and users, observing workflows, and understanding their business context. 
Translate customer pain points into clear and actionable problem statements for the development team. 
Leverage your technical and data understanding to evaluate product performance, interpret complex analytics, and inform strategic decisions. 
Proactively track qualitative and quantitative feedback by monitoring support channels, listening to sales calls, and checking in with customer-facing teams. 
Technical Depth and Execution Orientation
Guide the team in choosing the right development approach for the task at hand (PM-first, Design-first, or Dev-first), relying on your technical understanding of our platform. 
Define the problem and its constraints, allowing engineers to write robust solution proposals. 
Maintain a relentless execution oriented focus, seeing yourself as an extension of the development team, unblocking them and consistently following through on commitments to drive features to launch. 
Work effectively in our fast-paced environment, balancing immediate user needs with long-term strategic goals. 
Strategic Communication
Facilitate discussions, lead brainstorms, and articulate a compelling product vision to align the entire organization. 
Act as a product evangelist, collaborating with sales, marketing, and customer success to clearly articulate the product’s value. 
Proactively close the feedback loop, ensuring insights from users and the market are constantly flowing back into the development process. 

What You'll Bring: Qualifications

4+ years of experience in Product Management, specifically within B2B SaaS, Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, or related AI-native platforms. 
Proven track record of successful product delivery and strategic execution in a fast-paced environment. 
Demonstrated technical and data understanding—you must be comfortable discussing APIs, data pipelines, model performance, and architectural trade-offs with customers and engineers. 
Deeply rooted customer empathy and proficiency in interpreting user analytics and business metrics to guide product strategy. 
Strong collaborative and stakeholder management skills across Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing. 
Excellent written and verbal communication skills. 

Our CRAFT

CRAFT isn’t a list of aspirational values. It’s how we hire, how we promote, how we resolve hard calls, and how we stay honest with ourselves.

C — Customer trust. Everything starts here. We listen carefully, act with integrity, and respond with urgency. Delight is downstream of trust — never the other way around.

R — Relentless on outcomes. We move with urgency, take initiative, and see things through. Effort isn’t the measure — results are. If something isn’t working, we change the approach now.

A — Authenticity. We say the hard things, directly and with respect. We also show up as full humans. That combination is how trust is earned and how we grow together.

F — First principles, grounded in reality. We don’t accept “that’s how it’s done.” We strip problems to what’s actually true and build up from there — then validate quickly and let real-world results decide.

T — Transparency. We share the why, not just the what. When something can’t be shared, we say so. We’re one team — information flows so we can do our best work and challenge each other when we’re wrong.

Equal opportunity employer

WisdomAI is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive team where everyone can do their best work.

The mandate is to define and deliver what those products become in an AI-first platform. That means insight that finds the customer rather than waiting to be asked for, including generated insight and anomaly detection across their spend. It means data products built for a customer's own systems and agents to consume, not only for a person to read. And it means owning the trust layer underneath all of it, so that the answers our AI produces are accurate enough to put in front of a procurement executive.

You will work across the JAI portfolio, because the data and intelligence layer you own is what every agent and research capability in the product reasons over.

Agile execution: Translate product requirements into clear, well-defined requirements and acceptance criteria for the engineering teams, and work with them through delivery.

Strong working understanding of data platforms, semantic and dimensional modelling, and analytics or BI tooling. Snowflake experience is an advantage. 
A rigorous approach to accuracy: comfort defining ground truth, designing evaluation sets, and holding a quality bar under delivery pressure. 
Experience working with enterprise customers to validate problems and quantify value, rather than gathering feature requests.

Able to hold both a multi-year product direction and a current-quarter delivery commitment without losing either. 
Strong written and verbal communication in English, and credible with both engineering and business leadership. 
Effective at influencing without authority across product, engineering and go-to-market teams. 
Accustomed to working in an international environment across multiple development sites and time zones.

An agreed product direction for analytics and data products in an AI-first platform, signed off with Product and Engineering leadership and reflected in the roadmap. 
Generated insight and anomaly detection delivered to early access customers, with adoption and accuracy reported as the primary measures of success. 
A published quality and evaluation standard for the data and semantic models our AI reasons over, with accuracy tracked and reported.

About the Role
Delhivery moves millions of shipments every day, and every one of them has to be priced, invoiced, and collected correctly. A shipment billed late, billed wrong, or not billed at all is revenue the network earned but never banked. A disputed invoice also strains our relationship with a shipper. This role exists to fix that.
As Product Manager for Billing, you will own the product strategy for Delhivery's contract-to-cash engine, from rate card setup and shipment pricing through invoicing, dispute resolution, and collections. You will build systems that price every shipment accurately, catch revenue leakage before it reaches an invoice, and give shippers bills they trust. This is a high-visibility, high-ownership role at the intersection of business, finance, operations, and technology.

What You Will Do
Own the roadmap, not just the backlog. Define the product strategy for billing accuracy, revenue assurance, and faster cash realization. Translate business objectives into a prioritized roadmap with crisp KPIs such as billing accuracy, dispute rate, invoice TAT, unbilled revenue, and DSO, and be accountable to them.
Go deep before you go wide. Conduct structured deep-dives across rate cards, contract terms, weight and dimension capture, surcharges, credit notes, and reconciliation to find where and why revenue leaks. Quantify the financial impact of every gap before proposing a fix.
Bridge business reality and product design. Spend time with finance, BD, key account managers, and shippers. Understand why invoices get disputed, why contracts are hard to configure, and where manual work creeps in. Bring that context back into product decisions.
Get the fundamentals right at scale. Build billing systems that handle Delhivery's breadth of businesses, including Express, PTL, FTL, and cross-border, along with complex commercial constructs like slab pricing, fuel-indexed surcharges, and minimum guarantees. Keep everything compliant with GST, e-invoicing, and audit requirements.
Drive execution without losing sight of the bigger picture. Work closely with engineering, QA, finance, and ops to ship scalable solutions on time. Facilitate trade-off conversations between technical feasibility, financial controls, and business urgency, and make the call.
Prioritize ruthlessly. Apply first-principles thinking to separate high-impact initiatives from noise. Keep the team focused on what moves revenue and cash.

What You Bring
2+ years of product management experience in billing, fintech, ERP, logistics, or a fast-paced internet company

Practical fluency with modern AI tooling: prompt engineering, RAG, and AI-assisted coding environments (Cursor, GitHub Copilot, KIRO)

Billing is not a back-office function. It is where the value the network creates turns into revenue. Signal over noise: only the few things that need their attention right now, and nothing else

Company Description

Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.

Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.

Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.

As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.

For everyone, everywhere.

Job Description

More about our mission and what we offer.

Wise is building the best way to move and manage money across borders. To make that possible, customers need to be able to join Wise quickly, safely, and confidently.

We’re looking for a Principal Product Manager to join our Onboarding & KYC team in Hyderabad. You’ll own high-impact product work across APAC, helping Wise build onboarding and verification experiences that are low-friction for customers and prevent financial crime.

This is a senior role for someone who can operate in ambiguity, get deep into customer, regulatory, data, and technical details, and turn complex problems into shipped product outcomes.

What You’ll Be Doing

Own product strategy and roadmap for APAC onboarding, KYC and financial crime mitigation initiatives, from discovery through delivery, launch, measurement, and iteration.
Build and scale digital identity verification and eKYC experiences across markets such as Japan, Singapore, Australia, New Zealand, Thailand, Malaysia, Hong Kong, and the Philippines.
Partner with Engineering, Design, Analytics, Operations, Risk & Compliance to balance conversion, customer experience, operational cost, regulatory requirements and financial crime risk.
Lead complex localisation work, including integrating local identity providers, registry checks, and APAC-specific controls into Wise’s global platform.
Improve customer onboarding outcomes such as first product adoption, verification completion, time-to-verify, manual review rates, cost-to-serve, and quality of fincrime decisions.
Mitigating risk of financial crime by ensuring our in-product control environment accounts for country-specific financial crime risks.
Use data, customer insight, operational feedback, and regulatory context to prioritise what matters most.
Help generalise APAC’s strongest onboarding and KYC capabilities so they can be reused by other Wise product teams.
Staying close to the details: customer journeys, dashboards, service architecture, regulatory interpretations, edge cases, incidents, and operational workflows.

Qualifications

What we’re looking for

Significant product management experience, ideally in finance/fintech, identity, onboarding, KYC, risk, compliance, fraud, trust & safety, or another regulated domain.
8+ years in the workforce with ideally 5+ years in product management or product-management adjacent roles. 
For those with material experience outside of product management we still require a minimum of 3+ years in a senior product manager role
A strong track record shipping customer-facing products end-to-end, not just writing strategy.
Excellent structured problem solving: you can break down ambiguous, multi-stakeholder problems and create a practical path to impact.
Strong analytical skills: you can define good metrics, interrogate data, work with SQL (or similar), and make trade-offs based on evidence.
Enough technical depth to work with engineers on systems, integrations, reliability, observability, and platform design.
Strong customer focus, including a habit of using customer research, support insights, funnel data, and operational feedback to shape product decisions.
Clear, concise communication and the ability to influence senior stakeholders without relying on authority.
High ownership, strong attention to detail, and willingness to roll up your sleeves,
Nice to have

Experience with KYC/KYB: digital identity, national ID systems, government registry integrations, biometric or document verification, business onboarding, 
Experience in financial crime prevention: risk models (e.g. machine learning models), fraud/scam product prevention
Experience launching products across multiple countries or adapting global platforms to local market requirements.
Experience working with distributed teams across product, engineering, compliance, operations, and regional leadership.

Location

This role is based in Hyderabad, working closely with teams across Singapore, other APAC markets and Wise’s global product and engineering hubs.

Additional Information

For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.

We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.

Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.

If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.

Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

Description

Join Amazon Pharmacy's Supply Chain team and shape the systems that determine how medications reach patients. You will define product strategy and drive performance for the buying and inventory planning systems at the core of the pharmacy supply chain: procurement systems that decide what to buy and when under expiry and regulatory constraints, inventory planning that sets optimal stock levels across the network, and placement algorithms that position inventory across fulfillment centers. These systems are informed by demand forecasts that predict prescription volume, but your focus is turning that signal into smart purchasing and inventory decisions.

Pharmacy supply chains are unlike retail: demand is primarily driven by prescriptions (not browsing), products expire, controlled substances require compliance layers, and regulations vary by state. Every buying and inventory decision you define and measure operates under these constraints.

We are looking for a dynamic, analytically rigorous Senior Product Manager - Tech to own the product strategy for how Amazon Pharmacy determines optimal inventory levels, decides what and when to buy, simulates network decisions, and identifies unhealthy inventory — with demand forecasting as a key input to those decisions. You will define the problems, shape the solutions, and drive outcomes across these domains — working directly with engineers and scientists building the underlying optimization and ML systems.

Key job responsibilities

Define the product vision and multi-year roadmap for pharmacy supply chain systems: procurement, inventory placement and capacity planning
Translate complex supply chain and healthcare constraints (expiry, controlled substances, state regulations) into product requirements that engineering teams can build against
Design and own the end-to-end metrics framework for pharmacy supply chain health within your domain
Work with Operations, Compliance, Vendor Management, Fulfillment, Finance, and In-Stock partners to provide solutions and drive improvements
Partner with Applied Scientists and ML Engineers to define success criteria for forecasting models, optimization algorithms, and automated decision systems
Influence without authority across multiple teams and organizations to drive outcomes in a matrixed environment

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in engineering, statistics, computer science, operations research, business analytics, information systems or equivalent
Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
Experience managing technical products or online services
Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning

Master's degree in a quantitative/technical field such as computer science, engineering, statistics
Experience in healthcare, pharmacy, or regulated supply chains
Experience with ML/AI product management — defining success criteria for models, managing model lifecycle, A/B testing ML systems

Senior Product Manager, Search, Indexing and Query

Couchbase | Product Organisation | Bangalore, India | Reports to VP of AI Product Management

About The Role

Couchbase is building the operational data platform for AI. Search, indexing and query are the core of it — how data is found, filtered, ranked and returned is what determines whether an application, or an agent, can actually use the data underneath. We are hiring a Senior Product Manager to own that surface area across Capella and Couchbase Enterprise: the SQL++ query experience, secondary indexing, full-text search, and vector and hybrid search.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role for someone who wants to do the work at the Senior level — write the PRFAQ, sit with the customer, push the tradeoff, ship the capability, and own the outcome after launch. Reporting to the VP of AI Product Management, you will partner closely with the query, indexing and search engineering teams, with sales and GTM, and with the broader AI organization.

You do not need to have shipped a query engine or a search product before. We are hiring for the underlying capability, not the resume line — see “Who This Role Is Open To” below.

What You Will Own

Search, indexing and query as a product surface: End-to-end ownership of how customers express and satisfy a query on Couchbase — SQL++ query, global secondary indexes, full-text search, and vector and hybrid search. The roadmap in your area, the PRFAQs and PRDs, the launch, the adoption, and the iteration after launch.

Retrieval for AI applications: Make Couchbase the retrieval layer that RAG applications and agents actually use — hybrid search relevance, metadata filtering, recall and freshness, and cost per query. Work with the wider AI portfolio so retrieval composes with the rest of the platform rather than sitting beside it.

Developer experience for query and indexing: How a developer writes a query, gets an index recommendation, debugs a slow plan, and understands what a query costs. Reduce the number of things a developer has to know before their first query is fast.

Performance, cost and benchmark credibility: Own the performance story for your area. Reproducible benchmarks the field can stand behind, a defensible cost and TCO narrative against MongoDB, Elastic, Postgres and pgvector, and dedicated vector stores, and a clear point of view on where Couchbase wins and where it does not.

Working backwards from the customer: Start with the customer and work backwards. Write the PRFAQ before any code is written. Validate with real, named enterprise customers. Make clear tradeoff calls about what to build and what to defer based on what the enterprise ICP universally needs — not features chasing competitors or one-off requests outside the ICP.

Engineering partnership: Work shoulder-to-shoulder with the query, indexing and search engineering teams. Earn their trust by being technically credible, decisive on scope, and clear on the why. Own the PRD as a living document, not a one-time artifact. Hold the bar on quality, scope, and timing through to launch.

Customer and design partner engagement: Run design partner programs for the capabilities you own. Bring real customer voice into roadmap decisions and back to the broader team. Help build a pipeline of named reference customers willing to talk publicly about what they have shipped.

Cross-portfolio collaboration: Coordinate across Core Database, Capella, Analytics, Mobile and Edge, and the AI Specialist team so the capabilities you own compose cleanly with the rest of the platform. Bring a build-vs-partner point of view to your area.

Sales and GTM partnership: Equip sales, sales engineering, PMM, and partner GTM with what they need to win on search, indexing and query — positioning, demos, competitive context, benchmark data, customer proof points. Be the product owner in deals where the technical depth matters.

External voice: Contribute as the product owner in customer briefings, webinars, blog posts, documentation, and enablement content for the capabilities you own. Support analyst engagements and keynote content led by the Principal PM, PMM, and AR.

AI-driven PM practice: Use AI deeply and visibly in your own product management work — research, PRFAQ drafting, customer synthesis, competitive analysis, benchmark analysis, engineering collaboration. Adopt and contribute to the team’s AI-driven PM and AI-DLC (AI-driven development lifecycle) practices in day-to-day execution.

Raising the bar: Share what works. Contribute to PRFAQ and PRD standards, interview loops, and onboarding. Mentor associate and early-career PMs as the team grows.

What You Will Deliver

PRFAQs and PRDs for the capabilities you own, validated with named enterprise customers before engineering starts.

Shipped capabilities across query, indexing and search with measurable adoption and at least one named reference customer per major launch.

A published, reproducible performance and cost position for your area that sales and engineering both stand behind.

Clear, defensible tradeoff decisions visible to engineering, sales, and GTM. The team knows what is in, what is out, and why.

Sales and GTM enablement that the field actually uses — measured by pipeline influence and win-rate signals, not enablement-decks-produced.

Contributions to the broader platform narrative — customer-facing content, blog posts, and documentation in partnership with the AI Specialist team, PMM, and AR.

Visible AI-driven PM practice — concrete examples of AI-DLC in your daily work that the rest of the team can learn from.

Must Have

Seven or more years in product management, with at least three on a technical platform — database, data infrastructure, search, analytics, developer tools, cloud infrastructure, or AI infrastructure.

Systems depth. You can reason about latency, throughput, recall, index structures, query plans, memory and storage tradeoffs, and cost per operation. Given a benchmark or a slow query, you know what to ask next.

Customer obsession and working-backwards rigor: You start with the customer and work backwards. You write PRFAQs before code. You can tell which feature requests reflect universal ICP needs and which are noise, and you make the call clearly.

Engineering credibility: Engineers want to work with you. You hold your own on architecture, are decisive on scope, and own the why behind every tradeoff.

Cross-functional trust: Sales trusts your roadmap. GTM trusts your enablement. Marketing trusts your narrative. You build durable working relationships outside your own team.

AI-driven PM practice: You already use AI in your own PM work — research, PRFAQ drafting, customer synthesis, competitive analysis — and you can point to concrete examples.

Insanely paranoid and obsessed about becoming obsolete by mastering AI, constantly upskills and has work to prove.

Our Company

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI. 

What You'll Do

In this role, you will serve as a Senior Product Manager for Teradata's vector search and unstructured data capabilities, driving product vision, strategy, roadmap, execution, and adoption. You will define how enterprises turn documents, images, audio, and other unstructured content into searchable, trusted context that AI applications and agents can retrieve at scale, alongside the structured data they already manage in Teradata. 

On the retrieval side, you will own the product direction for vector and hybrid search: indexing and approximate nearest neighbor techniques, filtering, ranking and re-ranking, and the balance between recall, latency, freshness, and cost. You will work with engineering to make vector search a first-class, SQL-native capability that performs at enterprise scale and concurrency, and you will define how relevance and quality are measured, not only how fast queries run. 

On the ingestion side, you will own how unstructured data gets into the platform: connectors to object stores and enterprise content sources, document parsing, OCR, chunking, metadata extraction, embedding generation, and incremental refresh. You will shape pipelines that are reliable, governed, and cost-efficient, with access controls, lineage, and sensitive-data handling that carry through from source to retrieved result. 

Your impact will be measured by customers moving from retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) prototypes to production AI applications and agents that run on trusted enterprise data, with measurable gains in answer quality, time to value, and cost per query. 

Who You Will Work With

You will collaborate with customers, engineering, the database engine and SQL teams, AI platform and data science teams, cloud infrastructure, UX, governance and security, product marketing, and field teams to bring next-generation retrieval capabilities into Teradata's enterprise ecosystem. You will be responsible for ensuring our products meet business objectives. 

What Makes You a Qualified Candidate

Bachelor's in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field from a recognized institution. MBA or advanced degree is a plus. 
6+ years of experience in software product development companies, including 3+ years in product management working with AI/ML, search, or data platform products. 
Strong knowledge of embeddings and vector search, including index types (such as HNSW and IVF), quantization, filtered and hybrid search (keyword plus vector), and re-ranking. 
Working understanding of RAG, LLMs, and AI agents, and how retrieval quality drives answer quality. Experience defining evaluation metrics such as recall, precision, and relevance. 
Understanding of unstructured data ingestion: document parsing, OCR, chunking strategies, multimodal content, metadata extraction, and embedding pipelines, including GPU considerations. 
Experience with data pipelines and connectors on cloud object storage, including batch and incremental or streaming ingestion. 
Experience with APIs, SDKs, and integrations for enterprise and developer adoption, including open ecosystems such as Python, Jupyter, and agent frameworks. 
Familiarity with the competitive landscape, such as Pinecone, Elasticsearch and OpenSearch, pgvector, Snowflake, Databricks, and MongoDB, and the ability to benchmark against it. 
Excellent communication skills, with a strong track record of customer engagement, product KPIs, and prioritization. 
Experience with AI productivity tools, and the ability to work independently and deliver high quality outcomes in fast-paced environments. 

What You Will Bring

Experience building search, retrieval, or data ingestion products at scale, with a clear view of the trade-offs between recall, latency, freshness, and cost. 
Hands-on exposure to building RAG applications or agents on structured and unstructured enterprise data. 
A quality mindset: the discipline to build benchmarks and evaluation sets, and to let data decide between approaches. 
A strong understanding of responsible AI, including explainability, auditability, and protection of sensitive data in retrieval. 
Vision to anticipate how agents will use retrieval, and to position Teradata's offerings as differentiated and enterprise-ready. 
Passion for intuitive developer and user experiences, such as natural language search and simple, SQL-friendly interfaces. 
Ability to influence engineering and go-to-market teams without direct authority, and to mentor others.

We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally.
