Description

What if running an e-commerce business could become dramatically simpler — with AI helping sellers manage orders, inventory, pricing and operations across every channel they sell on?

Amazon Smart Commerce is looking for a Principal Product Manager - Tech to lead SmartHub (including the team of PMs), our multi-channel commerce operations platform. SmartHub brings together orders, inventory, catalog, returns, warehousing and business insights across marketplaces and D2C channels into a single system, helping businesses operate at scale without navigating multiple disconnected tools.

We are now at an exciting inflection point. Advances in generative and agentic AI create an opportunity to fundamentally rethink how sellers operate their businesses — moving from dashboards and workflows that tell sellers what happened, toward intelligent experiences that understand their business, identify what needs attention, recommend actions and increasingly execute work on their behalf.

As the Principal PM for SmartHub, you will define this next chapter. You will own the long-term product vision and roadmap for SmartHub and lead important horizontal capabilities such as pricing that span the broader Smart Commerce portfolio.

This is a role for a product builder who enjoys solving complex platform problems, operating in ambiguity and translating emerging technology into simple products that deliver measurable customer and business impact.

Key job responsibilities

Own the product vision, strategy and roadmap for SmartHub, Amazon Smart Commerce's multi-channel operations platform spanning order management, inventory, catalog, returns, warehousing and analytics.

Define how AI and agentic experiences can transform commerce operations — helping businesses move from manually operating software toward systems that understand business context, surface opportunities and risks, recommend decisions and automate repetitive work.

Reimagine high-frequency seller workflows such as order processing, inventory management, exception handling, returns and pricing to make operating across multiple sales channels dramatically simpler.

Lead horizontal product capabilities such as pricing that can create leverage across SmartHub and the broader Smart Commerce portfolio.

Develop a deep understanding of sellers ranging from emerging businesses to high-volume brands, including the operators who use SmartHub every day in warehouses and back offices.

Use customer research, product data and business insights to identify the highest-value problems and translate them into simple, scalable product experiences.

Partner deeply with engineering, science and UX teams on complex platform and AI problems, making thoughtful trade-offs across customer experience, reliability, scalability and speed.

Define and drive metrics across adoption, engagement, operational efficiency, seller experience and business impact.

Work across Amazon and external commerce ecosystems to build integrations and capabilities that allow businesses to operate seamlessly across marketplaces and D2C channels.

Influence senior leaders and partner teams across organizational boundaries to establish long-term product and technology direction.

Raise the product management bar through strong product judgment, first-principles thinking, clear written narratives and mentorship of other product leaders.

A day in the life

You might start the day speaking with a seller or warehouse operator processing thousands of orders across Amazon, Flipkart and their own website, identifying where manual work and exceptions slow them down. Later, you could work with engineers and scientists on an AI agent that detects inventory risks or automates an operational workflow, review adoption and reliability metrics with the team, and then align senior leaders on a multi-year product strategy. You will move fluidly between warehouse-floor details, customer experience, platform architecture, AI possibilities and business strategy.

About The Team

Amazon Smart Commerce is building the technology infrastructure for agentic commerce that helps businesses sell and operate wherever their customers shop.

SmartHub is our multi-channel operations platform, helping sellers bring orders, inventory, catalog, returns and business insights from multiple marketplaces and D2C channels into one system. It is built for the operational realities of commerce — high-volume events, warehouse workflows, complex integrations and businesses that cannot afford downtime.

We believe AI creates an opportunity to reinvent this category. Our ambition is to evolve from software that helps sellers manage workflows to an intelligent commerce operating system that helps them run and grow their businesses.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree
Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
Experience technical product management

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working directly with Engineers on product enhancements
Experience in project management methodologies, business analysis, or process improvement

We are looking for a Product Manager II to own a data and services product area, from understanding the problem through delivery, adoption, and improvement. This role combines hands-on analysis with product ownership: asking the right questions, defining clear requirements, and following through until the work makes a measurable difference.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. Build useful service experiences: Define requirements for service APIs, dashboards, alerts, and diagnostic workflows. Use partner feedback to improve onboarding, documentation, self-service, and automation that reduces manual analysis.

Deliver with partners: Coordinate milestones, dependencies, and risks for your feature area. Work with engineering on safe rollout, release criteria, monitoring, and service-health guardrails; communicate blockers and resolve issues early.
Learn from operation: Track adoption, data quality, and service health after release. Use partner feedback and operational findings to prioritize improvements in usability, reliability, latency, and cost.
Communicate clearly: Explain findings, progress, and tradeoffs to partner teams. Document decisions and open questions, seek different perspectives, and contribute to an inclusive, collaborative team.

Qualifications

Required/Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelor's Degree AND 2+ years experience in product/service/program management or software development.
OR equivalent experience.
Additional Or Preferred Qualifications

Other Requirements: Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter. 

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

Partner and Customer Understanding + Data-Driven Decision Making

Product Manager : Consumer Experience

We’re looking for a Product Manager who turns customer understanding into shipped outcomes.
MyYogaTeacher helps people across the world improve their health and well being through live, personalized yoga. We connect students with experienced yoga teachers in India for 1-on-1 sessions designed around their goals, lifestyle, health conditions, and preferences.
Our platform has served 200K+ customers and supports thousands of live sessions across time zones, devices, payment systems, and customer journeys.
We are now entering a phase where speed, clarity, and execution matter more than ever.
We are looking for a hands-on Product Manager who can speak with students, understand their real motivations, make sound decisions with incomplete information, and work closely with design, engineering, analytics, sales, and operations to ship meaningful improvements quickly.
This is not a role for someone who only writes requirements, manages Jira, or waits for complete data before making a decision.
You will be expected to understand the customer, form a point of view, bring teams together, and drive the product from problem discovery through execution and measurable impact.

What You’ll Own
Customer and Persona Understanding
Develop a deep understanding of our students—their goals, anxieties, motivations, objections, habits, and reasons for choosing personalized yoga.
Regularly speak with prospective students, active customers, churned customers, teachers, sales teams, and customer support teams.
Convert customer conversations, behavioral data, support tickets, sales calls, and session feedback into clear product insights.
Build and continuously refine customer personas and journey maps based on evidence rather than assumptions.
Understand the underlying job the customer is hiring MyYogaTeacher to do—not merely the feature they are requesting.
Ensure that product decisions remain connected to why MyYogaTeacher exists: helping people build healthier, happier, and more sustainable lives and identify ambivalence.

Product Discovery and Decision Making
Identify high impact opportunities across acquisition, trial, conversion, onboarding, engagement, retention, referrals, and reactivation.
Clearly define the customer problem, target persona, expected behavior change, and desired business outcome before proposing a solution.
Form strong product hypotheses using qualitative insights, product analytics, market understanding, and business context.
Make thoughtful decisions even when information is incomplete or circumstances are changing.
Distinguish between decisions that require deeper research and decisions that can be made quickly and reversed later.
Maintain a clear product decision log so teams understand what was decided, why it was decided, and what assumptions are being tested.
Challenge weak assumptions, unnecessary complexity, and solutions that do not address the underlying customer problem.

Execution and Delivery
Take end to end ownership of product initiatives from problem discovery to launch, adoption, measurement, and iteration.
Translate product opportunities into clear requirements, user journeys, success metrics, edge cases, and acceptance criteria.
Work closely with design and engineering to reduce ambiguity and unblock decisions quickly.
Break large initiatives into smaller releases that allow the team to learn and deliver customer value sooner.
Participate actively throughout development instead of handing over requirements and waiting for completion.
Review product builds continuously, identify gaps early, and ensure that the final experience solves the intended problem.
Drive weekly execution across multiple product initiatives while maintaining clarity on priorities and outcomes.
Follow through after launch to measure adoption, identify friction, and improve the product based on actual customer behavior.

Product Analytics and Business Impact
Define measurable outcomes for every major product initiative.
Use funnel analysis, cohort analysis, customer segmentation, experiment results, and qualitative feedback to understand product performance.
Monitor key metrics across trial completion, trial-to-paid conversion, onboarding, session attendance, engagement, retention, referrals, and customer satisfaction.
Investigate unexpected changes in customer behavior instead of relying only on dashboard-level reporting.
Partner with analytics and engineering teams to improve the quality and usefulness of product data.
Communicate whether a product initiative worked, what was learned, and what should happen next.

Cross-Functional Leadership
Bring together engineering, design, analytics, sales, marketing, teacher operations, and customer support around a shared understanding of the customer problem.
Communicate product decisions clearly and directly across technical and non-technical teams.
Resolve ambiguity and disagreements by returning the discussion to customer evidence, strategic priorities, and expected outcomes.
Conduct product demonstrations and training for teams responsible for launching, selling, supporting, or operating new experiences.
Ensure that teams understand not only what is being built, but why it matters.
Take accountability for the outcome without blaming dependencies, processes, or other functions when execution becomes difficult.

AI-First Product Management
Use AI tools as part of your daily product workflow—not as an occasional experiment.
Apply AI to accelerate customer research synthesis, product analysis, competitive research, requirement development, prototyping, test-case thinking, and documentation.
Use AI to explore more alternatives and move faster while continuing to apply strong product judgment.
Help improve how the broader product and engineering organization uses AI to increase execution speed and decision quality.

What You Bring
3–6 years of hands-on product management experience, preferably in a consumer internet, marketplace, subscription, health, wellness, education, or engagement-driven product.
Demonstrated experience owning meaningful product initiatives from discovery through launch and iteration.
Strong understanding of customer personas, user behavior, funnels, lifecycle journeys, and consumer decision making.
Experience using qualitative research and quantitative data together to make product decisions.
Ability to write clear product requirements while avoiding excessive documentation and process.
Strong product judgment and the confidence to make decisions without waiting for perfect information.
Experience working closely with engineering, design, analytics, operations, sales, or customer facing teams.
Comfort reviewing interfaces, customer journeys, data, workflows, and edge cases in detail.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
A bachelor’s degree in engineering, technology, design, business, or a related discipline. Exceptional product experience is more important than the specific degree.

What Makes You Stand Out
You regularly speak with customers instead of relying only on dashboards, second hand feedback, or market reports.
You can explain the customer persona, the problem, the business impact, and the product decision in simple language.
You have examples of making a difficult product decision quickly and taking responsibility for the outcome.
You know when to research further and when to stop discussing and start executing.
You can identify the smallest useful version of an idea and get it into customers’ hands quickly.
You have improved conversion, activation, engagement, retention, or customer satisfaction through products you personally own.
You are comfortable going deep into product details without losing sight of the larger customer and business outcome.
You question assumptions respectfully and do not allow unresolved ambiguity to slow the team indefinitely.
You proactively follow up, close loops, and move work forward without requiring repeat

Job Title: Product Manager - Time & Attendance and Scheduling

About this Job:

The platform team in people function is responsible for defining, developing and managing a programmatic approach to a scalable global solution. About The Company

Why We Built Lyric: Supply chains are more critical and complex than ever. Every day, large enterprises navigate trillions of possible decisions that could impact the bottom line. Powerful algorithms and AI can address these problems, yet most organizations struggle to leverage supply chain AI at scale. The current SCM technologies are either rigid, limited-scope point solutions or custom solutions built in-house, which demand immense expertise and investment.

That is…until now.

Enter Lyric: Lyric is an enterprise AI platform built specifically for supply chains, offering the best of both worlds:

Out-of-the-box AI solutions for optimizing networks, allocating inventory, scheduling routes, planning fulfillment capacity, promising orders, propagating demand, building predictions, analyzing scenarios, and more, plus
A platform-first approach that empowers both business and technical users with end-to-end product composability, leveraging no-code tools, their own code, or even forking our code to build and refine supply chain decision intelligence

With Lyric, enterprises no longer have to choose between flexibility and speed, they get both.

The Mission: We’re building a new era in supply chain with the team best equipped to lead it. With over 20 years at the intersection of supply chain and algorithms, we developed a deep conviction that global supply chains needed something like Lyric. Since our inception in December 2021, that conviction has been validated time and time again.

Today, a growing number of Fortune 500 companies, including Smurfit WestRock, Estée Lauder, Coca-Cola, and more, are innovating on their own terms with Lyric. We can’t wait to see what our customers, both current and future, are empowered to build with us next. Come build with us!

The Role

Retail planning is still largely built around planners navigating workflows, interpreting data, making hundreds of decisions, and manually translating those decisions into action.

We think there is a fundamentally different future.

At Lyric, we're building the next generation of Retail Planning capabilities, combining deep planning intelligence with agent-first product experiences that can reason, recommend, act, and increasingly execute planning work autonomously.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager, Retail Planning to help build that future.

This isn't just about digitizing existing retail planning workflows. You'll help determine which decisions should remain planner-led, which should become AI-assisted, and which can become truly autonomous.

What You'll Do

Build Lyric's Retail Planning capabilities

Own product strategy and execution for major Retail Planning workflows across Hardlines and Softlines. 
Develop a deep understanding of how retailers make assortment, inventory, allocation, replenishment, pricing, and related planning decisions. 
Translate messy, interconnected planning problems into clear product primitives, workflows, and capabilities. 
Work directly with retailers and planners to understand where existing planning systems break down and where Lyric can create step-change improvements. 
Define product requirements, prioritize the roadmap, and drive products from discovery through launch and adoption. 

Reimagine Retail Planning for an agent-first world

Challenge the assumption that planning software should simply provide better dashboards and workflows. 
Identify planning decisions and activities that AI agents can analyze, recommend, orchestrate, or execute autonomously. 
Design human-agent interactions that give planners leverage without removing the context, judgment, and control they need. 
Work with AI/ML and engineering teams on products that reason across large amounts of retail data and operate across multi-step planning workflows. 
Help define what the role of the retail planner looks like when agents can increasingly perform the repetitive analytical and operational work. 

Become deeply embedded in the customer problem

Spend significant time with planning teams, operators, and retail leaders. 
Develop strong intuition around differences between categories, channels, seasons, inventory structures, and retail operating models. 
Separate customer requests from underlying problems and build products that generalize across retailers. 
Partner with customers during early deployments and use real-world usage to rapidly improve the product. 

Drive outcomes, not feature delivery

Define clear measures of success for the capabilities you own. 
Understand whether products are actually changing planner behavior and improving retail decisions. 
Make trade-offs across usability, sophistication, autonomy, explainability, and speed. 
Operate with high ownership across product, commercial, and customer outcomes. 

What We're Looking For

6+ years of Product Management experience, ideally building complex B2B, enterprise, data, planning, optimization, or decision-support products. 
Strong understanding of retail planning, particularly within Hardlines and/or Softlines retail. 
Experience working on problems involving assortment, inventory, allocation, replenishment, merchandising, pricing, forecasting, or adjacent planning domains is highly valuable. 
Ability to understand complex business systems and reduce them into clear product abstractions. 
Strong product judgment. You can distinguish between recreating an existing workflow and designing a materially better way of solving the problem. 
Comfortable working with data-heavy products and collaborating closely with engineering, data science, and AI/ML teams. 
Excellent customer discovery skills. You can go several layers deeper than what a user initially asks for. 
Strong written and verbal communication. 
Comfortable operating in an environment with significant ambiguity, high autonomy, and a high bar for execution. 

We'd Be Particularly Excited If

You've built products used by merchandise planners, inventory planners, allocators, buyers, or other retail planning teams. 
You've worked inside a major retailer or closely with enterprise retail customers. 
You've built AI-native or agentic products rather than simply adding AI features to an existing application. 
You naturally question whether a workflow needs to exist at all before optimizing it. 
You enjoy domains where product management requires learning the underlying business deeply enough to debate with experts. 

What Success Looks Like

Within your first year, you should be able to:

Become one of Lyric's internal experts on Hardlines and Softlines retail planning. 
Own and materially advance a meaningful portion of Lyric's Retail Planning product. 
Build trusted relationships with sophisticated retail customers and planners. 
Ship products that replace meaningful amounts of manual planning work, not merely make those workflows slightly faster. 
Establish repeatable patterns for how AI agents and human planners collaborate, moving Lyric progressively toward autonomous retail planning.

Excited to define technology that powers an entire portfolio of products, not just a single application? 
Interested in building the industry's leading AI-native Product Intelligence Platform? 


If so, we'd love to meet you.

Why Esko? 

Esko, part of Veralto (NYSE: VLTO), is the global leader in packaging and product lifecycle solutions. More than 25,000 customers across 140+ countries rely on Esko to design, manage, manufacture, and deliver products found on store shelves every day. Packaging for 9 out of 10 major consumer brands is managed using Esko solutions. As we enter our next phase of growth, we're making significant investments in cloud, AI, and platform engineering to build the future of product innovation.

Our vision is to create the industry's leading AI-native Product Intelligence Platform. This modern, multi-tenant cloud platform unifies product, packaging, regulatory, quality, manufacturing, and supply chain data into a single intelligent ecosystem. By combining cloud-native architecture, intelligent automation, and AI-powered insights, we're helping global consumer goods, life sciences, and manufacturing companies innovate faster, improve compliance, reduce waste, and bring products to market with greater speed and confidence.

About The Role

As Product Manager for AI Services, you will own the product lifecycle for a shared foundation of AI capabilities that Esko's internal teams build on rather than re-invent - enabling them to solve customer problems that were previously out of reach with optimal speed and efficiency.

Cross-functional collaboration sits at the core of the role. You will coach internal teams, consolidate their needs to find common ground, work with technical and design stakeholders to agree the best approach, and document clear, testable requirements that are reviewed and approved before development begins. The result is a coherent, prioritized backlog and roadmap that reflects the combined needs of Esko's product teams and aligns with company strategy and AI transformation objectives.

You will keep stakeholders updated as work progresses, then support them through acceptance testing, triage and implement change requests, and drive adoption of the services in production. Ongoing success management is central: keeping services aligned with evolving team and customer needs while maintaining a generalized approach and backwards compatibility, and growing capabilities in line with advances in technology and market expectations. You will track adoption and key performance metrics to demonstrate impact and identify where more focus is needed.

As a key member of the Esko AI team, you will also help shape the strategic vision for Esko's AI initiatives through brainstorming, thought leadership, customer discussions and events.

What You Will Do

Own and prioritize the product backlog for AI Services – a shared collection of common AI capabilities leveraged by Esko product and engineering teams.
Proactively gather needs from cross-functional product teams and turn them into clear, well-scoped requirements for the Esko AI engineering teams.
Act as a bridge between Esko AI and other cross-functional teams - product, engineering, and commercial – to ensure their success in building AI-powered capabilities that deliver on the intended customer value.
Help other teams to bootstrap their own AI initiatives on top of the shared capabilities: clarifying what already exists, what needs to be built, and how to get started.
Weigh competing requests from multiple stakeholders against the long-term company strategy and priorities, while documenting risks and expected trade-offs.
Define and maintain adoption / success metrics for the shared capabilities - and use them to continually re-prioritize the backlog and indicate risks and areas of additional focus.
Communicate roadmap, priorities, and trade-offs clearly across engineering, product, and leadership stakeholders.


What We Are Looking For

At least 5 years’ experience in a Software Product Management role, preferably including ownership of a platform, API or other shared-services product used across multiple internal teams.
Undergraduate or master’s degree in computer science or related discipline.
Native or fluent proficiency in English.
Experience initiating, deploying, and scaling AI-powered capabilities in production, with a track record of managing the development cycle from proof-of-concepts or early-stage ideas into production capabilities that other teams depend on.
Experience acting as a liaison in a large, global organization with multiple cross-functional teams - gathering and distilling requirements from varied stakeholders, aligning competing priorities, and driving toward a successful shared outcome.
Strong product management fundamentals: backlog ownership and refinement, roadmap creation & communication, and the ability to write clear, unambiguous requirements for engineering to build and test against.
Comfort operating at the boundary between a platform team and the product teams that consume it, balancing shared needs and central objectives against individual team priorities and timelines.
Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to work fluently with both technical and business stakeholders alike.


Preferred Experience

Experience in packaging graphics or the wider graphic arts industry is strongly preferred. 


What Success Looks Like

Teams across the business ship AI-powered capabilities that solve valuable customer problems by leveraging a shared foundation of AI Services, rather than “re-inventing the wheel”.
Ideas and concepts forged by different teams are assessed for potential development as centralized AI services.
A roadmap for AI Services is maintained and accurately describes the status of current and plans for future objectives.
The Esko AI engineering teams work from a clearly prioritized backlog.

AI services are clearly explained and documented, with measures taken to minimize any roadblocks or barriers to successful adoption.
AI Services grows as a coherent whole rather than fragmenting into one-off, team-specific solutions.
A class-leading set of capabilities provide a powerful base for Esko cross-functional teams to transform the value of our software using cutting-edge AI technologies.

The job

You will own product discovery and delivery outcomes for a defined scope, including roadmap definition, prioritization, and ongoing lifecycle management—ensuring the product delivers measurable value to customers and contributes to AVEVA’s business objectives.

This role is execution-heavy and highly technical. You will translate strategy into detailed product requirements, partner with R&D to deliver high-quality outcomes, and ensure the voice of the customer is embedded into every phase of product development.

This role requires strong technical fluency and comfort operating in an agile delivery environment. You will represent the voice of the user in engineering forums, drive clarity through well-formed requirements and acceptance criteria, and create transparency into prioritization decisions and delivery progress.

As a senior individual contributor, you will demonstrate strong product management craft, influence without authority, and operational excellence. You will help raise the bar on how product decisions are made—using customer evidence, market insight, and data-driven metrics to guide prioritization and trade-offs.

In this role, you will also play a critical part in stakeholder engagement— responding to customer issues that impact product success. Success requires strong communication, comfort navigating ambiguity, and the ability to drive alignment across teams toward shared outcomes.

Main Responsibilities

Product Execution & Delivery

Opportunity Definition: Prepare and manage Opportunity Canvases and related Initiatives, defining objectives, value propositions, success measures, priorities, and delivery scope in partnership with cross-functional stakeholders.
Backlog Ownership: Own the product backlog for your scope: intake, triage, refinement, prioritization, and readiness for development.
Requirements & Scenarios: Translate user needs and cross-product scenarios into clear requirements (user stories, functional and non-functional requirements, acceptance criteria) that R&D can implement.
Delivery Planning: Partner with R&D to define milestones, sequencing, and release plans; proactively manage risks, dependencies, and scope trade-offs.
Technical Reviews: Participate in technical and development reviews; provide product input on implementation decisions to ensure usability, supportability, security, and scalability.

Voice of the Customer: Serve as the trusted voice of the customer—ensuring product decisions are grounded in real user problems and that customer feedback is systematically incorporated.
Internal Engagements: Represent the product in internal forums to provide clarity, alignment, and decision support across teams.
Issue Resolution: Coordinate responses to escalated customer-facing or internal issues impacting product success; drive root-cause understanding and prioritization of fixes.

Leadership & Stakeholder Engagement

Portfolio Strategy Translation: Work closely with the Portfolio Director to understand portfolio strategy and investment priorities for the assigned area, and translate them into clear long-term direction and short-/mid-term execution plans (roadmap, sequencing, and quarterly objectives) aligned to delivery capacity and customer outcomes.
Cross-Team Alignment: Collaborate with key stakeholders, including Portfolio/Product leadership, R&D, UX, Customer Success, Support, and other internal groups to align product initiatives with company and product strategies.
Stakeholder Communication: Clearly present product strategy, roadmap, scope decisions, and progress updates to internal stakeholders; ensure shared understanding of goals, trade-offs, and timelines.

Team Development & Operational Excellence

Operating Cadence: Establish and maintain strong product operating practices (e.g., roadmap reviews, backlog refinement, discovery cadence, release readiness) to enable predictable execution.
Collaboration & Leadership: Lead through influence—aligning engineering, UX, and cross-functional stakeholders around shared outcomes.
Quality & Responsiveness: Ensure high standards for product quality, usability, and customer impact; ensure responsiveness to user feedback via the feedback portal and other vehicles.

Skills

Product Management Excellence & Strategic Execution

Ability to write high-quality requirements and acceptance criteria; comfortable decomposing ambiguous problems into executable increments.
Experience collaborating day-to-day with engineering teams in agile development environments; confident in development reviews and backlog grooming.
End-to-End Product Ownership: Demonstrated success owning products across discovery, delivery, launch, and iteration.
Prioritization & Trade-Offs: Ability to manage competing priorities while balancing short-term and long-term investments.
Outcome Orientation: Strong focus on measurable customer value and business impact (not just output).
Cross-Functional Execution: Proven ability to work effectively with engineering, UX, marketing, sales, and customer success.

Customer & Market Focus

Customer-Centric Mindset: Consistent practice of grounding decisions in customer needs and usage evidence.

Communication & Influence

Clear Communication: Strong written and verbal skills to communicate roadmap, decisions, and trade-offs.
Stakeholder Management: Ability to align diverse stakeholders and handle disagreement constructively.
Storytelling: Ability to articulate value and rationale to different audiences.

Technical & Analytical Skills

Data-Driven Decision Making: Ability to use metrics, analytics, and qualitative insights to guide decisions.
Technical Fluency: Solid understanding of software development and product delivery practices; able to collaborate effectively with R&D.
Product Lifecycle Understanding: Familiarity with ideation, MVP delivery, iteration, customer feedback loops, and end-of-life considerations.

Execution & Operational Excellence

Organizational Skills: Strong planning and execution discipline; reliable follow-through.

Place of Posting - Bengaluru

Team : Economic Inclusion Program

About The/Nudge

The/Nudge is an action institute building resilient livelihoods to alleviate poverty. We work with women, farmers, tribals, and youth across rural development, agriculture, skilling, and economic inclusion, in partnership with 15+ central and state governments.

Our economic inclusion journey towards serving 25 million Indians spans 10 states and currently reaches over 1.5 million people. Through our incubator, accelerator, and grand challenges, we have supported 200+ social entrepreneurs, including Forbes 30 Under 30 honorees, Earthshot Prize winners, and nationally recognized changemakers.

Founded with the support of 130+ eminent philanthropists, 40+ corporates, and 15+ foundations, The/Nudge is working towards a poverty-free India, within our lifetime.

What are we solving for?

We are solving for households in poverty who are also financially and socially vulnerable through a targeted, multi-faceted, and sequenced model called the graduation approach, which has demonstrated that we can durably pull households out of poverty.

At The/Nudge Institute, We Have Been Piloting This Program For The Past 3 Years And Are Now Scaling It Across Multiple States. Our Purpose Is To Enable The Most Excluded Individuals To Become Contributing Members Of The Economy. We Will

Enable government to adopt by providing research, design, and implementation support
Continue to iterate on the program design to create impact at scale through our own implementations
Support more NGOs in adopting graduation approach by offering technical expertise and capacity building
Build evidence on graduation approach to nudge governments to adopt at-scale
Develop technology solutions that enable NGOs and governments to adopt and implement the program at scale & with quality

Position Overview

What are some of the principles/ approaches we use?

First principles thinking
Human centered design (thoughtful, action oriented, experimental & iterative process) with a gender lens (unbiased and reflective approach) 
Systems thinking (analytical, stakeholder oriented and holistic)
Strategic planning (result oriented, logical & coherent with clearly defined outcomes, grounded in current realities)

What will you do?

We are hiring an Associate Manager, Product Planning Feedback and Adoption to independently own planning, adoption and feedback workstreams across multiple state programs. The person will translate program priorities into measurable plans, ensure that product interventions and tools are used effectively, and build feedback loops that turn field experience into product and operating improvements.

This role combines hands-on program management with analytical and strategic ownership. The Associate Manager will work closely with State Operations, Product, Technology, Insights, Livelihood, Learning and Development, and program leadership. The role requires the ability to facilitate decisions, identify risks early and drive actions to closure with limited supervision.

Key Responsibilities

Planning and program visibility
Strengthen governance. Design weekly, fortnightly and monthly review rhythms that result in clear decisions, owners and next steps.
Strengthen collaboration between State Operation teams and Central Product teams through a regular cadence.
Adoption and data driven action
Own adoption across states. Lead the adoption of product interventions and tools from rollout through sustained and meaningful use.
Define meaningful metrics. Establish metric definitions, data sources, reporting frequency and data quality checks.
Interpret performance. Analyse trackers and dashboards, segment gaps by state, block, cohort or tool, and distinguish process, product and data issues.
Convert insights into action. Develop state-specific recommendations, align owners and timelines, and monitor whether interventions improve adoption.
Feedback systems and product improvement
Design end to end feedback cycles. Define the milestone, respondents, sampling approach, questions, scoring logic and success measures.
Ensure reliable data collection. Coordinate with state teams, monitor response quality and resolve collection gaps without compromising timelines.
Synthesize field evidence. Combine quantitative and qualitative inputs into clear product and process recommendations prioritised by impact, urgency and feasibility.
Close the feedback loop. Track accepted actions with owners and timelines, communicate decisions to stakeholders and verify closure.
Stakeholder leadership and communication
Anchor cross-functional forums. Set the agenda, prepare concise pre-reads, facilitate the discussion and keep reviews focused on decisions and actions.
Influence without authority. Build alignment across State Operations, Product, Technology, Insights and domain teams, and escalate dependencies with context and options.
Create leadership visibility. Prepare scorecards, reviews and written updates that explain progress, risks, underlying causes and specific asks.
Raise execution standards. Guide team members and partners on data discipline, meeting preparation, documentation and follow-through.
What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means that program plans and adoption metrics are trusted and used in reviews; risks are surfaced early with clear recovery plans; state and product teams receive recommendations that improve adoption; and field feedback leads to prioritised, tracked and communicated product or process improvements.

Who are we looking for in this role?

Experience and education
Relevant experience. 6+ years in program management, product operations, strategy and operations, implementation consulting or large-scale operations.
Independent ownership. Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional, multi-location or multi-state workstreams from planning through closure.
Education. A postgraduate degree or MBA is preferred. Candidates with a bachelor's degree and strong relevant experience will also be considered.
Core capabilities:
Analytical fluency. Can define and interpret metrics, question data quality, identify patterns and translate analysis into practical recommendations.
Structured problem solving. Can break down ambiguous problems, identify root causes, evaluate options and make sound recommendations.
Stakeholder management. Can build credibility, navigate differing priorities and influence senior and cross-functional stakeholders without formal authority.
Executive communication. Can facilitate effective meetings and communicate complex information clearly in written and verbal formats.
Execution discipline. Is organized, detail-oriented and proactive about follow-ups, risks and escalation while managing multiple priorities.
Tools. Is proficient in Excel or Google Sheets and comfortable working with dashboards and presentation tools.
Language and travel. Has strong written and spoken English and Hindi, and is willing to travel to and stay in rural program locations when required.
Good to have:
Sector experience. Exposure to livelihoods, social impact programs, government systems or large-scale field implementation.
Product adoption. Experience driving adoption of digital tools or process interventions across distributed teams.
Research and feedback. Experience with survey design, qualitative research, feedback synthesis or user research.
We aspire to be an inclusive and diverse organization and encourage qualified individuals irrespective of their religion, caste, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, ethnicity, age, or any other dimension of identity, to apply.

Join us as a Release Train Manager

This is a unique opportunity to join a fast paced and Agile team, responsible for aligning the vision, planning, and interdependencies of many teams by providing cross-team or domain synchronisation of the portfolio delivery and domain pipeline
With no two days the same, you'll have the chance to be a true servant leader and help ensure consistent Agile delivery at scale
In this exciting role, you'll enjoy regular engagements with key stakeholders as well as the opportunity to build your network across the bank
We're offering this role at vice president level

What you'll do

In this key role, you’ll be developing and maintaining the release train. This will include the preparation and review of the release and environment strategy, involving plans and estimation, and management of interdependencies. With your vital leadership, you’ll provide cross-team synchronisation, making sure everyone has a clear understanding of how their work helps our customers.

You’ll drive continuous improvement across delivery via various channels, including improving or removing manual steps, and we’ll look to you to demonstrably improve release train agility and value to end state customers.

Your Responsibilities Will Include

Enhancing deployment and management phases of the development lifecycle, including through Agile coaching and active contribution to release and environment best practice
Facilitating and fostering the preparation of release and sprint vision, goals and work pipelines and facilitating pre and post planning meetings
Building and communicating release calendars and iterative planning cycles and synchronising with other release train managers across domains
Aggregating the programme release objectives into value streams release objectives where they exist and publishing them for visibility and transparency
Assisting with the economic decision-making by facilitating estimation by teams and the roll up to programme and portfolio levels

The skills you'll need

We’re looking for someone with an expert understanding of running complex projects spanning multiple scrum and non-scrum teams.

You’ll Also Need

Experience of at least 12 years in a combined Product Owner and/or Project Manager role, ideally within a financial services or capital markets environment
Strong track record of managing technically complex products in close partnership with both business stakeholders and engineering teams
Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the confidence and gravitas to engage senior business leaders 
Exposure working with data platforms, data aggregation, or AI/ML-driven products

The role

At Axelerant, we believe the traditional handoff model , research to design to product to delivery , is no longer fit for purpose. AI tooling has collapsed the time between concept and working prototype, and the bottleneck has shifted from production to ownership. We are building for that reality. 

This is a new kind of role: the UX Product Owner, or UXPO. You are the single continuous thread connecting user intent to shipped value. You hold the story, the system, the design, and the sprint together , not as a coordinator, but as the person who owns all of it. You are not a designer who attends standups, and you are not a product owner who appreciates good UX. You are someone who does both, deeply, without losing fidelity in between. 

The work lives in overlapping loops , plan, prototype, calibrate, validate, ship, measure , and discovery feeds the backlog on a weekly cadence, not once at project kickoff. You will use AI tools to compress the concept-to-tested loop significantly, while knowing precisely where human judgment is irreplaceable. 

If you read a brief like this and think "that is already how I work," this seat is worth a conversation.

What you will own

Run end-to-end user research and translate insights directly into prioritized backlog items , no wall to throw them over 
Own the product narrative from discovery through deployment, maintaining context and continuity across every loop 
Design and iterate on systems thinking artifacts: user journeys, object models, and pattern libraries 
Write clear acceptance criteria and work shoulder-to-shoulder with engineers throughout the sprint 
Build and test coded or high-fidelity prototypes rapidly using AI-assisted tooling
Manage and groom the product backlog, balancing user needs, business goals, and delivery constraints 
Establish a continuous discovery rhythm so research informs the backlog weekly rather than at project kickoff 
Identify where AI tooling accelerates the work and where human judgment must remain the deciding factor

What you bring

Proven experience spanning both UX design and product ownership , not adjacent exposure, but genuine depth in each 
Strong research practice: you can design, conduct, and synthesize user research, then act on it without an intermediary 
Fluency in systems-level thinking, including journey mapping, object modeling, and design system architecture 
Comfortable and credible in agile delivery contexts , backlog management, sprint ceremonies, and direct collaboration with engineering teams 
Hands-on experience with AI-assisted design or prototyping tools to accelerate the concept-to-tested loop 
Ability to write precise acceptance criteria that bridge design intent and development implementation
Track record of maintaining product coherence across fast-moving, iterative delivery cycles 
Clear communicator who can align stakeholders, advocate for users, and make prioritization trade-offs transparently

What you get

A role that is genuinely new , space to define and shape what great UXPO practice looks like 
Collaborative, supportive team environment at Axelerant 
Work at the frontier of AI-assisted product development with real ownership over outcomes

About Daloopa:
Daloopa is the leading provider of AI-powered fundamental data for institutional investors. Headquartered in New York, with a growing team in India, Daloopa's proprietary platform sources, structures, and distributes one of the most comprehensive and accurate financial datasets in the market, helping investors accelerate research, financial modeling, and decision-making.
Trusted by hedge funds, private equity firms, mutual funds, corporates, and investment banks globally, Daloopa recently secured $47 million in Series C funding, bringing total funding to over $100 million. This investment will accelerate the company's mission of powering the next generation of AI-driven financial workflows.
At Daloopa, we are driven by our values: Obsess over the Customer, Raise the Bar, Be Intensely Proactive, and No BS. Joining us means being part of a high-performance culture where innovation, ownership, and impact go hand in hand.

Role Overview:
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the platform where humans and AI work together on live financial data — the review and feedback layer that supplements our AI extraction systems.
Every correction, override, and judgment call a human analyst makes in this product is a signal. Your job is to design the experience so that signal gets captured cleanly and routed back into the systems that need it: better context for the model at the point of decision, structured feedback loops, and inputs that improve accuracy of our data. As coverage expands into new regions, document types, and event types, this layer is what keeps quality improving across this expanding perimeter.
You will work closely with Engineering, Operations, and Product leadership to design review workflows that are fast for the analyst and help tune AI, and to build the instrumentation that turns human review into a compounding asset.
This is a high-ownership role for someone who is deeply technical, highly execution-oriented, and excited about building the human-AI interface for a real-world AI system at scale.

Key Responsibilities:
Own the roadmap for the review and feedback experience, covering how analysts see model context, make corrections, and resolve disagreements between AI output and ground truth.
Design context management into the workflow — surfacing the right source documents, prior decisions, and model reasoning at the moment an analyst needs to judge or correct an output, so review speed doesn't trade off against review quality.
Build the feedback and tuning loop end to end: capture structured signal from every human correction, route it to the AI/ML team in a form they can act on, and close the loop by measuring whether it changed downstream accuracy.
Partner with Engineering and AI/ML to define what needs to be reviewed, what the ideal review experience is, and how it endures with future AI model updates.
Instrument the full workflow from document to reviewed datapoint, with a single metric the team can rally around for review speed and error rate.
Collaborate cross-functionally across Product, Engineering, and Operations to align priorities, execute quickly, and deliver measurable business impact.
Stay current on advancements in AI/LLMs and apply emerging capabilities — particularly around human-in-the-loop tuning and RLHF-style feedback — thoughtfully into platform strategy and execution.

Skills and Qualifications

Make Custom Objects a first-class citizen across Workflows, Reporting, Contacts, Companies, Opportunities, Forms, Integrations, AI, and other HighLevel products .

Job Description

Make your mark by shaping innovative artificial intelligence solutions while growing your product leadership and technical depth on a high-impact team.

As an Artificial Intelligence Product Owner Vice President as a part of the Artificial Intelligence team within Commercial Investment Banking, you will set the product direction for artificial intelligence solutions that deliver measurable outcomes and support firm risk management objectives. You will partner with data science, engineering, design, and workflow stakeholders to translate strategy into scalable products across the full lifecycle. You will champion responsible innovation through strong controls, clear governance, and continuous performance monitoring.

Job Responsibilities

Own product vision, strategy, and roadmap for artificial intelligence products, aligning to business growth targets, user needs, and firm risk management objectives
Lead the end-to-end product lifecycle from ideation and planning through execution, launch, adoption, and continuous enhancements to improve cost efficiency, innovation, reusability, and reliability
Define and govern the solution design and delivery approach, evolving product methodologies and standards to consistently meet business outcomes and quality expectations
Drive responsible artificial intelligence and generative artificial intelligence implementation, including ethical practices, fairness, explainability, and controls for data drift and concept drift detection
Architect artificial intelligence-integrated, data-first workflows that enable human-plus-machine collaboration and integrate with upstream and downstream systems to maximize automation and connectivity
Partner with cross-functional teams (data science, engineering, workflow technology partners, user experience and interface design) to translate strategy into executable solutions and build high-impact products
Prioritize features and delivery execution by defining user stories, acceptance criteria, sequencing, and ensuring on-time, high-quality releases
Establish product performance measures by setting key performance indicators, monitoring outcomes and user feedback, and prioritizing investments and enhancements based on measurable impact

Coach product teams on best practices in market research, prototyping, storyboarding, mind-mapping, adoption strategies, and delivery excellence to raise capability and execution rigor
Champion innovation and generative artificial intelligence transformation across JPMorganChase by staying current on advancements, guiding stability versus variability choices, and fostering an open learning culture

Required Qualifications, Skills, And Capabilities

Hold a bachelor's degree in computer science, data science, engineering, or a related field
Demonstrate product owner (or similar) experience delivering artificial intelligence and machine learning products end-to-end
Bring 10+ years of hands-on experience in data science, machine learning, and predictive analytics
Apply strong understanding of artificial intelligence, machine learning, and data analytics, including large-scale data and distributed processing
Utilize familiarity with model operations practices, including monitoring, retraining, and continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines
Operate effectively in agile delivery environments and use product management tools such as Jira or Trello
Communicate clearly with strong stakeholder management skills in fast-paced environments with multiple priorities
Solve complex problems using analytical, conceptual, and investigative skills to evaluate options and scenarios
Build solutions using Python, structured query language, Alteryx, and PySpark
Demonstrate capability with natural language processing and prompt engineering
Leverage broad tool and platform exposure, including Confluence, Microsoft Power Platform (including Copilot Studio), Camunda business process management tools, cloud architecture on Amazon Web Services and Microsoft Azure, automation platforms such as UiPath, Xceptor, and Instabase, customer engagement systems, and workflow platforms

Preferred Qualifications, Skills, And Capabilities

Show experience with cloud platforms and artificial intelligence services, including Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform
Demonstrate knowledge of data privacy regulations and ethical considerations in artificial intelligence

Job Overview

LPL Financial is seeking a Data Product Analyst to support our Strategic Data Platforms, with a strong focus on how data is produced, shaped, governed, and delivered to downstream consumers across the firm. 

This role sits at the intersection of Product Management, Data Product Ownership, and Advanced Analysis, and is designed for a senior individual contributor who can bring rigor and clarity to complex, data‑centric platform initiatives. 

The Data Product Analyst focuses on data as a product—helping define data contracts, validate quality, assess downstream impact, and support data product and platform decisions. 

The ideal candidate is comfortable working across upstream systems of record, platform services, and downstream consumers, and excels at turning complex data flows into actionable insights and decisions.

Responsibilities

Product Discovery & Capability Support 

Support product discovery by helping translate business and platform needs into clear data‑centric problem statements. 
Contribute to roadmap planning by evaluating value, risk, and complexity across data initiatives. 
Help define outcomes and success measures for data platform capabilities (e.g., usability, reliability, adoption, quality). 

Advanced Data Analysis & Problem Solving 

Perform hands‑on exploratory and diagnostic analysis across distributed data sources and platforms. 
Investigate data quality issues, lineage gaps, and semantic inconsistencies that affect downstream consumers. 
Conduct impact analysis for schema changes, new feeds, platform migrations, or system decommissions. 
Identify systemic issues in data flow, transformation, or consumption and recommend durable solutions. 

Data Product Ownership (Supporting / Platform‑Level) 

Support Data Product Owners by helping define: 
Data contracts, schemas, and semantic definitions 
Data quality rules, validation logic, and controls 
Usage expectations and downstream dependencies 
Maintain traceability between business intent, data products, and technical implementation. 
Partner with engineering, architecture, and data platform teams to support scalable, reusable distribution patterns. 

Agile Execution & Delivery

Participate in backlog refinement, sprint planning, and demos to ensure work reflects validated platform and consumer needs. 
Support prioritization decisions by providing evidence‑based impact and dependency analysis. 

Stakeholder Communication & Influence 

Act as an analytical partner to Product Managers, Platform Owners, Engineering, and downstream consumer teams. 
Communicate complex data flow and platform concepts in clear, decision‑ready narratives. 
Help align stakeholders across domains by grounding conversations in data realities and trade‑offs. 

What are we looking for?

Required Qualifications

Experience as a Product Manager supporting Data Science, software applications, and/or AI projects

Experience with Agile delivery models and product management tooling (Aha, Rally, GitHub, etc.)
Demonstrated ability to manage complex product portfolios and cross team dependencies

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in US Healthcare Payer domain (claims, eligibility, care management, provider data, analytics, etc.)

Experience establishing responsible AI or model governance practices
Hands-on familiarity with GenAI delivery patterns: RAG and grounding, agent frameworks, prompt and model evaluation, guardrails, and inference cost management

Familiarity with cloud platforms such as Azure or AWS and modern data platforms
Familiarity with regulated environments and compliance driven product delivery

At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.

We are looking for an Associate Product Manager to lead our responses to RFIs, RFPs, EOIs and tenders, and to shape the mission solutions behind them. You will own each bid from qualification to submission, making sure it is technically sound, compliant, commercially credible and on time. 
The focus is space and satellite missions, along with ground segment, satellite data and adjacent aerospace work. Mission design and systems engineering skills matter most: you should be able to turn customer needs into a workable mission concept, run first-cut analysis yourself and explain it clearly. You will work across customers, engineering, product, management and leadership.

Key Responsibilities
Run first-cut mission analysis (coverage, revisit, access, ground contacts, lifetime) in STK, GMAT, Orekit or Python, verify it and script repetitive tasks. 
Track opportunities in the space domain and recommend bid/no-bid decisions. 
Run the proposal process end to end: bid plan, compliance matrix, RFI, RFPs, reviews, pricing inputs and submission. 
Translate customer requirements into a mission concept covering objectives, payload (EO, SAR, communications, IoT), orbit and constellation, ground segment and data products. 
Prepare system budgets, trade studies, architectures, ConOps and traceability, plus cost, schedule and risk estimates with engineering and finance. 
Write technical volumes, executive summaries and white papers, backed by clear diagrams and coverage visuals. 
Maintain the proposal library and handle clarifications and post-submission queries. 



Requirements

Qualifications 
Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Aerospace, Electronics/Communication, Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, Physics or a related field. 
At least 2 years in mission solutions, systems engineering, proposal management or technical product management in space, aerospace or defence, including hands-on RFI/RFP/tender responses. 
Working knowledge of mission design: orbital mechanics, orbit selection, coverage and revisit, payloads, link budgets and ground segment architecture. 
Solid systems engineering grounding: requirements flow-down, architecture, interfaces, trade studies, system budgets and verification. 
Hands-on use of STK, GMAT or Orekit, and enough Python to write analysis scripts and plot results. 
Clear, concise technical writing, the organisation to run parallel bids against hard deadlines, and confidence presenting to customers and leadership. 
Good To Have 
MATLAB; familiarity with ECSS, NASA SE Handbook or INCOSE practices and MBSE tools (SysML, Cameo, Capella). 
Experience with government, defence or space agency procurement and tender portals. 
Shipley, APMP or equivalent proposal training. 
Understanding of costing, pricing and contract terms for space or technology work. 
Exposure to downstream applications (satellite data, analytics, ground station services) or to product management. 



Benefits

The chance to shape space missions from concept to contract award, working directly with customers and leadership. 
A multidisciplinary team across systems, payload, platform, ground segment, software and business development. 
Fair compensation will be provided as per market standards. 
Experience rapid growth and start-up culture. 
Open to exploring, discussing and implementing new ideas and processes.

jobs.sourceTitle: Senior Product Manager – Activation & Onboarding, Commerce
jobs.descriptionHtmlOrText:
About Wingify
Wingify is building an Agentic Experience Optimization Platform that brings experimentation, personalization, behavioral insights, commerce optimization, feature management, and customer engagement together on a shared data foundation.
At the heart of the platform is Wingz, our intelligence engine that continuously understands customer behavior, decides what is most relevant, acts in the moment, and learns from the outcome.
Within our Commerce Product Tribe, activation is where this journey begins.
Our enterprise customers have complex, heterogeneous product catalogs and data sources. Getting them live requires connecting these systems, structuring their data, and making the setup simple enough that increasingly AI—not manual configuration—does the heavy lifting.
That's where you come in.

The Role
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager – Activation & Onboarding to own the journey from signed contract to first measurable customer value for our Commerce products.
You will own the product experience and roadmap across technical integration, catalog onboarding, data structuring, configuration, and activation. Your goal is simple: make it dramatically faster and easier for enterprise customers to get live and see value.
This is an impact-driven role. Success isn't measured by how many features you ship, but by whether you improve metrics such as:
Time to first value
Activation and onboarding completion rates
Catalog integration success
Drop-off at different onboarding stages
Data quality and integration reliability
Support effort required to get customers live

You'll work closely with Engineering, Data, GTM, CSM, TSM and TSE teams, as well as directly with enterprise customers and their technical teams.
You'll also have a significant opportunity to use AI and automation to rethink how enterprise onboarding works—from catalog mapping and configuration to troubleshooting and error resolution.

What You'll Own
Own the activation and onboarding product roadmap end-to-end, from customer kickoff through first live recommendation and measurable value.
Define and track activation KPIs including time-to-value, activation rate, integration completion, catalog health and onboarding drop-offs.
Partner with Engineering and Data teams on API integrations, catalog/feed ingestion, data schemas and integration architecture across sources such as BigQuery, feeds and direct APIs.
Identify and remove friction across catalog connection, data mapping, structuring, validation, synchronization and error handling.
Simplify technical onboarding for both technical and non-technical users through better UX, automation and self-service experiences.
Explore and ship AI-powered capabilities such as automatic catalog structure detection, AI-assisted field mapping, natural-language configuration, intelligent defaults and proactive integration troubleshooting.
Conduct structured discovery with customers, CSMs, TSMs and TSEs to understand where onboarding breaks down and quantify the impact of solving those problems.
Translate the needs of international enterprise customers—including multi-market, multi-catalog and non-standard data structures—into clear product requirements and evaluation criteria.
Own experimentation and continuous improvement of onboarding flows through instrumentation, funnel analysis and customer feedback.
Monitor integration reliability, data quality and activation performance, and proactively address regressions.
Clearly communicate product capabilities, limitations and AI-driven automation to customers and internal stakeholders, building confidence and trust in the experience.

What We're Looking For
4–8 years of Product Management experience, ideally building integration, activation/onboarding or data-intensive B2B products.
Experience working with products involving APIs, data pipelines, product catalogs, feeds, search, recommendations or personalization.
Proven experience shipping products that simplify technical onboarding or enterprise integrations, preferably in a B2B SaaS environment.
Strong ability to work with Engineering and Data teams on topics such as APIs, data schemas, catalog/feed formats and integration architecture.
You don't need to be an engineer, but you should be technically curious, comfortable going deep, and able to challenge technical trade-offs from a customer and business perspective.
A genuine interest in using AI to reduce product friction and automate workflows, with good judgment about where automation creates value and where human control is still important.
E-commerce or retail experience is a strong plus, particularly with product catalogs, feeds, merchandising, search, recommendations or personalization.
Experience working with international, multi-market or multi-language products is a plus.
Excellent written and verbal English communication skills are required.
French is a plus.

What Great Looks Like
Product Craft
You can take an ambiguous integration or onboarding problem and turn it into a clear, outcome-driven product roadmap.
You understand that AI is a means to remove friction, not the product objective itself.
You can work effectively with Engineering and Data teams on complex technical problems without needing to be the deepest technical expert in the room.
You have strong product intuition for what makes an integration genuinely easy—not just easy in a demo.

Discovery & Execution
You use a combination of customer interviews, funnel data, product analytics and operational insights to identify the highest-impact problems.
You can translate customer pain points into clear product requirements and measurable outcomes.
You drive execution with clarity across product development, QA, experimentation, documentation and launch.
You continuously measure activation and time-to-value and use those insights to improve the onboarding journey.

Business & Stakeholder Management
You work effectively across GTM, Sales, CSM, TSM, TSE, Operations, Engineering and Data.
You can explain complex technical concepts in simple language to customers and business stakeholders.
You build trust by being clear about what the product—and its AI capabilities—can and cannot do.
You prioritize based on customer impact, activation outcomes and business value, rather than simply chasing new technology.

Autonomy & Mindset
You take ownership, make decisions and keep things moving in ambiguous environments.
You bring people along, challenge assumptions constructively and maintain a high bar for quality.
You are comfortable operating across international teams, cultures and time zones.
You combine rigor and ambition with a collaborative, low-ego approach.

Why This Role?
This is an opportunity to work on a high-impact product problem at the intersection of Product, AI, Data and Commerce.
You'll have the opportunity to fundamentally rethink how enterprise customers integrate complex product data and get value from a sophisticated commerce platform—moving from manual, technical onboarding toward an intelligent, AI-assisted activation experience.
If you're excited by complex product problems, enterprise customers, data-heavy systems and using AI to make products dramatically simpler, we'd love to hear from you.


Location: Fully Remote (Based in India)

About Us

HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.

To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently. Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our people 

With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our impact 

Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact.

We’re proud to be a part of that.Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

Role Overview

For most SMBs, a customer conversation is not merely a support interaction. It is where a lead is qualified, an appointment is booked, a customer question is resolved, a sale is advanced, or a relationship is lost. Businesses receive these conversations across SMS, email, WhatsApp, Facebook, Instagram, live chat, and other messaging channels. Customers expect immediate, accurate, and context-aware responses — but most SMB teams cannot monitor every channel around the clock. HighLevel's Conversation AI product is designed to close that gap.

Conversation AI enables businesses to deploy AI agents that can answer questions, nurture and qualify leads, collect structured information, book and manage appointments, trigger workflows, follow up with inactive contacts, route conversations between specialised agents, and hand interactions to humans when appropriate. The product supports multiple ways of building agents — from guided forms and configurable prompts to visual conversation flows and AI-assisted agent creation. It also includes knowledge retrieval, multi-channel deployment, agent actions, routing, testing, analytics, logs, permissions, reusable snapshots, and APIs for deployment at agency scale.

We are hiring a Principal Product Manager to define the next generation of this platform. This person will own the long-term product strategy for Conversation AI and establish the architecture, product principles, quality systems, operating metrics, and commercial model required to make AI agents dependable across millions of real customer interactions.

This is not a chatbot feature-management role. It is a senior individual-contributor product leadership role at the intersection of AI agents, CRM, messaging infrastructure, workflow automation, knowledge retrieval, appointment scheduling, analytics, developer platforms, and agency-led distribution. You will be expected to influence multiple product and engineering teams, make difficult platform-level trade-offs, and turn Conversation AI into one of the most valuable and trusted products in the HighLevel ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities 

Define and drive the long-term product vision, strategy, roadmap, and product architecture for HighLevel Conversation AI.
Own the complete Conversation AI system, including agent creation, prompts, knowledge, actions, visual flows, channel deployment, routing, testing, monitoring, permissions, templates, APIs, and lifecycle management.
Establish the product principles that determine when Conversation AI should answer, ask a clarifying question, take an action, transfer to another agent, follow up later, or hand the conversation to a human.
Develop a deep understanding of agencies, SMBs, multi-location businesses, and conversation-heavy industries such as home services, legal, dental, medical and wellness, real estate, insurance, automotive, fitness, and professional services.
Spend significant time reviewing real customer conversations, AI failures, support tickets, agent configurations, implementation challenges, and measurable customer outcomes.
Translate ambiguous customer and platform problems into clear strategic choices, product requirements, decision documents, system models, phased roadmaps, and measurable success criteria.
Partner closely with Engineering and AI leadership on LLM orchestration, model selection, context management, tool invocation, retrieval, re-ranking, latency, caching, reliability, evaluation, observability, data architecture, and cost.
Build a scalable evaluation framework covering grounded accuracy, action accuracy, instruction adherence, safety, escalation quality, conversation quality, and business outcomes.
Define testing and release standards for changes to models, prompts, retrieval systems, agent tools, routing logic, and conversation behaviour.
Partner with Design to simplify the entire agent lifecycle — discovery, creation, configuration, training, testing, deployment, debugging, optimisation, and reuse.
Create a coherent product experience across guided forms, prompt-based agents, flow-based agents, templates, snapshots, and Ask AI-assisted creation.
Improve integrations between Conversation AI and Contacts, Conversations, Calendars, Workflows, Opportunities, Payments, Knowledge Base, Custom Fields, Custom Objects, and Reporting.
Define the platform model for multiple agents, channel assignments, routing priorities, bot transfers, context preservation, and human handovers.
Develop robust observability and debugging experiences that show conversation context, model responses, retrieved knowledge, tool calls, action inputs and outputs, latency, errors, and execution timelines.
