Product Manager - NxtWave Academy

NxtWave | Hyderabad | Mon-Fri | Full-Time


About the Role


The Product Manager - NxtWave Academy owns the learning product: the experience that takes a student from enrolment through active learning to course completion. This is the product-side owner of the Academy's retention and engagement north star - the person who moves activation, weekly-active-learning, progression and in-journey drop-off through the product itself (features, nudges, personalization, AI-first learning tools). It is a hands-on, experimentation-first, AI-first role: you frame problems, separate assumption from evidence, and ship and read experiments rather than execute a pre-decided feature list.

What You'll Own


Learning Product & Funnel Ownership

  • Own and improve the in-product learner journey: activation -> active learning -> progression -> completion.
  • Define and track the Academy learning-product metric tree (activation, WAL, progression velocity, feature adoption, in-journey drop-off).
  • Diagnose drop-off with data before proposing a fix; instrument events and build the dashboards you rely on.

AI-First Product Delivery

  • Ship features leveraging LLMs, agents, retrieval and automation (adaptive practice, doubt-solving, recommendations); write clear PRDs/DRDs.
  • Partner with Engineering, Design and Data for fast, high-quality delivery; maintain backlog clarity across initiatives.

Experimentation & Prioritization

  • Run structured, hypothesis-driven experiments across the learning journey; read them honestly and kill bad bets.
  • Separate validated evidence from stakeholder assumption before committing engineering effort.
  • Prioritize a constrained roadmap and defend trade-offs.

Cross-Functional Alignment

  • Align Engineering, Design, Data, Curriculum and the Retention Head on a single prioritized roadmap.
  • Present recommendations - including 'no build' recommendations - to leadership with evidence.
  • Ensure learner privacy, data safety and ethical AI usage; own pre-launch QA and safe rollout.

What Success Looks Like

  • Improve new-learner activation rate (student reaches the first meaningful learning milestone) by an agreed % QoQ, owned end-to-end (hypothesis -> build -> measure -> iterate).
  • Reduce in-product drop-off at the weakest identified journey stage by an agreed % within 2 quarters of it being flagged.
  • Improve weekly-active-learner (WAL) rate and average course-progression velocity through product interventions (in-app nudges, streaks, resume-flows, personalization).
  • Ship statistically-sound product experiments every quarter across the learning journey, each with a documented hypothesis, result, and ship/kill/iterate decision.
  • Define, instrument, and own the Academy learning-product metric tree; every shipped initiative has a pre-defined success metric before engineering effort is committed.
  • Ship AI-first learning features (adaptive practice, doubt-solving, recommendations) that show measurable lift in progression or engagement for the targeted cohort.

Must-Have

  • Has owned a product surface end-to-end and can name an activation / engagement / retention / progression metric they personally moved, with a number.
  • Can walk through a real experiment: hypothesis, design, result, and the ship/kill/iterate decision it drove.
  • Comfortable doing their own funnel/cohort analysis (SQL or a product-analytics tool like Amplitude/Mixpanel).
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and multi-stakeholder pushback; can prioritize a constrained roadmap and defend the cuts.

Good-to-Have

  • EdTech / learning-science / gamification / subscription-growth experience - faster ramp on learner-journey mechanics.
  • Has built or briefed personalization / recommendation / adaptive-learning systems.
  • 0->1 product experience in an unstructured, low-process environment.

Location & Work Week

  • Hyderabad
  • MondayFriday (5 days)

Compensation

Fixed + annual variable + retention component. Final structure by level and experience.

jobs.sourceTitle: Technical Product Manager (Risk Adjustment) US Healthcare
jobs.descriptionHtmlOrText:
We are hiring a Technical Product Manager who can also operate as our Lead Business Analyst. This is a domain-heavy product role: we need someone who genuinely understands US encounter claims data, Medicare, Medicaid, ACA Lines of business, medical chart coding, and audit defence and who can convert that expertise into a product that engineers can build and customers will trust.

You will sit between US payer customers, clinical and coding subject matter experts, and an AI/data engineering team. You will own problem definition, requirements, data logic, and acceptance criteria for one or more product lines, and you will be accountable for whether what we ship is correct against CMS and HHS rules — not only whether it was delivered on time.

This is a hands-on role. You will write specifications, interrogate data, define validation logic, and sit in UAT. You will not be managing a team of BAs on day one, though you will set the standard the rest of the organisation follows.

What You Will Own

Product direction

  • Own the roadmap and backlog for an assigned product area (chart review AI, encounter/EDGE submissions, RAF analytics, or RADV audit readiness).
  • Translate CMS and HHS regulatory change — model version updates, submission deadlines, RADV protocol changes — into product decisions, sequencing, and release planning.
  • Define success measures for each feature (coder throughput, RAF accuracy, submission acceptance rates, audit defensibility) and track outcomes after release.
  • Partner with founders, sales, and implementation on customer discovery, demos, pilots, and beta feedback loops.

Requirements and domain logic

  • Elicit, document, and validate business and functional requirements for risk adjustment, HCC analytics, and submission workflows.
  • Write user stories, use cases, process flows, data mapping documents, business rules, and acceptance criteria that an engineer can build from without needing a second conversation.
  • Specify CMS-HCC model logic (including V24 and V28), HHS-HCC logic for ACA, RAF calculation, diagnosis eligibility, and filtering rules in enough detail to be implemented and tested.
  • Define file-level behaviour for X12 837 I/P/D, TA1, 999, 277CA, MAO-002, MAO-004, MMR, MOR, and ACA EDGE Server XML files including enrolment, medical, pharmacy, and supplemental diagnosis submissions.
  • Specify reconciliation logic that traces rejected, dropped, or failed records back to source claims, encounters, charts, and member data.

Technical partnership

  • Work directly with data and AI engineers on data models, pipeline behaviour, and edge cases; read and write SQL to validate what the platform actually produces.
  • Define evaluation criteria for AI outputs — code suggestion precision and recall, MEAT evidence quality, hallucination controls, human-in-the-loop review steps, and audit trail requirements.
  • Contribute to API and integration design for EHR, coding platform, and payer data exchange.
  • Own UAT planning and regression scenarios aligned to CMS model files, business rules, and real customer data conditions.

What We Are Looking For

Required

  • 6–12 years in US healthcare, including at least 3 years in a product management, product owner, or lead BA capacity on a healthcare data or SaaS product.
  • Deep working knowledge of risk adjustment for Medicare Advantage and/or ACA Marketplace: CMS-HCC and/or HHS-HCC models, RAF scoring, HCC mapping, and the diagnosis-to-payment relationship.
  • Strong command of healthcare claims data — ICD-10-CM, CPT/HCPCS, claim frequency codes, place of service, dates of service, provider and rendering identifiers, and the fields that determine diagnosis eligibility.
  • Practical experience with encounter data submission (RAPS/EDPS) or ACA EDGE server submissions, including response file handling and error resolution.
  • Demonstrated ability to write specifications that engineering teams can build from: business rules, data mappings, state transitions, and acceptance criteria.
  • SQL proficiency sufficient to profile data, reproduce defects, and validate calculations independently.
  • Comfortable in a startup environment — self-directed, proactive, and able to work with US stakeholders across time zones with strong written and spoken English.

Strongly preferred

  • Direct exposure to RADV or HHS-RADV audits — sampling, medical record retrieval, coder validation, discrepancy handling, or extrapolation methodology.
  • Experience shipping AI or NLP-enabled products, and defining how model output is measured, reviewed, and governed.
  • Background as a certified coder (CPC, CRC, CCS) or clinical documentation specialist, or close working experience with coding and CDI teams.
  • Prior work at a payer, risk adjustment vendor, or provider-side risk organisation.
  • Familiarity with HIPAA, PHI handling, and audit trail expectations in production systems.

What Success Looks Like

  • First 90 days: fluent in our data model and product lines; owning the backlog for one product area; requirements accepted by engineering with minimal rework.
  • Six months: shipped features that measurably improve coder throughput or submission acceptance rates; owning the CMS/HHS regulatory change pipeline into the product.
  • Twelve months: the reference point internally for risk adjustment logic, and a trusted voice in customer conversations alongside the founders.

Team Overview
The Managed File Transfer (MFT) team is responsible for delivering secure, scalable, and compliant data exchange capabilities that support critical business operations across TransUnion. MFT serves as a foundational platform enabling customers, partners, and internal teams to securely transfer and process data while meeting regulatory, security, and operational requirements.

The team is currently leading several strategic modernization initiatives, including large-scale customer migrations, cloud transformation, platform modernization, operational excellence improvements, and compliance-driven programs. Success requires close collaboration across Product, Engineering, Operations, Solution Consulting, Customer Success, Security, and Business stakeholders.

This role sits at the center of those efforts, helping translate business priorities into execution plans while ensuring successful delivery of customer-facing outcomes. This is not a traditional product management role. Success requires a unique combination of product management, program management, and project management disciplines. The ideal candidate can define priorities, drive execution, orchestrate complex initiatives, and hold teams accountable for commitments.

You will be responsible for leading cross-functional efforts that span multiple engineering teams, operational groups, customer-facing organizations, and external stakeholders. Role Overview:

PDI Technologies is looking for a Product Owner to help drive our mobile product roadmap from vision to delivery. This individual will take roadmap initiatives and solution briefs and break them down into clear, well-structured PRDs that our engineering teams can pick up and execute against — keeping delivery moving in a fast-paced, iterative environment.

This role sits within our broader Mobile Platform and Framework effort — the underlying solution that lets customers bring a highly customizable, flexible branded app to market — with expected primary focus on Mobile Engagement Manager (MEM), a web-based portal being built on top of the Mobile Platform that will let end customers modify, update, and change elements of their own mobile app themselves, backed by a full publishing engine. MEM is early in its build, so this is a chance to help shape a new product from the ground up alongside engineering and design. Exact scope of ownership across the Mobile Platform and MEM will be finalized as the team ramps up, and there is flexibility for this to evolve.

As a Product Owner, you are a critical member of an Agile development team, translating product strategy into high-quality, high-value features. You'll work closely with Agile engineering teams, Product Managers, customers, and business stakeholders to shape requirements for our consumer-facing mobile experiences. Prior experience in Product Management, Product Owner, or Business Analyst roles for a consumer-focused mobile app or platform/framework product is highly desired.

This role is expected to use AI tools and processes as a core part of how work gets done — accelerating requirements-gathering, documentation, and story breakdown so the team can move faster without sacrificing quality.

Key Responsibilities:
Stay aligned with and contribute to the product vision, roadmap, and priorities for Mobile Engagement Manager (MEM), with visibility into the broader Mobile Platform/Framework
Translate roadmap initiatives and solution briefs into detailed, engineering-ready PRDs and user stories
Help define and evolve requirements for MEM's publishing engine — how customers configure, preview, and push changes to their live mobile app
As needed, extend into Mobile Platform-level decisions (what should be configurable, extensible, or standardized across customers) as they intersect with MEM
Work closely with Support to understand and prioritize customer-reported issues affecting the mobile app and platform experience
Work closely with system users (customers, partners, consulting) to understand product needs and translate them into actionable user stories
Apply technical astuteness, attention to detail, and proactivity to drive closure and optimize development team throughput
Use AI-assisted tools and workflows to speed up requirements analysis, documentation, and backlog preparation
Serve as a product evangelist, particularly with Product Managers and Business teams, helping them understand platform best practices
Develop documentation for new mobile and MEM features, including UI mockups, process flows, and data sequence diagrams
Attend sprint planning meetings and work with the team to define sprint goals
Guide Agile teams in breaking down user stories and defining acceptance criteria
Ensure the product backlog is prioritized and properly balanced between new product work and maintenance
Collaborate with engineering during sprints to review output and answer questions about desired functionality and outcomes
Ensure the team has an appropriately groomed backlog ready for sprint planning; monitor ready stories vs. velocity
Conduct backlog refinement meetings, sprint reviews, and product demos
Manage the product backlog in ALM tools such as Jira or Azure DevOps
Author and publish product release notes and customer notifications
Own release planning for Mobile Platform and MEM initiatives
Qualifications:
Prior experience with consumer-facing mobile apps (iOS/Android) — writing requirements, PRDs, or user stories for a mobile product strongly preferred
Experience with platform, framework, or configurable/multi-tenant products is a strong plus, given the customizable nature of the Mobile Platform
Comfort defining requirements for a 0-to-1 product (like MEM) with evolving scope, including working with design on portal/UI workflows
Ability to break down ambiguous roadmap items and solution briefs into scoped, sequenced, engineering-ready PRDs
Familiarity with mobile-specific considerations (app store release processes, platform guidelines, mobile UX patterns) is a plus
Fluent with — or genuinely eager to learn — AI-assisted product workflows (e.g., using AI tools to accelerate PRD drafting, backlog refinement, research synthesis, and documentation) in order to move quickly in a fast-paced environment
2–5 years of experience as a Business Analyst, Product Manager, Product Owner, or similar role, including at least 2 years working as an Agile Product Owner
Highly motivated self-starter with a desire to help others, take action, and seek out resources to excel within the role
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts into non-technical terms and vice versa
Ability to work independently as a contributing member of a high-paced, focused team, managing multiple priorities and competing deadlines
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to work under pressure
Ability to socialize ideas and influence decisions without direct authority
Collaborative by nature, with a strong desire to dig in and learn independently and through asking questions
Comfortable partnering with and reporting to leadership based in the U.S., with strong cross-time-zone communication habits
Working knowledge of product and sprint backlog tracking, burn-down metrics, velocity, and work breakdown techniques
Solid understanding of Agile software development processes and principles
Bachelor’s degree in business, computer science, or equivalent work experience

Let’s be real: waiting for a health crisis to start taking care of your body is officially out. Proactive, specialist-led care is the new flex.

Welcome to MetaGO, where we are totally flipping the script on metabolic health and obesity in India. Kyunki scene ye hai, we want to change when India treats these issues, not just how.

Built by the OGs Varun Sheth, Zaheer Adenwala, and Kunal Kapoor—the same trio that scaled Ketto into a massive firm—MetaGO is rooted in one unapologetic truth: nobody should have to fight their biology alone.

Type 2 diabetes and heart disease do not just pop up overnight. They ghost you for years before turning into a full-blown crisis. We are here to intercept them in the talking stage, way before things get messy.

The Playbook

Faltu ka gyan nahi, just pure science.

Every MetaGO journey kicks off with a massive 35+ biomarker deep dive. From there, we bring in the heavy hitters—endocrinologists, cardiologists, and internal medicine experts—to craft a highly personalized roadmap.

Throw in GLP-1 therapies when clinically appropriate, killer fitness coaching, and track it all seamlessly on the MetaGO app. With absolute legends like Dr. Kaushal Patel leading our medical board, apna health scene poora sorted hai.

The Growth & Product Team

Where the GO of MetaGO happens!

This is the engine room. Yahan sirf hustle aur main character energy chalti hai. Everything a member, doctor, coach, or ops teammate touches is cooked up and owned right here.

You are not just shipping minor updates; you are building the entire ecosystem.

Here’s What You’ll Be Driving

• The AI Frontier: We are going full sci-fi. You will be building out next-level AI Health and Fitness Coaches, AI-driven sales flows, predictive AI alerts, content marketing, hyper-intelligent chatbots, human-like AI voice calls, and even tapping into AI video generation. Sab kuch smart, sab kuch next level.

• Omnichannel Tooling: Building the ultimate operating systems that make workflows totally makhan for every internal squad. You will own the CRM and tech for Acquisition, Sales, Customer Success and Support, Medical Operations, and Supply Chain Management.

• The MetaGO App: The daily companion keeping our members on track.

• The Meds Pipeline: The zero-friction logistics network getting meds from a prescription pad straight to a member’s doorstep.

• The Data Brain: The ultimate platform connecting every single consult, lab report, dose, and weigh-in.

What We’re Looking For

• Experience: Years are just a number. If you have worked in the right environment, you have what it takes. But yeah, we definitely want a strong product background.

• Leadership: You enjoy leading from the front and really value stakeholder relationships.

• Strategy: You can lay out a product vision and a multi-year strategy that gets everyone hyped to build.

• Execution: You know how to break down that big strategy into well-prioritized quarterly roadmaps and actually get things done.

• Data-Backed Decisions: You can ask the right questions and let the numbers guide your moves.

• Business Acumen: You are here to build a massive business, not just ship random product features.

• Technical Proficiency: You can sit with the engineering squad and actually influence the design and architecture.

• Fun Personality: People genuinely love working with you. Good vibes only.

• Superstar: That is exactly what we want you to become here at MetaGO.

Picture Abhi Baaki Hai, Mere Dost :)

Our current lineup covers medically supervised GLP-1 and non-GLP-1 programs, diagnostics, and coaching. But with the AI scale and massive product roadmap we are unlocking, honestly, picture abhi baaki hai mere dost :)

We are a fast-moving, high-energy crew that takes massive challenges head-on and owns them to the ground.

If you believe healthcare should start way before the panic sets in, and you want to build the tech that actually makes a dent, we need to talk.

Let’s build something epic together.

kAIgentic is building the intelligence layer for the world's most ambitious enterprises. Headquartered in Singapore with teams in India and Japan, our software platform helps large organizations evolve as fast as technology itself by turning the tacit know-how locked inside their people into safe, governed, AI-powered operations.

The hardest part of enterprise transformation is not strategy. It is execution. Institutional knowledge lives in people's heads, systems are fragmented, and risk tolerance is low. kAIgentic captures how work actually happens, designs better workflows, and runs them inside an intelligence layer that is observable, auditable, and engineered for the most regulated environments on earth. The outcome is an enterprise that continuously improves.

We are backed by SMBC Group as our founding partner and customer zero, and our platform is already being proven inside one of the most complex, regulated operating environments in the world. That means real problems, real data, and real production impact from Day 1.

You will own one significant part of our product estate end to end: strategy, requirements, delivery and adoption. You will also be kAIgentic’s experience lead across the platform. You will set the principles and patterns every product follows, and own the journeys that cross product boundaries.

Our users do hard, regulated work: confirming how a bank process really runs, redesigning it, and deciding what to automate. The job is not to make that work look simple. It is to remove the labour that shouldn’t be there, keep the expert judgment that should, and make human review mean something.

What You’ll Do

Define the UX vision that maximizes adoption and quantifiable value across the kAIgentic product suite.

Architect integrated experience roadmaps that reconcile enterprise governance, legacy workflows, and AI capabilities into seamless user journeys.

Influence senior leadership, customers, and engineering partners to align feature priorities with reduced cognitive load and heightened trust.

Represent kAIgentic in customer workshops and industry panels, extracting tacit knowledge that refines the product experience.

Define measurable adoption and impact metrics, linking user behavior to business outcomes and informing iterative improvement.

Architect the translation of market, regulatory, and workflow insights into clear product briefs and decision criteria.

Influence the adoption of AI-enhanced design and research tools within product teams, accelerating evidence-based iteration.

Own your product area

Set strategy, roadmap and requirements. Write the specs engineering builds from, and make the scope calls, including what to cut.

Run discovery with the people who do the work. These are experts in banking operations, risk and compliance, often in Japan, and often in situations where you cannot observe the work directly.

Define success measures that tie user behaviour to outcomes and quality, such as effort per confirmed process, rework and review quality, not adoption alone.

Lead experience across the platform

Set the experience principles and interaction patterns all products follow. These cover how the product shows confidence and uncertainty, when it asks a person for input, and how review and approval work. Hold the bar in design reviews.

Own the journeys that cross products, so that what a user confirms in one carries cleanly into the next.

Design human review that auditors and regulators would accept as meaningful, not a rubber stamp, and define how we measure that it is.

Design for mixed audiences in the same flow: experts who use the product once or twice, and analysts who work in it daily.

Prototype with AI tools quickly enough to test ideas with users in days, and raise the team’s practice to match.

What You’ll Bring

Proven expertise delivering UX-focused product strategy for large-enterprise AI solutions, with a track record of driving adoption and measurable value

Mastery of product discovery and delivery frameworks, including hypothesis-driven research, PRD authoring, and iterative validation.

Deep knowledge of enterprise workflow analysis, governance models, compliance constraints, and integration patterns.

Expertise in AI research fundamentals and the ability to translate model capabilities into user-centric features.

Strong capability in designing and evaluating user experiences that reduce cognitive load, clarify intent, and build trust.

Skilled at synthesizing market, regulatory, and customer insights into concise product briefs and strategic direction.

Exceptional judgment in balancing technical feasibility, security, and scalability with user value.

Clear, persuasive communication with senior stakeholders, engineering, and customers, both in writing and presentations.

A track record of owning both a product and its experience in enterprise software used for complex, high-stakes work.

Judgment to separate essential complexity from accidental complexity. You can show where you removed work and where you deliberately kept it.

Experience designing oversight of AI or automated decisions, including how model uncertainty and failure reach the user.

Strong skill at eliciting knowledge from domain experts. Experience in a regulated industry, with banking preferred.

Hands-on prototyping, including fluency with AI design and prototyping tools. AI-native velocity as a default mode of working

Clear writing: specs, decision briefs and principles that others can apply without you in the room.

Influence without authority across product managers, engineering and global stakeholders. Experience with Japanese enterprise clients is a plus.

Why join kAIgentic?

We are a global team of builders who thrive in ambiguity, care deeply about the customers we serve, and believe the intelligence layer is how enterprise work will be reshaped over the next decade. We are building the connective tissue that lets large companies operate with the speed of a startup and the trust of an institution.

We look for people who:

Combine technical excellence with genuine customer empathy.

Are entrepreneurial and energized by zero-to-one problems with no playbook.

Lead with ownership, integrity, and collaboration, not titles.

Want to help define a new category of enterprise AI, not just ship inside an existing one.

Working here means being surrounded by peers who challenge assumptions, celebrate progress, and build with both courage and care.

Life at kAIgentic

Intelligence layer at the core. You will be shaping the substrate that turns institutional knowledge into governed, production-grade operations. This is enterprise infrastructure with real consequences.

Innovation at enterprise scale. Startup velocity meets the depth, scale, and stakes of mission-critical, regulated environments. Both are non-negotiable.

Ownership from Day One. Your work directly shapes the product, the culture, and the outcomes our customers see.

Learning and growth. You will work alongside seasoned leaders from leading enterprises who have built and scaled global businesses.

A culture of trust. Psychological safety, transparent disagreement, and disciplined experimentation are how we operate, not slogans on a wall.

Global collaboration. Teams across Singapore, India, Japan, Europe, and the US, working as one.

A mission worth the effort. Building something the world has not seen before: anintelligence layer that helps enterprises continuously improve how they run.

About the Company

Elevate Now is a doctor-led clinical weight loss platform in India. It diagnoses the underlying drivers of weight gain, such as insulin resistance, inflammation and hormonal imbalances, and delivers personalised treatment under medical supervision through a fully online, subscription-based model. Every member is paired with a physician trained in obesity medicine and a dedicated health coach, supported by blood diagnostics and continuous glucose monitoring.

The company has onboarded over 30,000 paying members and is backed by Physis Capital, W Health Ventures, Narayana Health and other early-stage investors.

Role Summary

Doctors are at the centre of the Elevate Now model. The quality of every consult, prescription and follow-up depends on how well the tools around them work. As Product Manager for Doctor Experience, you will own the products that physicians use every day, making it faster and easier for them to review a member’s data, make sound clinical decisions and stay in sync with the health coach and care team.

Success looks like more consults handled per doctor without a drop in quality, less time spent on admin and documentation, higher doctor satisfaction and retention, and better member outcomes and adherence as a result.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

Own the roadmap for doctor-facing products, including the consult workflow, patient records and charts, prescriptions, follow-ups and care plans.
Spend regular time with physicians to observe how they work, understand their pain points, and turn what you learn into clear product requirements.
Bring member data such as blood diagnostics, CGM readings, symptoms and progress into a clean, usable view that supports faster clinical decisions.
Reduce friction and documentation time through smart defaults, templates, automation and, where appropriate, AI assistance.
Build tools that improve collaboration between doctors, health coaches and support teams, including handoffs, escalations and shared notes.
Work with the clinical leadership team to translate protocols and safety guardrails into product logic, such as prescription checks and flags for follow-up.
Define and track metrics such as consult duration, doctor utilisation, documentation time, follow-up completion rate and doctor NPS.
Partner with engineering, design and data teams to ship quickly, run experiments and iterate on feedback.
Write clear PRDs and prioritise based on clinical impact, doctor productivity and member outcomes.

Requirements (Must-Haves)

3+ years of experience as a Product Manager.
Hands-on experience building products for doctors or clinicians, for example telemedicine or consult platforms, EMR or clinic management tools, or clinical workflow products.
Experience gathering insight directly from doctors and clinical teams and turning it into shipped product.
Comfort with sensitive health data and an understanding of why privacy, consent and clinical safety shape product decisions.
Working comfort with data (SQL or analytics tools) to measure usage, efficiency and outcomes.
Clear written communication and strong stakeholder management, including with senior clinicians.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in healthtech, digital health or a subscription-based care model.
Exposure to chronic care, metabolic health, obesity medicine or endocrinology workflows.
Experience building with or evaluating AI tools in a clinical or documentation setting.
Familiarity with prescription workflows and the regulatory context for telemedicine in India.
Experience in an early-stage startup where scope is broad and processes are still being built.

Benefits

Why Join Elevate Now
Own a high-impact growth charter with direct visibility into business outcomes.
Work at the intersection of healthcare, product, and data, where growth improves access to medicines for real patients.
Collaborate closely with leadership, engineering, and operations in a fast-moving team.

Let’s be real: waiting for a health crisis to start taking care of your body is officially out. Proactive, specialist-led care is the new flex.

Welcome to MetaGO, where we are totally flipping the script on metabolic health and obesity in India. Kyunki scene ye hai, we want to change when India treats these issues, not just how.

Built by the OGs Varun Sheth, Zaheer Adenwala, and Kunal Kapoor—the same trio that scaled Ketto into a massive firm—MetaGO is rooted in one unapologetic truth: nobody should have to fight their biology alone.

Type 2 diabetes and heart disease do not just pop up overnight. They ghost you for years before turning into a full-blown crisis. We are here to intercept them in the talking stage, way before things get messy.

The Playbook
Faltu ka gyan nahi, just pure science.

Every MetaGO journey kicks off with a massive 35+ biomarker deep dive. From there, we bring in the heavy hitters—endocrinologists, cardiologists, and internal medicine experts—to craft a highly personalized roadmap.

Throw in GLP-1 therapies when clinically appropriate, killer fitness coaching, and track it all seamlessly on the MetaGO app. With absolute legends like Dr. Kaushal Patel leading our medical board, apna health scene poora sorted hai.

The Growth & Product Team
Where the GO of MetaGO happens!

This is the engine room. Yahan sirf hustle aur main character energy chalti hai. Everything a member, doctor, coach, or ops teammate touches is cooked up and owned right here.

You are not just shipping minor updates; you are building the entire ecosystem.

Here’s What You’ll Be Driving

The AI Frontier: We are going full sci-fi. You will be building out next-level AI Health and Fitness Coaches, AI-driven sales flows, predictive AI alerts, content marketing, hyper-intelligent chatbots, human-like AI voice calls, and even tapping into AI video generation. Sab kuch smart, sab kuch next level.
Omnichannel Tooling: Building the ultimate operating systems that make workflows totally makhan for every internal squad. You will own the CRM and tech for Acquisition, Sales, Customer Success and Support, Medical Operations, and Supply Chain Management.
The MetaGO App: The daily companion keeping our members on track.
The Meds Pipeline: The zero-friction logistics network getting meds from a prescription pad straight to a member’s doorstep.
The Data Brain: The ultimate platform connecting every single consult, lab report, dose, and weigh-in.

What We’re Looking For
Experience: Years are just a number. If you have worked in the right environment, you have what it takes. But yeah, we definitely want a strong product background.
Leadership: You enjoy leading from the front and really value stakeholder relationships.
Strategy: You can lay out a product vision and a multi-year strategy that gets everyone hyped to build.
Execution: You know how to break down that big strategy into well-prioritized quarterly roadmaps and actually get things done.
Data-Backed Decisions: You can ask the right questions and let the numbers guide your moves.
Business Acumen: You are here to build a massive business, not just ship random product features.
Technical Proficiency: You can sit with the engineering squad and actually influence the design and architecture.
Fun Personality: People genuinely love working with you. Good vibes only.
Superstar: That is exactly what we want you to become here at MetaGO.

Picture Abhi Baaki Hai, Mere Dost :)

Our current lineup covers medically supervised GLP-1 and non-GLP-1 programs, diagnostics, and coaching. But with the AI scale and massive product roadmap we are unlocking, honestly, picture abhi baaki hai mere dost :)

We are a fast-moving, high-energy crew that takes massive challenges head-on and owns them to the ground.

If you believe healthcare should start way before the panic sets in, and you want to build the tech that actually makes a dent, we need to talk.

Let’s build something epic together.

This role combines product strategy, technical understanding, roadmap execution, and cross-functional collaboration to deliver scalable, high-value software products.
The ideal candidate will have experience managing data-driven SaaS products, cloud-based platforms, identity solutions, or MarTech/AdTech ecosystems. You will own product roadmaps, manage backlogs, define success metrics, and collaborate with engineering, sales, marketing, and compliance teams to deliver products that meet business objectives and customer needs.

Product Ownership: Take end-to-end ownership of a product, sub-product, or defined capability, ensuring successful execution and continuous improvement.
Backlog Management: Own and prioritize product backlogs, user stories, functional requirements, and acceptance criteria.
Product Planning: Develop product plans and business cases focused on revenue growth, customer adoption, operational efficiency, and cost optimization.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with engineering, architecture, UX, sales, marketing, and other stakeholders to ensure effective product development and delivery.
Performance Management: Define and track quarterly OKRs, product KPIs, adoption metrics, availability, quality, customer satisfaction, and financial performance.
Product Launch & Adoption: Support go-to-market planning, product positioning, launch activities, and initiatives to drive customer adoption.
Data & Cloud Platforms: Work with technical teams to understand cloud-native architectures, data ecosystems, platform capabilities, and identity-related technologies.
Market & Competitive Research: Analyze market trends, customer feedback, competitive offerings, and emerging technologies to identify product opportunities.
Governance & Compliance: Collaborate with privacy, legal, security, and compliance teams to address data privacy, identity governance, and regulatory requirements.
Stakeholder Management: Communicate product priorities, progress, dependencies, risks, and trade-offs effectively; escalate strategic decisions and cross-product dependencies when required.
Mentorship: Provide guidance and informal mentorship to junior product team members and contribute to product management best practices.

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, or a related discipline.
8+ years of overall professional experience, with substantial experience in product management, product ownership, or technology product delivery.
Strong understanding of product management fundamentals, including roadmap planning, backlog prioritization, requirements gathering, and release planning.
Experience managing data products, enterprise software platforms, cloud-based applications, or SaaS solutions.
Practical knowledge of cloud and modern data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, AWS, or Microsoft Azure.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, with the ability to translate business needs into actionable product requirements.
Experience defining and monitoring product KPIs, OKRs, adoption metrics, and business outcomes.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management, presentation, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Ability to independently manage complex assignments, balance competing priorities, and drive execution across multiple teams.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in MarTech, AdTech, customer data platforms (CDPs), identity resolution, or data-driven SaaS products.
Familiarity with identity management, audience data, customer profiles, data enrichment, or data integration platforms.
Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments with distributed engineering and business teams.
Understanding of data privacy, consent management, regulatory compliance, and responsible data usage.
Exposure to product commercialization, go-to-market strategy, competitive analysis, and revenue optimization.

You combine product thinking with strong technical understanding of data and cloud platforms.
You can translate complex technical capabilities into clear product requirements and measurable business outcomes.
You take ownership, make data-informed decisions, and drive execution across cross-functional teams.
You are comfortable working in evolving product environments where customer needs, technology, and business priorities intersect.

You are accountable for the success of your product, partnering closely with design, engineering, and business stakeholders. You balance customer needs, business goals, and technical feasibility to ensure your product creates real value.

Understand the flight order lifecycle through research, data analysis, and feedback loops
Define the product vision, goals, and outcomes in alignment with the group and portfolio strategy to reduce risk to flights P&L. 
Research, troubleshoot, diagnose, and recommend solutions to complex business and technical problems.
Translate data insights and market trends into product opportunities

Continuously evaluate whether product initiatives are driving intended value

A strategic thinker capable of connecting business opportunities with technical execution across engineering and design teams.

Highly organized, self-directed, and focused on outcomes over output

interactions into ongoing, meaningful relationships. It is a product with real users, real traction, and a
roadmap far larger than the team currently chasing it. There is white space here that most PMs only

Description

The vision for Alexa is to be the world’s best personal assistant. Alexa Smart Properties enables enterprise customers to deploy Alexa in their managed properties like hotels, senior living homes, vacation rentals, hospitals, and more, transforming how businesses engage with their customers and streamline staff processes. We’re leveraging Generative AI to reimagine how hospitality, healthcare, senior living, and other verticals deliver magical experiences to their guests, patients, residents, and staff.

If you’re passionate about building enterprise-grade communication and device management solutions — while applying GenAI to solve hard, complex technical problems — then this role is for you. You will operate at the intersection of large language models, content management systems, third party integrations , and enterprise SaaS platforms to deliver delightful, scalable features for our B2B customers and their end users.

Come join us to invent the future of how millions of enterprise end users communicate and connect through Alexa-powered devices — and how businesses manage those experiences at scale.

Key job responsibilities

As a Senior Product Manager — Technical in Alexa Smart Properties, you will own and drive the product vision and execution for our enterprise staff personas to make it easy for staff to manage their content, get real time insights, and engage with their end customers. You will own our enterprise console and integrations with third party systems. You will manage how staff manage content in our enterprise console including menus, events, promotions, alerts, and contacts. You will create features to deliver staff real time insights - through intelligent real time events to analytics. You will also build out capabilities to track tickets, orders, and other tasks directly in our enterprise console.

With Alexa Smart Properties, you can also manage your content and end customer engagement using a third party system such as a property management system or resident engagement system. You will manage the roadmap of integrations we develop as well as improvements to accelerate integration speed and scale.

Across both pillars, you will use all means possible — including AI capabilities — to accelerate development cycles, enable faster learning, make better decisions, and unlock new forms of innovation. You will leverage GenAI to rapidly generate prototypes, specifications, and documentation to validate customer value propositions faster. You will deeply understand your product’s business context — market dynamics, competitive landscape, pricing strategy, and profitability drivers — and articulate how product decisions impact business outcomes.

You will define vision (PR/FAQ), problem statements, tenets, and strategy while owning roadmap and priorities. You will influence without authority, building alignment across teams with different priorities — engineering, science, design, finance, marketing, sales, legal, and operations. You will establish key performance indicators, drive feature adoption, and measure the health of your product and business, distinguishing between output metrics such as adoption and outcome metrics such as customer satisfaction and business impact. You will create buy-in for your vision across the Alexa organization and with external partners, and conduct or commission customer research, usability studies, and competitive analysis to identify best-of-breed benchmarks and understand market opportunities.

A day in the life

As a Sr. PMT in Alexa Smart Properties, rarely are two days the same. You are a business owner, the voice of the customer, and the point person for partner teams across communication and device management experiences.

On a daily basis, you will be working with enterprise customers to understand the needs of the staff persona - including needs to manage content, engagement with end customers, and get real-time insights. Your day could consist of writing PRFAQs and BRDs, building a prioritized roadmap, sprint planning/bug bashing, iterating on product decisions with Engineering teams, evaluating how GenAI and agentic systems can accelerate your roadmap, working with partners in business development, solution architects, legal, privacy, documentation, and more. You will think big to envision what’s next for enterprise communications, and exhibit “Learn and Be Curious” for different technologies — including emerging AI capabilities.

You will make informed trade-offs, build your own mockups and prototypes, define acceptance criteria, and participate in testing and validation. You’ll evaluate technical proposals for strengths and weaknesses — including extensibility, performance, and scalability — asking the right questions to identify risks before commitments are made. You’ll assess how AI capabilities can reshape product architectures, when autonomous agent patterns enhance versus complicate product design, and how to leverage GenAI to accelerate insight generation while applying critical judgment. You will use AI on a daily basis to increase your velocity and scale your impact.

You will meet with customers to understand our core strengths and weaknesses, synthesize feedback with business and service data, and drive decisions using sophisticated judgment when data is incomplete. People will look to you to solve problems, connect them with specialists, and hold the tension between business outcomes and customer value honestly.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree
Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
Experience managing technical products or online services
Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in using analytical tools, such as Tableau, Qlikview, QuickSight
Experience in building and driving adoption of new tools

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly analytical and user-centric Senior Product Manager to spearhead the strategic and behavioral evolution of our core search engine platform across web browsers. In this role, your primary mission is to convert massive top-of-funnel browsing traffic into meaningful, high-intent leads for our paid clients and advertisers, while simultaneously deepening daily user engagement.

Rather than a traditional transaction/payment engine, you will focus on booking capacity and intent fulfillment. This means defining and building frictionless, zero-payment booking loopssuch as reserving slots, scheduling appointments, or checking real-time availabilityeither through seamless third-party API integrations or native platform capabilities on Justdial. This role sits at the intersection of browser technology, consumer psychology, and lead-generation architecture.

Key Responsibilities

Lead Generation & Funnel Optimization: Design and execute a product roadmap aimed strictly at increasing user engagement and converting casual browser searchers into high-intent leads for advertisers.
Fulfillment & Booking Capabilities: Own the strategy and execution for zero-payment booking loops (e.g., appointment scheduling, slot reservations). Architect these experiences smoothly using both native systems and third-party partner integrations.
Browser Experience Ownership: Act as the internal expert on browser technology, optimizing site speed, discoverability, user paths, and interactive modules across all major web browsers.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Engineering, UX/UI Design, Marketing, and Business Development to translate user intent into highly scannable, engaging search results pages that prompt action.
Data & Intent Analytics: Move beyond surface-level clicks to analyze deeper behavioral signals. Utilize user data and search patterns to design algorithmic intent-matching and vendor response-time metrics.
Product Delivery: Translate business requirements into crisp PRDs (Product Requirement Documents) and technical logic, collaborating daily with engineering teams for on-time, high-quality Experience & Browser Depth:
6 to 7 years of product management experience, with a proven track record of successfully managing and optimizing high-volume, consumer-facing web or search products.
Deep experience working on browser platforms, with an intimate understanding of web technologies, browser performance limits, and user behaviors across different browsers.
Prior experience in search engine technology, lead-generation platforms, online directories, or high-traffic consumer internet spaces is a major plus.

Funnel Rigor & Lead Monetization Mindset

Exceptional data-driven mindset with strong analytical skills to map out user drop-offs and design hooks that capture intent earlier in the browsing journey.
Familiarity with building or managing performance metrics that benefit advertisers (e.g., lead quality, response speed tracking, etc).

Technical Empathy & Integration Skills

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field. An MBA or advanced degree is preferred.
Solid understanding of web architectures and API orchestrations (crucial for linking third-party booking systems natively into our browser interface) is a plus.

Communication & Strategic Execution

Excellent communication skills with the ability to clearly convey product vision to design and engineering teams, as well as business stakeholders.
Strategic mindset with the ability to think creatively, distill vague customer problems into clear UI/UX patterns, and drive initiatives from concept to launch.

Performance Indicators (Success Metrics)

Primary: High-Intent Lead Volume (Generated for paid clients), Search-to-Lead/Booking Conversion Rate, Browser-Based User Engagement & Retention.
Secondary: Partner API Success/Latency Rates, Booking Fulfillment Completion (Successful slot reservations), Lead Quality/Accuracy Scores.

Why Join Us

Joining Justdial Ltd means working on a product that impacts millions of users in India daily. Youll have the opportunity to re-engineer core search experiences on the web, design next-generation lead capture loops that directly impact the revenue of thousands of local businesses, and work alongside a talented, fast-paced team. We offer competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and a vibrant work culture that rewards ownership and creative execution.

About Refold AI 

Refold AI is the AI integration platform built for agents, made for modern SaaS companies that need to ship enterprise integrations at scale. We're reimagining integrations with AI agents that work like business consultants and integration engineers, building them 10x faster, in hours instead of days. The payoff: integrations stop being a bottleneck that costs you deals and burns margin, and become a growth engine. You win the enterprise deals that hinge on them, onboard faster, and scale without an army of consultants. 

We've grown rapidly, reaching seven-figure ARR and 30+ paying customers, powering the product and professional services teams at modern SaaS companies, from Incorta, Kantata, and Coupa to Highradius, Naehas, and OvationCXM.

Refold AI has raised $6.5M from world-class investors including Eniac Ventures (early investors in Airbnb & Uber), Tidal Ventures, and Better Capital.

What you'll do:

Where does automation earn trust, and where does a human still need to stay in the loop?
You will draw that line repeatedly, and the answer will keep changing. How do you price outcomes instead of usage, in an industry that has only ever paid for hours? You will own that question commercially and build the model around it. What does it mean for a platform to get smarter across customers without leaking what any one customer knows?
You will define what learning looks like at the system level.
How do ISV developers think about reliability when their customers depend on
integrations running without anyone watching? You will own that experience end to end.
When something breaks in production for an enterprise customer, who gets told, what do they see, and what can they do about it? You will design that judgment layer.

What we're looking for:

You have shipped something on your own. A side project, a tool, anything you took from zero to working. We are building systems with real complexity. We need someone who has felt the difference between a decision made in a doc and a decision made in code.
You are technically grounded. You do not write the code, but you understand the structure, the trade-offs, and the failure modes. When engineering says a change costs 40% more compute, you know what that means downstream.
You think in constraints. When you look at a feature request, the first question is what breaks if we build this, not what we could do with it. Edge cases are not polish. They are often the product.
You write, not deck. Specs, trade-off docs, design decisions. If you cannot write a crisp two-page spec, the feature is not ready to build.
You push back. If the scoping is underspecified, say so. If the deadline is not realistic, say so. Disagree clearly and commit once a decision is made

Experience

5+ years in product in the B2B software industry
At least 2 of those years on a platform, infrastructure, or developer tool.
Comfortable with distributed systems concepts: queues, retries, schema versioning, idempotency
Track record of shipping things that were actually hard, not feature additions on a stable roadmap
Degree from a top-tier institution, or hands-on product experience at a company known for building hard things. One or the other, not neither.

Razorpay is one of India’s leading full-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision - to simplify payments for Indian businesses - we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution.

Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.

From building AI-native agentic payments, to AI-assisted fraud detection and real-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners - including banks, networks, regulators - we are pioneering industry-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech

Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation - powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.

Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.

Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme - and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.

We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India & SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions - including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards-first UPI) - along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.

But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen - you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle - if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People > Pedigree - we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles - this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy & Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors, you’ll be part of a 3000+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.

What We Need

Data-native PM — you think in funnels, cohorts, and experiments before PRDs. You write SQL, build dashboards, and catch insights nobody asked you to find.
Hands-on with AI agents — you've actually built something with LLMs, not just read about them. Prompt engineering is table stakes.
Entrepreneur DNA — you've tried building something of your own (a startup, a side project, a 0→1 product) or you're a seasoned Growth PM who's operated across the full acquisition-to-revenue loop.
Business-grade judgment — you hold your own in revenue conversations, understand unit economics, and translate growth levers into P&L impact.


This is not a feature PM role. There's no stable roadmap someone hands you. You define problems, find levers, ship fast, and measure what matters.

What You'll Do -

Build Customer Empathy: PMs have to regularly meet and understand customer needs first-hand as well as stay on top of the customer pulse via secondary insights - both qualitative and quantitative.
Devise Strategy: Define both long-term strategy and quarterly roadmap to achieve the product vision and create impact.
Conceptualize new solutions: Product Conceptualization with a problem first, data-driven, and test & iterate approach. Ensures conceptualization from a platform and a long-term view. Ensures value-based prioritization of product initiatives.
Build products: Collaborate with Engineering and ecosystem players to build products that customers love. Produce high-quality product specifications and effectively prioritize and manage the scope of each product launch to deliver products and features on time.
Launch products: Draft and execute a go-to-market plan in conjunction with Product Marketing. Be the internal and external authority and advocate for your given area of focus.
Ecosystem collaboration: Self-starter to collaborate closely with ecosystem players to co-build products that don’t exist


Mandatory Qualifications

You are obsessed with users but grounded in business and data.
You have 6+ years of experience in product management with at least 2 years focused on growth or PLG initiatives.
You're hands-on, hungry, and thrive in fast-paced environments.
You have a strong command over product analytics and experimentation frameworks.
You understand technology deeply enough to work well with engineers, but your core superpower is thinking from a customer-first and business-first lens.
You think in systems, love solving root problems, and approach prioritization through impact and effort.
You’re structured in thinking, biased for action, and love taking ownership end-to-end.

Job Summary:

Lead and integrate a global operations capability supporting the lifecycle of healthcare products and procedure kits, from product and component setup through controlled changes, commercial enablement, inventory management and discontinuation. The role connects product information, technical documentation, supply chain execution and business analytics to improve product availability, data quality, turnaround time and financial outcomes.

The Senior Manager will lead through managers and team leaders, establish a common operating model across the combined teams, and partner with global Product Management, Supply Chain, Commercial, Quality and Regulatory, and Technology leaders. The mandate includes building specialist talent, delivering reliable operations, and converting analytics, automation and AI opportunities into measurable improvements.

Business scope

Kitting and lifecycle operations: new and revised kit setup, bill of materials maintenance, component changes, kit activation and closure, discontinued business, inventory disposition and lifecycle exceptions.
Product information and technical support: product master data, technical data sheets, labeling and instructions for use support, packaging information, translations, product cross references and controlled documentation.
Commercial and supply chain enablement: quotations and pricing support, vendor and sourcing administration, product availability and backorder insights, tender information and coordination across product divisions.
Analytics and transformation: business intelligence, product and component analysis, workflow automation, project governance, process standardization and capability expansion.

Responsibilities:

Product and lifecycle accountabilities

Kitting and lifecycle operations

Own service delivery for kit and component setup, bill of materials changes, revisions, activation and closure. Establish checks that keep approved product, quotation, packaging and system information consistent across handoffs.
Coordinate new, revised and discontinued business with Product Management, planning, manufacturing, purchasing and customer-facing teams. Manage dependencies, exceptions and escalation to protect continuity of supply.
Lead the operational response to excess, obsolete and expiring inventory, component shortages, revision runout and customer cancellations. Use analysis to recommend transfers, returns, purchase order actions or disposition for approval by the accountable business owner.

Product data and documentation

Establish ownership and quality controls for product attributes, descriptions, packaging hierarchies, images, component data and cross references. Resolve data defects at source and maintain consistency across product information and ERP systems.
Oversee technical data sheet creation and updates, labeling and artwork coordination, instructions for use documentation, translation workflows and document publication. Maintain version control, traceability and evidence of required reviews.
Strengthen controls for product changes, component discontinuations and related document updates so that approved changes reach the affected systems, users and downstream processes.

Technical and product development support

Lead the assigned support for supplier information, product specifications, sample review coordination, packaging study documentation and project milestones. Ensure requirements, acceptance criteria, dependencies and outstanding decisions are clearly documented.
Partner with Product Management, Quality and Regulatory specialists on technical reviews and change decisions. Exercise approval authority only within formally assigned responsibilities and approved procedures.

Commercial and supplier enablement

Oversee quotation and pricing administration, component cost and margin analysis, product replacement information, tender responses and product documentation requests. Ensure business recommendations use validated information and reach the authorized decision maker.
Direct assigned vendor setup, vendor data maintenance, purchasing support and pricing or invoice exception workflows. Improve coordination with Procurement, Finance and global commercial teams.
Improve availability and backorder support by connecting inventory, production schedules, component constraints and product alternatives. Ensure customer-facing responses reflect approved product information and reliable supply assumptions.

Transformation and leadership accountabilities

Business analytics and decision support

Build a prioritized analytics portfolio covering inventory exposure, expiry and obsolescence, component shortages, kit revisions, product availability, quotation economics, margin drivers and time to market.
Translate business questions into data requirements, agreed definitions and actionable dashboards. Challenge data quality, assumptions and analytical conclusions, and ensure insights lead to documented decisions and follow-up actions.

Automation and AI

Sponsor process simplification and automation using suitable tools such as Power Automate, Power Apps, Power BI, RPA and system integrations. Define requirements, controls, testing, adoption and support arrangements with Technology partners.
Develop AI use cases for extracting and validating product information, comparing document versions, assisting product cross referencing, summarizing exceptions and supporting stakeholder queries. Define evaluation criteria and human review for technical, quality and regulatory content.
Own the business case and benefits realization for each initiative. Establish a baseline, measure capacity released and improvements in quality or cycle time, and validate financial benefits with Finance while accounting for delivery and ongoing support costs.

People and capability leadership

Lead managers, team leaders, analysts and domain specialists across the combined portfolio. Define accountabilities, performance expectations, succession coverage and decision rights at each level.
Build specialist career paths in product lifecycle operations, product data, technical documentation, analytics and automation. Recruit and develop talent capable of taking on more complex global responsibilities.
Create a common culture of ownership, problem solving and continuous learning. Coach leaders through cha

Turn what creators actually do into a simpler product that asks them fewer questions
Write clear specs, and cut scope when the evidence says so
Track where Thommidhi is right and wrong, and decide what to fix first

Director (C15) - Head of Product and Engineering

About The Role

Are you a product engineering leader who excels at driving massive platform consolidations, leading high-performing global teams, and solving complex distributed systems challenges? Do you believe in solving complex problem through technology simplification and modernisation?

At Citi, we are executing a bold, multi-year technology modernisation strategy. A critical pillar of this transformation is the unification of our global compliance enterprise workflow and case management systems. As the Head of Product and Engineering, you will be the strategic engineering leader and product visionary responsible for driving the consolidation, modernisation, and scaling of our global compliance case management platforms.

In this dual-hatted role, you will:

Lead Global Case Management & Workflow Platforms: Direct a globally distributed engineering organisation tasked with building and scaling our unified, high-throughput enterprise workflow and decisioning platforms.

Serve as the India Site Lead: Act as the senior technology executive for our regional engineering hub in India, driving talent strategy, engineering culture, and operational excellence across the site.

This is a high-visibility, executive-level role reporting directly to the Managing Director, Global Head of Product and Engineering.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Strategy ,Platform Unification and Product Management
Drive Platform Consolidation: Define and execute the technical strategy to consolidate disparate legacy workflow and case management systems into a single, modern, global platform.
Architectural Modernization: Lead the transition of core platforms to a cloud-native, microservices-based, and event-driven architecture capable of processing millions of complex events daily with sub-second latency.
AI & Automation Integration: Partner with AI/ML research teams to embed intelligent routing, automated document processing, and machine learning-driven decision support systems into the core workflow engine.
Technical Governance: Establish and enforce robust architectural standards, API designs, and data schemas that ensure long-term platform extensibility and maintainability.
Product leadership: Thought leader and ability to wear the product hat. Ability to drive strategic product decision along with key stakeholders
Global Engineering Leadership & Execution
Manage Globally Distributed Teams: Lead, inspire, and scale a multi-disciplinary engineering organization(75+)
Foster Engineering Excellence: Establish rigorous standards for code quality, automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and comprehensive observability (monitoring, tracing, logging) to ensure 99.999% platform availability.
Operational & Financial Management: Oversee financial planning, resource allocation, vendor management, and operational budgets for your global engineering organisation.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Product Management, Operations, Risk, and senior business executives to align engineering roadmaps with business outcomes.
India Site Leadership
Site Strategy & Growth: Act as the senior executive and site lead for the regional engineering hub in India. Drive local talent acquisition, retention, and career development programs.
Culture & Collaboration: Build a vibrant, inclusive, and high-performance engineering culture that mirrors the best practices of top-tier product technology companies.
Local Governance: Ensure compliance with local regulations, operational standards, and corporate policies.

Our Target Tech Stack & Architecture

We are actively migrating our platforms to a modern, cloud-native stack:

Backend & Microservices: Go, Java (Spring Boot), Python, gRPC, REST APIs
Frontend & Workflows: React, Angular, TypeScript, Modern BPMN/Workflow Engines (e.g., Temporal, Camunda, Flowable)
Data & Event Streaming: Apache Kafka, Apache Spark, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Elasticsearch
Cloud & Infrastructure: Red Hat OpenShift, Kubernetes, AWS, Service Mesh (Istio)
AI/ML & Analytics: Multi-LLM integrations via secure internal gateways, Vector Databases, Python-based ML pipelines

What We’re Looking For (Qualifications)

Basic Qualifications:

Experience: 15+ years of professional software engineering experience, with 5+ years in an engineering leadership role (Director, Senior Engineering Manager, or equivalent) at Product-Engineering first setup
Platform Unification: Proven track record of successfully leading large-scale platform consolidations, legacy migrations, or enterprise-wide system unifications.
Distributed Systems: Deep expertise in designing and operating high-availability, low-latency, and highly secure distributed systems at massive scale.
Global Leadership: Experience managing globally distributed engineering teams of 80+ engineers, including direct management of engineering managers and principal architects.
Site Leadership: Proven experience leading a regional engineering site or hub, with a strong track record of building local talent pipelines and fostering a strong engineering culture.

Preferred Qualifications:

Domain Knowledge: Experience in compliance, sanctions, transaction risk, anti-money laundering (AML), fraud detection, or high-scale transactional risk systems is highly desirable but not mandatory. We value core engineering leadership and platform-building capabilities above specific domain experience.
Workflow & BPMN Expertise: Familiarity with modern workflow orchestration engines (e.g., Temporal, Camunda) and complex state-machine design.
Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.

Why Join Citi?

Unprecedented Scale & Impact: We secure and facilitate the global financial system. The platforms you unify will protect trillions of dollars in daily transactions from financial crime and regulatory risk.
True Autonomy: You will have the mandate, budget, and executive backing to make critical architectural and organizational decisions to achieve our platform unification goals.
Modern Developer Ecosystem: Leverage Citi's state-of-the-art internal developer platforms, including our secure GenAI gateway and modern serverless application frameworks, to accelerate delivery.

And many more reasons…
