jobs.descriptionHtmlOrText:
Fanatics Commerce is the global leader in licensed sports merchandise, operating a vertically integrated platform that designs, manufactures, and delivers officially licensed apparel, jerseys, headwear, and collectibles for major leagues, teams, and events worldwide. With more than 900 e-commerce sites and a global omnichannel presence across digital, in-venue, and retail, Fanatics Commerce reaches fans in over 180 countries and powers official fan experiences for many of the world's most iconic sports properties.

At Fanatics, we bring our BOLD Leadership Principles to life every day - building championship teams, obsessing over fans, acting with entrepreneurial speed, and delivering with a determined and relentless mindset.

As we continue to scale our global platform, the Staff Product Manager, AI Platform Control Plane will play a critical role in defining the strategy, governance, and scalable foundation for AI agents, tools, and applications across Fanatics Commerce.

Role Overview

Fanatics Commerce is building an AI platform to make it easier for teams to build, deploy, and scale AI-powered agents and tools across the organization, and the Staff Product Manager, AI Platform Control Plane owns the common capabilities that make this possible — registration, configuration, deployment, lifecycle management, security, governance, monitoring, and operation at scale. This role sits at the intersection of product, engineering, AI, security, and business needs, working as part of a globally distributed AI platform PM team alongside the AI Platform Adoption PM and the Business Solutions PM to create a continuous feedback loop between customer needs, business solutions, and platform evolution. The Staff Product Manager, AI Platform Control Plane delivers business and fan impact through BOLD leadership and execution excellence, leveraging data, automation, and AI-enabled insights.

How Will You Drive Impact

Success is measured by the ability to deliver results through BOLD capabilities and measurable outcomes.

Team & Leadership Impact (Build Championship Teams)

Cross-Functional Leadership

Partner with engineering, security, governance, legal and business stakeholders to translate organizational requirements into scalable platform capabilities, creating clarity and alignment without relying on formal authority.
Operate as a tightly connected system with the AI Platform Adoption PM and Business Solutions PM, ensuring clear ownership and strong collaboration across the platform PM team so that customer needs, solution patterns, and platform evolution continuously.
Establish the principles, product standards, and architectural guardrails that guide the evolution of the Control Plane in partnership with engineering leadership.

People Leadership

Create alignment across a broad range of technical and business stakeholders — product, engineering, security, governance — driving decisions through ambiguity and making difficult trade-offs with confidence and transparency.
Mentor and model platform product thinking by demonstrating how to turn complex infrastructure capabilities into coherent products that solve real customer problems.

Fan & Customer Impact (Obsessed with Fans)

Build a deep understanding of the developers and teams using the AI platform, distinguishing between individual feature requests and underlying needs that should shape reusable platform capabilities.
Own the experience for developers and technical teams interacting with the Control Plane, reducing complexity in configuring, deploying, operating, and troubleshooting AI applications.
Establish clear workflows, tooling, documentation, and self-service capabilities that enable teams to move AI solutions from experimentation into secure, governed, reliable production environments with decreasing effort and friction.
Use developer feedback and platform usage data to continuously improve the Control Plane experience, ensuring teams view it as an enabler rather than a constraint.

Innovation & Problem Solving (Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit)

Stay deeply informed about emerging AI infrastructure and agentic patterns — including agent runtimes, orchestration, tool calling, MCP-style systems, model gateways, evaluation, and observability — and translate that knowledge into practical platform capabilities and product strategy.
Identify common technical and product patterns that should become platform primitives rather than being implemented repeatedly by individual teams, building once and enabling reuse across multiple AI solutions.
Balance developer velocity with platform reliability, security, safety, and governance, making pragmatic architectural and product trade-offs as the platform evolves.
Build safety and governance capabilities directly into the platform rather than relying primarily on manual processes, defining requirements for guardrails, policy enforcement, auditability, monitoring, evaluation, and responsible AI controls.

Ownership & Execution (Determined & Relentless Mindset)

Define and own the product strategy and roadmap for the AI platform Control Plane, establishing platform abstractions and standards that allow teams to build AI solutions consistently without reinventing underlying capabilities for every use case.
Define how users, teams, agents, tools, models, and other AI resources are identified, owned, authenticated, authorized, and managed throughout their lifecycle, establishing clear ownership and accountability at scale.
Provide visibility into AI usage, behavior, performance, risks, and policy compliance, enabling appropriate human oversight and intervention for AI applications where required.
Track and drive success metrics including developer velocity, time to production, platform leverage, management and control maturity, safety and governance consistency, observability and reliability, and overall developer experience quality.

AI & DIGITAL CAPABILITY

We are building a future-ready organization. This role is expected to:

Apply AI and technology to improve efficiency, quality, and outcomes
Use data and digital tools to inform decisions and enhance performance
Demonstrate curiosity and adaptability in adopting new technologies and ways of working
Contribute to a culture of innovation and continuous improvement

Required Qualifications

CAPABILITIES & EXPERIENCE YOU BRING

Proven experience as a Staff-level or senior product manager owning platform, infrastructure, or developer tooling products, with a track record of defining strategy and delivering roadmaps in ambiguous, rapidly evolving environments.
Strong technical fluency in AI infrastructure, distributed systems, security, and platform architecture — credible enough to engage deeply with engineering on trade-offs, challenge assumptions, and make sound product decisions without needing to be the architect.
Demonstrated understanding of AI and agentic systems, including agent runtimes, orchestration, tool calling, model gateways, evaluation frameworks, and observability patterns relevant to production AI platforms.
Experience defining and building identity, access control, lifecycle management, and governance capabilities for complex technical platforms, with the ability to translate organizational security and compliance requirements into scalable product solutions.
Systems thinking ability — can design for the broader platform ecosystem (agents, models, tools, data, infrastructure, identity, security, governance, developer experience) rather than optimizing individual components in isolation.
Strong track record of influencing and aligning engineering, product, security, governance, and business stakeholders without formal authority, driving decisions through ambiguity and complexity.
Experience using customer and developer feedback, platform usage data, and solution patterns to continuously evolve platform strategy and prioritize a roadmap for maximum leverage and reuse.

WORK LOCATION

Hybrid: The

Company Overview

Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).

What you'll do

As a P5 Lead Product Manager Analyst AI for Marketing and Prospecting, you own Agent Use Case Definition & Business Outcomes by identifying high-impact business workflows. You define technically viable agent requirements and translate business problems into clearly defined agent capabilities feasible within the enterprise tech stack. For Applications Workflow Design & Orchestration, you define the end-to-end workflow an agent will perform across enterprise systems, specifying triggers, context, actions, and escalation paths. You handle Collaboration, Value measurement, and Continuous improvement by defining success metrics, tracking outcomes, and refining agent behaviors based on operational feedback. Finally, you manage Autonomous Boundaries and Safety by determining the extent of agent autonomy, defining guardrails, approval checkpoints, and the human-in-the-loop model.

This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the Director, Martech & Prospecting Applications.

Responsibility

Identify the highest-value problems for business development, sales and account executives where an agent can save time, reduce effort, and take useful action
Be very savvy with data, crunch the current state funnel metrics, and pipeline performances to determine the highest value use cases to agentify
Influence senior leaders and cross-functional teams on use cases we should automate, what to build first, and how to stay at the forefront of this space
Understand intent signals, prospecting signals, propensity scores, next best recommendations etc to determine the best execution strategies for prospecting
Evaluate rapidly new capabilities from model providers, tooling ecosystems, and internal platforms, and translate them into clear product bets
Build scrappy but convincing prototypes using available models, agent frameworks, tools, and lightweight interfaces to test usefulness, trust, and feasibility
Partner with engineering, ML, design, and platform teams to turn promising prototypes into scalable product experiences
Shape how memory, context, orchestration, permissions, and human handoff should work in prospecting journeys
Define safe patterns for agents that take action, including clear explanations, user approvals, visibility into what the agent is doing, and recovery paths when things go wrong
Establish success metrics, launch criteria, and learning loops for these experiences, balancing ambition with trust, reliability, latency, and cost

Job Designation

Hybrid: Employee divides their time between in-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in-office expectation)

Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.

What you bring

Basic

6+ years of product management experience, including meaningful work on AI/ML products, automation systems, developer tools, platforms, or other technically sophisticated products.
Hands-on builder mindset, with the ability to use model APIs, agent tooling, and simple code in Python or TypeScript/JavaScript to create or guide working prototypes
Proven track record of taking new product areas from ambiguous opportunity to strategy, prototype, launch, and measurable impact

Preferred

Experience building assistants, agents, copilots, or AI products that use tools to complete tasks
Familiarity with memory, tool calling, browser or computer use, voice, multimodal interaction, or agent orchestration
Background in software engineering, ML, data science, or a similarly technical field
Strong point of view on when an agent should act autonomously, when it should ask for permission, and how to keep users in controlStrong technical fluency and comfort working at the boundary of product and engineering and be able to reason about APIs, orchestration, data flows, permissions, latency, and failure modes
Strong judgment in trust-sensitive experiences, including transparency, control, privacy, and reliability
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to create clarity and alignment across senior cross-functional stakeholders
Strong Data Analysis, Data Science and engineering skills

Life at Docusign

Working here

Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.

We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you’ll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live.

Accommodation

About StanceBeam
StanceBeam is a Bengaluru-headquartered sports technology company. We built the world's first commercial smart cricket bat sensor and have since grown into a full performance-technology stack: sensors, ball tracking, computer vision, video analytics and an affordable Decision Review System. Our technology is deployed across India, Australia, New Zealand, South Africa, the United Kingdom and the United States, and our work has been recognised through the KPMG Game Changers Award, the Karnataka Government's Elevate100 programme and a granted patent portfolio.
About the role
You will be the product manager across StanceBeam's product portfolio: the mobile and tablet applications our players, coaches and operators use, the web platforms and administration tools behind them, and the sensor, ball-tracking and computer-vision systems that feed them. A significant part of the role is our international client engagements.
The product is a connected suite rather than a single app: consumer applications on iOS and Android, tablet applications used in live operational settings, web-based administration portals and websites, with integrations across hardware, access control, payments and analytics.Underneath that sit our sensors, ball tracking and computer vision.
You will work directly with the founders and directly with our clients. The founders will set direction and commercial priorities with you, and you will be working directly with international clients and product teams.
Why this role
Ownership of live products with real users, in facilities, academies and matches
A rare mix of software, hardware, AI, and computer vision in one portfolio.
International exposure: clients in the US, UK, Australia and the Gulf, overseas travel a few times a year, and work that spans time zones.
A small, senior team where the scope is as large as you can handle.
What you will do
Discovery and definition
Own the product backlog across the portfolio and keep it prioritised, current and understood by everyone who works from it.
Talk to the people who actually use the product. Separate what they ask for from the job they are trying to get done, and write up the difference.
Write PRDs, user stories and acceptance criteria that engineering and QA can build and test from, and a proper technical specification with a rollback plan for anything that touches firmware or devices.
Prioritise in a way you can defend, showing the reasoning and the trade-off, not just the ranking.
Where hardware meets software
Keep track of which app versions, firmware versions and hardware revisions work together, and plan releases accordingly.
Plan staged rollouts for firmware and model updates, with a kill switch and a rollback plan written before launch.
Take responsibility for the data pipeline from device to screen. Everything downstream is only as good as what comes in.
Plan around hardware lead times. A software fix ships in a sprint; a firmware or hardware change is measured in months, and sequencing around that is your job.
Where the physical world is involved, run structured pilots rather than live experiments, with defined cohorts and clear exit criteria.
Client-facing work
Be the day-to-day product contact for our clients' product and operations teams - for features, releases, defects and timelines.
Run weekly working sessions, sprint demos and release walkthroughs.
Capture incoming requests, diagnose the underlying business need, and turn them into considered proposals
Translate technical and hardware constraints into language the client can act on, and translate their operational reality back into requirements the team can build.
Protect the integrity of the platform. Know when a one-off request would fragment the product, and be able to say no while keeping the relationship intact.
Assess change requests for effort and timeline impact, present the trade-off clearly, and bring anything with commercial or contractual implications
Keep the client informed in writing: release notes, status summaries and decision logs, so nothing important lives only in someone's memory.
Delivery, quality and release
Run sprint planning, refinement and reviews with the engineering and QA leads, and keep the delivery plan realistic and current.
Coordinate acceptance testing with clients: prepare the scope, support them through it, triage findings and drive the agreed fix list to closure.
Own release readiness: release notes, environment checks, sign-off criteria and the go/no-go call. Flag risk before a date slips, not after.
Work with the technical lead on third-party integrations so partner and vendor commitments stay aligned with our release calendar.
Make a considered call on technical debt: when to accept it to hit a hardware-linked date, and when it is too risky to defer.
Contribute to operational readiness for each launch: standard operating procedures, administrator playbooks, training material and support documentation.
What we are looking for
Essential
6 to 10 years in product management, business analysis or a closely related role, with clear ownership of a backlog and written specifications.
Direct client-facing experience. You have run meetings with a client, taken difficult questions and been trusted to represent your company without supervision.
Hands-on experience with a product where software meets the physical world: hardware and firmware, sensors or IoT, computer vision, embedded systems or similar. You personally owned part of it rather than sitting next to the team that did.
Experience across more than one platform, for example a consumer app alongside an internal or administrative system.
Comfort working closely with engineers: you can read an API contract or a technical specification, understand why something is hard, and question an estimate without being adversarial.
Agile delivery in practice, sprint planning through to release, not just as a certification.
Confident use of AI tools in your day-to-day work, drafting, synthesising feedback and analysis, with the judgement to know when the output is wrong.
Comfort with ambiguity and a start-up reality. You will often be the person who has to go and find the answer.
Desirable
A technical background: an engineering or computer science degree, or time spent as a developer, data or QA engineer before moving into product. We want someone who can hold their own in a technical discussion and read code when needed.
Interest in sport and sports technology. It is the domain we work in, and curiosity about it will make your product decisions better.
Experience with a product where a machine-learning or vision model was part of the user-facing behaviour.
Experience supporting international clients.
Familiarity with Jira or Azure Boards, Figma, Postman, and an analytics stack

Tech Product Manager at Aditya Birla Capital is characterized by a dynamic blend of technology, finance, customer focus, cross-functional collaboration, agile methodologies, and strategic business objectives. Success in this role requires a combination of technical expertise, industry knowledge, leadership skills, and a passion for delivering innovative solutions that drive value for customers and the business alike.

Security and Data Privacy: Given the sensitive nature of financial data, ensuring the security and privacy of customer information is paramount. Developing products that are secure and compliant with data protection regulations (such as GDPR or local data protection laws) while maintaining usability and functionality can be a significant challenge.

Technological Innovation: The financial services industry is rapidly evolving, driven by technological advancements, changing customer preferences, and competitive pressures. As a Tech Product Manager, staying abreast of emerging technologies (such as artificial intelligence, blockchain, or cloud computing) and leveraging them to drive innovation in products and services is essential to maintaining a competitive edge.

Integration and Legacy Systems: Aditya Birla Capital, like many large organizations, may have legacy systems and infrastructure in place. Integrating new technologies and products with existing systems while ensuring seamless operation and minimal disruption can be a complex undertaking.

Key Result Areas

KRA (Accountabilities) (Max 1325 Characters)Supporting Actions (Max 1325 Characters)

About The Insight Program

Who are we solving for?

We are solving for millions of adults in India, especially in rural communities, living with uncorrected presbyopia, a near-vision impairment affecting 1 in 3 people over 30. Without timely access to simple solutions like reading glasses, they face barriers to work and income, despite evidence showing such interventions can boost productivity by 34% and income by 20%.

What are we solving for?

Millions in India experience uncorrected presbyopia, a near-vision impairment affecting one in three people over 30, with cases now appearing as early as 35. Globally, presbyopia is the most common cause of vision impairment, impacting over 800 million people. In India alone, 300 million people live with this condition, contributing to $14 billion in lost productivity each year.

For many, especially in rural communities, clear near vision is essential for work and daily activities. Without access to timely solutions, individuals may face challenges in earning a livelihood. However, studies from Assam and Bangladesh show that a simple intervention - reading glasses - can increase productivity by 34% and boost income by 20%.

Despite the clear benefits, several factors have made it difficult for people to access reading glasses at scale.

With only one trained optometrist per 180,000 people, access to professional eye care remains a challenge in many areas.

Many individuals aren’t aware that their near-vision difficulties can be easily corrected, and some hesitate to wear glasses due to social and cultural perceptions.

Bringing reading glasses to remote and rural areas requires innovative and community-driven approaches to ensure affordability and reach.

Through the InSight Program, The/Nudge Institute is collaborating with central and state governments to make India presbyopia-free using a community-led model.

Role - Senior Product Manager, Fleet Management Systems (FMS)
Location - BLR/GGN

About the Role
Delhivery's freight network operates across thousands of vehicles, vendors, customers, and trips every day. Orion and our Fleet Management Systems sit at the center of this ecosystem—connecting demand creation, supply allocation, procurement, trip execution, tracking, documentation, and financial closure.
As Senior Product Manager for FMS, you will own products that make freight operations faster, more automated, and more efficient. You will work at the intersection of customers, operations, supply, engineering, data, and AI—simplifying complex workflows and progressively moving them from manual coordination to intelligent, system-driven execution.
This is a high-ownership role for someone who enjoys solving complicated operational problems and turning them into scalable products.

What You Will Do
Own the roadmap, not just the backlog — Define product strategy and roadmap across freight and fleet workflows from demand/indent creation and supply-demand matching to trip execution, tracking, documentation, and closure. Define clear business and product KPIs and own outcomes.
Automate operations using AI — Identify workflows currently dependent on calls, emails, WhatsApp, spreadsheets, or manual decision-making and redesign them using AI agents, workflow automation, and intelligent recommendations.
Go deep into freight operations — Understand how customers raise demand, how supply teams source vehicles, how vendors bid and allocate capacity, and how trips are executed on ground. Spend time with operations, vendors, drivers, and customers to understand where systems diverge from reality.
Drive measurable operational outcomes — Use data to identify bottlenecks and measure improvements in metrics such as turnaround time, automation/adoption, vehicle placement, tracking compliance, vendor performance, and operational productivity.
Build for scale and reliability — Partner closely with engineering and architecture teams to design systems that can handle complex workflows, integrations, real-time events, and large transaction volumes without creating operational fragility.
Drive execution across teams — Work closely with engineering, operations, supply, business, finance, and external partners. Navigate competing priorities, make trade-offs, and take initiatives from problem discovery through rollout and adoption.

What You Bring
4+ years of product management experience, preferably in logistics, supply chain, fleet management, marketplaces, B2B platforms, or a fast-paced internet company.
Strong product fundamentals with demonstrated ability to take ambiguous operational problems, structure them, quantify their impact, and translate them into scalable products.
Strong operational instinct—you are comfortable understanding workflows on the ground rather than designing products only from meeting rooms.
Hands-on SQL and data skills—you should be comfortable pulling and analysing your own data, building funnels, identifying failure patterns, and using data to challenge assumptions.
Practical fluency with modern AI tooling—LLMs, prompt engineering, agentic workflows, RAG, and AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar environments.
Strong systems thinking. You can reason across workflows involving customers, vendors, vehicles, drivers, payments, documents, APIs, and multiple internal systems rather than optimizing one screen in isolation.
Ability to influence across teams without relying on authority and to drive adoption after the product has shipped.

Why This Role
Freight operations have traditionally depended heavily on people coordinating through calls, messages, spreadsheets, and fragmented systems. At Delhivery's scale, the opportunity is to fundamentally change that.
FMS is evolving from a system that records freight operations into a platform that can increasingly understand demand, recommend decisions, automate coordination, and manage execution.
This role gives you the opportunity to build that transformation at scale—combining logistics, marketplaces, data, and AI to redefine how freight moves.

About The Team

Product Management in Meesho closely resembles our rocketship growth. Because we obsess over understanding customer behaviour, we’ve been able to carve out an e-commerce niche in Tier 2/3/4 towns in Bharat. Our business growth is testimony to a singular focus on how we think of ‘product’ for our unique customers - ones that have barely shopped online, but are now able to because of Meesho.

Fun fact: Nearly 7% of India’s households shop with us. 😉

We are driven by a ‘user-first’ mindset. We have a strong bias for action. Above all, our team is driven by impact, not features. We drive ‘problem discovery’ & delivery - not only obsess over “what to build”, but execute with rigour to create impact.

Position Overview

The Senior Product Owner is an experienced, functionally deep Workday professional who owns one or more Workday modules end-to-end on behalf of Revantage and its PortCos. This is not a passive coordination role — it is an active, hands-on domain mastery role. You are the subject-matter expert, the decision-maker, the stakeholder champion, and the product strategist for your assigned module(s). You will work across a complex multi-PortCo environment, running user forums, managing the release roadmap, driving adoption, and continuously finding ways to extract more value from the platform.

This role is specifically focused on Core HCM, Onboarding & Security. Additional module expertise is a plus. This role has a defined growth path: as the team matures, the Product Owner will take on line management responsibility for an Associate Product Owner, growing into a player-manager who both delivers and develops.

Key Responsibilities

Domain Ownership & Functional Mastery

Own your assigned Workday module(s): Core HCM, Security and Onbaording end-to-end — from strategy and design through configuration, testing, deployment, and ongoing optimization.
Develop and maintain deep functional expertise in your domain(s), staying current with Workday product updates, roadmap changes, and community best practices.
Serve as the primary point of contact and escalation resource for your module area across all PortCos.
Maintain comprehensive knowledge of how your module(s) interact with upstream and downstream systems and processes — and design solutions with those dependencies in mind.
Think beyond Workday: identify complementary or supplementary technologies that could enhance capability in your domain — whether that is AI-powered tools, third-party integrations, or adjacent platforms.

PortCo Engagement & Stakeholder Management

Build and maintain strong relationships with HR leaders, operations teams, and business stakeholders across multiple PortCos.
Act as a trusted advisor — understanding each PortCo's unique workforce model, business context, and HR priorities.
Run structured Product Owner forums, working groups, and user communities to surface requirements, share updates, and drive alignment.
Manage competing priorities across PortCos with transparency — communicating trade-offs, timelines, and decisions clearly to all stakeholders.
Facilitate requirements workshops and design sessions, translating business needs into clear, actionable Workday solutions.

Roadmap & Release Ownership

Own and maintain the product roadmap for your module(s) — balancing strategic enhancements, PortCo-driven requirements, bug fixes, and Workday release adoption.
Evaluate every Workday bi-annual release for impact and opportunity within your domain — leading opt-in decisions, testing, and rollout planning.
Prioritize the backlog in collaboration with stakeholders, the Functional Architect, and People Technology leadership.
Ensure all enhancements are delivered with appropriate change management, training, and communications to end users and HR teams.
Track and report on the delivery and benefit realization of roadmap initiatives.

Hands-On Delivery

Remain hands-on with Workday configuration in your module area — able to review, validate, and contribute to configuration work alongside the Associate Product Owner.
Lead user acceptance testing (UAT) for enhancements and releases within your domain.
Review and approve design documents, configuration specifications, and test plans before deployment.
Support the Associate Product Owner(s) in day-to-day delivery, providing guidance, review, and quality oversight.

Ecosystem & Innovation Thinking

Continuously evaluate the HR technology landscape for innovations relevant to your module area — e.g., AI in recruiting, manager effectiveness tools, payroll analytics.
Propose and build the business case for technology enhancements or new tool adoption where Workday alone does not fully meet business needs.
Collaborate with vendors (Workday, Paradox, HiredScore, Peakon, etc.) to stay ahead of product developments and advocate for Revantage's priorities.

Team Development

In the near term, work closely with and provide functional guidance to the Associate Product Owner(s) aligned to your module area.
As the team grows, take on formal line management responsibility for your Associate Product Owner — supporting their development, performance, and career growth.

Required Qualifications

5+ years of Workday functional experience with deep, hands-on expertise in at least two Workday modules.
Demonstrated experience owning a Workday module in a production environment — including enhancements, releases, stakeholder management, and roadmap ownership.
Experience working in a multi-entity, multi-PortCo, or shared-services HR technology model.
Strong understanding of Workday business process configuration, security roles, reporting, and calculated fields.
Proven ability to engage and influence senior HR stakeholders without direct authority.
Experience running forums, steering committees, or user communities across a distributed stakeholder base.
Global Workday implementation or support experience — able to navigate multi-jurisdiction complexity.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills — able to translate technical concepts for business audiences and vice versa.

Module-specific Experience (by Role)

Depending on the specific Product Owner role, candidates should bring deep expertise in one or more of the following clusters:

Core HCM, Onboarding & Workday Help: Org design, job architecture, business process configuration, worker data, Workday Help case management.
Compensation & Advanced Compensation: Salary structures, merit and bonus plans, compensation cycles, equity, allowances, and global pay practices.
Recruiting, Paradox & HiredScore: Recruiting business processes, offer management, candidate experience, AI screening tools, and sourcing integrations.
Talent & Learning: Performance reviews, goal management, succession planning, learning campaigns, content management, and skills framework.
US Benefits & US Payroll: Open enrollment, benefit plans, ACA compliance, payroll processing, tax configuration, and off-cycle runs.
People Analytics & Peakon: Workday Prism Analytics, dashboards, engagement survey design, action planning, and People Analytics storytelling.

Preferred Qualifications

Workday Pro certification in one or more relevant modules.
Experience with third-party HR technology integrations and vendor management.
Exposure to change management methodologies and communication planning.
Prior experience in private equity, financial services, or multi-company real estate environments.
Familiarity with Agile or product management frameworks (backlog management, sprint planning, road mapping tools).

About Revantage

Revantage is a Blackstone portfolio company and a leading provider of corporate services across Blackstone's Real Estate portfolio. Headquartered in Chicago, Revantage supports a diverse and complex ecosystem of portfolio companies (PortCos) spanning residential, commercial, logistics, hospitality, and life-sciences real estate globally — across North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific.

Our People Technology team sits at the centre of this multi-entity, multi-jurisdictional operating model. We run a single Workday tenant that serves a federated landscape of PortCos, each with its own workforce, HR policies, compensation structures, payroll requirements, and compliance obligations. Flutter Entertainment is listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE). We’re proud to be recognized by TIME as one of the World’s Best Companies 2025 — a reflection of the passion and commitment of our colleagues across the globe.

Working at Flutter is a chance to work with a growing portfolio of brands across a range of opportunities. We will support you every step of the way to help you grow. Just like our brands, we ensure our people have everything they need to succeed.

FLUTTER ENTERTAINMENT INDIA 

Our office in the heart of Hi-Tech City , Hyderabad, serves as Flutter Entertainment’s Global Capability Center (GCC). Now home to 1,000+ talented colleagues, we are shaping the future of entertainment across critical areas such as Customer Support Operations, Data & Technology, Business Operations (Finance, HR, Procurement), and HR Tech & Analytics.

Our Values define us. They are - Build Better Together, Own Every Outcome, Stay Curious and Grow, and Raise the Bar Everyday. 

They're how we collaborate, grow, lead, and show up for each other, every single day.

With ambitious growth plans for the future and the global and local scale to achieve them, we continue to serve our customers and care for our communities with the talent and passion of our colleagues .

Overview Of The Role

Join our team as a Data Product Owner, where you'll deliver transformative product enhancements.

Your role consists of being the main interaction point between Product and Technology for our first in-house Data Squad. Using lean and agile techniques, you will be responsible for delivering business value, fast.

Reporting to the Lead Product Owner, you will bridge technical and business worlds as you continually deliver improvements and innovative features across the full range of our Data Platforms.

You will have a bias for action and can break down complex problems into steps that drive the product experience.

Your exceptional communication skills will be key, adapting to a high paced environment and constant interactions with a diverse group of stakeholders.

Responsibilities

Product Owner Responsibilities 

Understanding product/commercial needs and how these are translated into functional and technical requirements. 
Leading requirements gathering effort based on stakeholders' input. 
Being accountable for the timely availability and accuracy of requirements for projects, ensuring the engineering teams can develop software as efficiently as possible. 
Writing user stories with acceptance criteria, grooming and prioritizing backlogs, producing release plans and communications, running show and tells, and tracking benefits realisation. 
Attending all scrum/relevant ceremonies. 
Adapting product backlogs as appropriate to meet changing needs and requirements. 
Consistently communicating with stakeholders and keeping them informed of the status of requirements development. 
Understanding and balancing commercial needs against technical requirements and capabilities. 
Understanding the dependencies between technology components and how they combine to deliver solutions to the end consumer and to the business. 
Managing cross-team product dependencies. 
Having a detailed understanding of the portfolio, project & feature delivery processes. 
Being a subject matter expert in their domain and have a solid understanding of company organisation and performance. 
Contributing to operational readiness processes for new releases and provides product training to stakeholders. 
Ensuring that all solutions meet company-wide, ‘hygiene' requirements in terms of non-functional performance, security, compliance, social responsibility. 
Where appropriate, co-ordinate with 3rd party technology providers to ensure timely and quality delivery/integration of external product features as specified. 

TO EXCEL IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL NEED TO HAVE 

Proven experience in a similar role. 
Knowledge & experience of working with Data Products and Platforms. 
Excellent written and verbal communication skills. 
Experience in defining business requirements. 
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. 
Knowledge of techniques for requirements elicitation and specification. 
Ability to relate to both business, design, and technical specialists. 
Superb attention to detail. 
Strong relationship management skills. 
Experience in working across multiple Agile methodologies. 

We'd Like You To Master In 

Experience working in a multi-product environment. 
Knowledge of the Sports betting business. 
Drive for results and an action-oriented approach, pursuing work with energy and drive. 
Customer focus profile, building and delivering solutions that meet customer expectations. 
Credible and efficient communication across a range of channels and audiences. 
Resilience and confidence under pressure, maintaining a positive attitude despite adversity. 
Cooperatively approach and partnership with others across the organisation. 

Benefits We Offer

Access to Learnerbly, Udemy , and a Self-Development Fund for upskilling. 
Career growth through Internal Mobility Programs . 
Comprehensive Health Insurance for you and dependents. 
Coverage of OPD Consultations and Full Body health checkup every year. 
Well-Being Fund and 24/7 Assistance Program for holistic wellness. 
Hybrid Model : 2 office days/week with flexible leave policies, including maternity, paternity, and sabbaticals. 
Free Meals, Cab Allowance , and a Home Office Setup Allowance. 
Employer PF Contribution , gratuity, Personal Accident & Life Insurance. 
Sharesave Plan to purchase discounted company shares. 
Volunteering Leave and Team Events to build connections. 
Recognition through the Kudos Platform and Referral Rewards . 

WHY CHOOSE US 

Flutter is an Equal Opportunity Employer and values the unique perspectives and experiences that everyone brings. We are committed to a fair and inclusive recruitment process where every candidate has an equal opportunity to succeed, with hiring decisions based on skills, experience and potential.

We have ambitious growth plans and goals for the future. Here's an opportunity for you to play a pivotal role in shaping the future of Flutter Entertainment India.

If you're passionate about this opportunity but don't meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply. Your skills, experiences and perspective could make you a great fit for our team.

Product Execution & Delivery

About Us

HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.

To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently. Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our people 

With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our impact 

Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.

Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

About The Role

HighLevel’s Commerce platform is the system of record for how our customers sell — what they offer and how it is priced, how orders get fulfilled, and how money moves: payments in, invoices out, and books that balance . It spans product information, pricing, taxes, and channels; fulfillment and inventory; and the full finance stack of payments, checkout, invoicing, and ledger — together powering commerce for a global base of agencies and businesses operating at scale.

We are seeking a Group Product Manager, Commerce , to lead product across three connected verticals — Business Operations, Fulfillment Operations, and Finance — and the team of Product Managers who own them. You will set the strategy for the end-to-end commerce lifecycle, from catalog to cash , and be accountable for the coherence, reliability, and growth of the platform as a whole.

The ideal candidate is an experienced product leader who has managed and grown other Product Managers , and who can zoom from platform strategy down to the details of a pricing engine, a fulfillment flow, or a ledger entry. You lead through your team, raise the bar on product craft , and turn a broad, interdependent surface area into a clear, sequenced roadmap.

Your mission: To build a coherent, reliable, and extensible commerce platform — spanning what customers sell, how it is fulfilled, and how they get paid — and to build the team that delivers it, so HighLevel’s customers can run their entire business on us.

What You’ll Do

Set Commerce Product Strategy – Own the vision and multi-quarter roadmap across Business Operations, Fulfillment, and Finance , translating a broad, interdependent surface area into clear, sequenced priorities.

Lead & Grow a Team of PMs – Manage, mentor, and hire Product Managers across the verticals, setting a high bar for product craft and owning their performance, development, and career growth .

Own the End-to-End Commerce Lifecycle – Be accountable for the full catalog-to-cash journey — product information and pricing, fulfillment and inventory, payments, invoicing, and ledger — as one connected system.

Drive Platform Coherence – Ensure shared contracts like the analytics engine, layouts, and reporting are designed once and reused, so the verticals compose into a single, consistent platform rather than a set of silos.

Deliver Business Operations – Guide the PIM, pricing, taxes, channel configuration, loyalty, and analytics roadmap that lets merchants define what they sell, to whom, and at what price.

Deliver Fulfillment Operations – Steer fulfillment, inventory, and the upcoming warehousing, time-clocking, and metering charters so what was sold reliably reaches the buyer.

Deliver Finance – Own the payments, checkout, invoicing, and ledger/accounting roadmap, ensuring money moves securely and the books balance across providers and external systems like QuickBooks and Xero.

Own Outcomes & Metrics – Drive measurable growth in GMV, transaction success, merchant adoption, and reliability , using data to prioritize across a large and competing set of bets.

Partner with Senior Stakeholders – Work closely with engineering, design, finance, operations, and leadership to align on strategy, resourcing, and trade-offs, and represent Commerce in company-level planning.

Balance Delivery & Long-Term Bets – Keep near-term charters shipping on time while investing in the platform foundations that compound over the next several years .

Raise the Operating Bar – Establish the rituals, specs, and quality standards — discovery, prioritization, launch, and review — that make the team predictable, fast, and outcome-driven .

Who You Are

Experienced People Leader – You have managed and grown Product Managers, and you get energy from multiplying your impact through a strong, well-run team .

Platform & Commerce Depth – You have led product across commerce, payments, fintech, or a comparable transaction-heavy platform , and understand how catalog, fulfillment, and finance fit together.

Strategic and Execution-Focused – You can define a multi-vertical strategy and still hold your teams to crisp execution , ensuring ideas translate into shipped, measurable impact.

Systems Thinker – You see the interdependencies across modules and design for coherence, reuse, and shared contracts rather than one-off solutions.

Outcome- & Customer-Centric – You balance business goals, risk, and trust, keeping the merchants who run their business on the platform at the center of every decision.

Highly Data-Driven in Ambiguity – You are comfortable prioritizing across a broad, messy portfolio, using data to make sharp trade-offs without waiting for perfect information.

What You’ll Bring

8+ years of Product Management experience , including 2+ years directly managing Product Managers , and 10+ years of total professional experience. 
A track record of leading product across a large, multi-team surface area — ideally in commerce, payments, fintech, or platform/SaaS — with measurable business impact. 
Proven people leadership : hiring, developing, and retaining strong PMs, and building the operating rhythm of a high-performing product team. 
Strong platform and systems judgment , with the ability to reason about how pricing, fulfillment, payments, invoicing, and ledger interconnect . 
Experience partnering with senior engineering, design, and business stakeholders to set strategy, secure resourcing, and drive company-level outcomes. 

Bonus: 

You have owned a commerce or payments platform end-to-end — from catalog to cash — at significant scale , and can clearly articulate your impact on growth, reliability, and team development. 

Why should you join us? 

At HighLevel, we foster an exciting and dynamic work environment driven by a passionate team. We believe in a collective responsibility where no task is considered someone else's job. Our unwavering focus is on providing value to our users, and we achieve this by delivering solutions swiftly through lean principles, allowing us to bring products to market in a matter of weeks rather than quarters. Every good idea is put to the test, ensuring that we maintain a high standard of innovation. We prioritise the well-being of our team, recognizing that by taking care of them, they can better serve our users. We embrace the

Job Summary: As Senior Director - Product for JAMS (JioStar AI Media Studio), you will own the product vision, roadmap, and execution for JioStar's generative video platform - the platform that lets us produce production-grade AI-generated video content at scale, across Microdramas, content promos, marketing creatives, and AI avatars. You will define what gets built, for whom, and in what sequence, partnering with Engineering, Microdrama Teams, Marketing, Content Teams & leadership to take use cases from pilots to scaled production-ready content, and build this in a platformised way that enables us to unlock multiple use-cases at a time. About the team: JAMS is JioHotstar's AI-native media production platform built to enable content creators to tell stories that were not possible to be told before, at a fraction of the cost it might have taken earlier. We leverage frontier generative models, integrated into our homegrown platform that enables the entire script -> video journey for creators. The eventual goal is to support multiple use-cases, be it microdrama content generation, content promos, marketing creatives or avatar-led experiences, both interactive and pre-generated. You will be part of the JioHotstar Product Organisation and work directly with key stakeholders across Microdramas, GenAI Studio, Marketing, Sports, and Entertainment content teams to prioritize and scale what works. We are an AI native, agile & fast-moving team focused on turning bold ideas into impactful products. From rapid prototyping of new concepts to building scalable platforms that power future growth, we thrive on experimentation and innovation. As part of this team, you’ll work at the intersection of creativity and technology - building end-to-end experiences, experimenting with emerging tech, and shaping the future of entertainment content.

Key responsibilities:

Own the end-to-end product strategy for the JAMS generative video platform. Define what use cases are important to build (Microdrama, promos, avatars, and everything else), in what sequence, and why, grounded in business impact and platform readiness & what capabilities does the platform need to build to enable these use cases.
Translate ambiguous, frontier-tech capability (generative video, voice synthesis, character/knowledge grounding, real-time generation) into a sequenced product roadmap with clear pilot-to-scale gates per use case.
Drive cross-functional alignment with Microdramas, GenAI Studios, Marketing, Sports, and Entertainment content leadership on use-case prioritisation, and go-to-market sequencing.
Define and own the platform success framework (Scale, Quality, Speed, Cost) and the use-case-specific business metrics) — building the measurement rigor to prove or kill use cases honestly.
Partner with Engineering on platform architecture trade-offs and what's product-buildable vs. infrastructure-dependent across use cases.
Build a product team capable of operating at the pace of frontier generative AI - hire, mentor, and create the operating rhythm (goal-setting, roadmap tracking, execution cadence) across multiple concurrent use cases, building a high performance culture.
Meet, evaluate partners and build frameworks to evaluate how to partner / integrate them to unblock new capabilities / accelerate product roadmap for JAMS.

Skills and attributes for success:

Track record building 0-to-1 AI-native products. Bonus: If this spans generative media (video, voice, images).
Strong technical & AI fluency and being able to engage credibly with Engineering & Data Science Teams on generative model architecture, cost/latency trade-offs, and platform constraints.
Experience managing a multi-use-case product portfolio — sequencing and trading off investment across use cases at different maturity stages, rather than running a single roadmap.
Demonstrated ability to influence and align senior stakeholders on product roadmap and investment decisions.
Sharp product instinct & experience in building 0-to-1 platform products, experience defining and rigorously tracking product metrics across disparate use cases.
Track record building and leading lean product teams that deliver high outcomes.
Excellent written and verbal communication, ability to produce sharp strategy artifacts for both team-level execution and CXO-level review.

About Us Perched firmly at the nucleus of spellbinding content and innovative technology, JioStar is a leading global media & entertainment company that is reimagining the way audiences consume entertainment and sports. Its television network and streaming service together reach more than 750 million viewers every week, igniting the dreams and aspirations of hundreds of million people across geographies.

Why We Stand Out

Seeking a new challenge where your professional and personal aspirations are not only possible but supported? Kaufman Rossin might be just the place for you!

Kaufman Rossin Professional Services Private Limited's (the "Company") offices are located in the World Trade Center (WTC) in Bangalore, Karnataka, India, and at Udyog Vihar, in Gurgaon, Haryana, India.

The Bangalore office provides a range of services, including risk management, corporate governance, tax, assurance, and family office services. Out of the Gurgaon office, we render highly specialized back-office alternative investment services for global hedge funds and related fund types. As one of the top accounting firms in the US, our foundation is "people first". In the words of James Kaufman, one of our founders, "We prioritize our people, their development, and their well-being. Our values are translated into action every day."

Kaufman Rossin, headquartered in Miami, Florida has been celebrated as the Best Place to Work in South Florida more than a dozen times. The firm has grown to over 700 employees, with offices spanning the tri-county area and sister entities, Kaufman Rossin Wealth and Kaufman Rossin Alternative Investment Services.

The Firm is ranked 49th among the top 100 firms in the US by Inside Public Accounting 2023. Internationally, the Firm has offices in Bangalore and Haryana in India and the Ivory Coast in Africa.

Think you have what it takes?

This is a single blended position based in Bengaluru within Kaufman Rossin's internal Information Technology department. One person owns both Scrum Master and Product Owner/Business Analyst functions for internal IT initiatives. The role partners directly with US-based IT stakeholders as an equal contributor, proactively driving requirements conversations and jointly defining solutions while facilitating agile ceremonies and coaching the Bengaluru delivery team.

Requirements


How You'll Contribute: 


Product Owner Responsibilities

Own and maintain the internal IT product backlog, ensuring every Epic, Feature, Story, and Task is well-defined, prioritized, and sprint-ready
Own the work-item hierarchy: Epics to Features to user stories to tasks, with clear acceptance criteria. 
Partner with US-based IT stakeholders as a peer to drive requirements, challenge assumptions, and co-define solutions. 
Lead backlog refinement with the Bengaluru engineering and delivery teams


Business Analysis Responsibilities

Jointly lead discovery and requirements sessions with internal US IT stakeholders, actively driving conversations rather than only documenting them
Produce BRDs, functional specifications, process-flow diagrams, and acceptance criteria, collaboratively reviewed with US counterparts
Own requirements traceability so every delivered feature connects to a documented internal business or technology requirement
Translate complex internal technology, automation, integration, infrastructure, security, and operational workflows into structured user stories


Scrum Master Responsibilities

Facilitate sprint planning, standups, reviews, and retrospectives across internal IT initiatives
Provide hands-on Jira and Azure DevOps administration, including boards, workflows, hierarchy, sprint setup, automation, and reporting
Remove impediments, protect sprint integrity, track and report delivery metrics. 
Drive continuous improvement and coach the Bengaluru team on agile principles and self-organization


Stakeholder Partnership

Engage US IT leaders, internal product owners, technical leads, and business-system stakeholders as a peer; proactively initiate requirements conversations and propose solutions. 
Build trusted relationships across internal IT and with the departments supported by IT, developing genuine knowledge of KR's systems and operating environment. 
Prepare and deliver structured status updates, backlog reviews, sprint metrics, and requirement walkthroughs for US audiences. 
Coordinate across internal IT workstreams while maintaining clear ownership, priorities, dependencies, and escalation paths


What Skills You'll Bring: 

4+ years of Scrum Master, Product Owner, and/or Business Analyst experience in agile delivery, including 2+ years in a blended or dual-capacity role. 
SAFe certification - SAFe Agilist, SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager, or SAFe Scrum Master - is mandatory. 
Hands-on Jira and Azure DevOps experience, including board configuration, work-item hierarchy, sprint setup, workflow automation, and reporting. 
Proven business-analysis skills in process mapping, requirements traceability, use-case documentation, acceptance criteria, and stakeholder facilitation. 
Experience working with distributed delivery teams and stakeholders across US and India time zones. 
Excellent written and spoken English for stakeholder communication, technical documentation, presentations, and vendor interactions

Surface risks and constraints early
Manage cross‑team dependencies
Ensure delivery adheres to CDO governance, readiness, and release standards.

Enforce consistent KPI definitions and semantic standards
Uphold data quality, lineage, and trust expectations
Ensure security and compliance requirements are met

Identify opportunities to:
Simplify or consolidate products
Reduce technical or vendor dependency
Improve scalability and user experience
Continuously refine product direction based on feedback and performance insights.
Required

Qualifications & Experience

7+ years of experience in Product Ownership, Product Management, Business Analysis, or Analytics/Data‑centric leadership roles.
Proven experience owning multiple products or domains in a complex enterprise environment.
Strong understanding of enterprise data, analytics, reporting, and BI platforms.
Demonstrated ability to work effectively with senior business stakeholders and technical delivery teams.
Experience leading or mentoring other Product Owners or equivalent roles.

Preferred

Experience within a Chief Data Office, Analytics COE, or Enterprise Reporting organization.
Familiarity with platforms such as Databricks, Power BI, semantic models, and self‑service analytics.
Experience modernizing legacy reporting or analytics platforms.
Background in professional services or financial services environments.

Leadership Behaviors & Expectations

Thinks and acts portfolio‑first, not story‑by‑story.
Brings clarity, structure, and discipline to ambiguity.
Comfortable making—and defending—trade‑off decisions.
Focused on outcomes, adoption, and trust, not just delivery.
Acts as a role model for product ownership maturity.

Role Relationships (Clarity of Accountability)

Lead Product Owner: Defines long‑term strategy, investment priorities, and value realization. Owns execution alignment, product standards, and delivery outcomes across a portfolio.
Product Owners: Own day‑to‑day product execution and backlogs within specific domains.
Program Managers: Own delivery coordination, milestones, and dependency management.

The Lead Product Owner ensures CDO can scale product‑led execution without chaos, reducing reliance on individual heroics while increasing predictability, trust, and impact across enterprise data and analytics investments.

Bachelor’s or higher degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.

Proven track record in designing and implementing data platforms, ETL frameworks, and data integration solutions.

Strong ability to operate in complex business environments and translate requirements into data solutions/designs/architectures.

Job Description:
As a Senior Product Manager of Managed Security Testing at VikingCloud, you will be responsible for the strategic planning, development, and execution of our offensive security testing services, including penetration testing as a service (PTaaS), vulnerability assessments, phishing simulations, social engineering testing, and specialized security assessments. You will own the product roadmap for VikingCloud's managed security testing portfolio, working closely with our internal security testing teams, third-party testing partners, and customers to deliver high-quality offensive security services that help merchants and financial institutions identify and remediate security weaknesses before attackers can exploit them. This role requires deep understanding of offensive security methodologies, industry certifications and frameworks (CREST, PTES, OWASP, PCI DSS ASV), and the ability to bridge technical security testing with compliance requirements. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams including security consultants, engineering, sales, and customer success to build scalable, automated testing platforms while maintaining the rigor and quality expected from professional security assessments. Your work will directly support customers' compliance programs (PCI DSS, SOC 2, ISO 27001) while providing actionable security insights that reduce risk.

Responsibilities:
Product Strategy & Vision: Develop and execute a comprehensive product strategy for VikingCloud's managed security testing services, including penetration testing, vulnerability assessments, web application testing, mobile app testing, API testing, phishing simulations, social engineering assessments, and automated testing. Define the product vision that balances automation and scalability with the technical rigor required for professional security testing.
AI Security Testing (AISec): Develop testing methodologies and a comprehensive product strategy for Larege Language Models (LLMs) AI Agents, Chatbots, and other AI powered technologies. This includes an “AI Red Teaming” strategy and packages for testing the robustness of customer-facing AI applications.
PTaaS Platform Development: Lead the development of VikingCloud's Penetration Testing as a Service (PTaaS) platform, creating modern delivery mechanisms that provide continuous testing, real-time reporting, seamless remediation tracking, and collaborative workflows between testers and customers. Define platform requirements for test scoping, scheduling, execution tracking, finding management, retesting, and certification delivery.
Testing Methodology & Standards: Ensure all security testing services adhere to industry-recognized methodologies and frameworks including CREST standards, Penetration Testing Execution Standard (PTES), OWASP Testing Guide, NIST SP 800-115, and PCI DSS testing requirements. Maintain current knowledge of CREST accreditation requirements and ensure VikingCloud's services meet or exceed these standards. Define quality assurance processes for testing deliverables.
Certification & Compliance Alignment: Build security testing services that directly support customer compliance requirements including PCI DSS (ASV scanning, segmentation testing, penetration testing), SOC 2 Type II (security testing evidence), ISO 27001, NIST frameworks, and industry-specific regulations. Position testing services as essential compliance components that provide both security value and audit evidence.
Roadmap Planning & Prioritization: Create and maintain detailed product roadmaps for testing services and PTaaS platform capabilities. Prioritize features and service enhancements based on customer feedback, compliance requirements, competitive analysis, revenue potential, and operational efficiency gains. Balance automation initiatives with maintaining high-quality manual testing where required.
Phishing & Social Engineering Programs: Develop comprehensive phishing simulation and security awareness testing capabilities including campaign management, template libraries, user tracking, training integration, and reporting dashboards. Create social engineering testing services including vishing, smishing, physical security testing, and pretexting scenarios tailored to different industries and threat models.
Service Delivery & Scalability: Design service delivery models that enable VikingCloud to scale testing services efficiently while maintaining quality. Define when to use internal testers versus third-party partners, automation versus manual testing, and on-demand versus scheduled assessments. Create standardized testing packages for common use cases while allowing customization for complex environments.
Vulnerability Management Integration: Integrate security testing services with VikingCloud's existing vulnerability scanning and management capabilities. Create workflows that enable customers to move seamlessly from continuous scanning to targeted penetration testing to remediation verification. Build unified vulnerability management dashboards that combine scan results, pen test findings, and remediation status.

Qualifications:
Bachelor's degree in computer science, cybersecurity, information security, or related technical field required; advanced degree (M.S. in Cybersecurity) or MBA is a plus.
10-14 years of experience in offensive security, penetration testing, or security consulting with at least 4-5 years in product management or service delivery leadership roles.
Hands-on penetration testing experience including web applications, APIs, mobile applications, network infrastructure, wireless networks, and cloud environments. Direct experience conducting security assessments, not just managing testing programs.
Deep understanding of offensive security methodologies and frameworks including CREST standards, Penetration Testing Execution Standard (PTES), OWASP Testing Guide, OWASP Top 10 and OWASP Top 10 for LLMs, SANS Top 25, and MITRE ATT&CK and ATLAS frameworks.
Strong knowledge of CREST certification pathways and accreditation requirements including CREST Registered Tester (CRT), CREST Certified Tester (CCT), CREST Practitioner Security Analyst (CPSA), and CREST infrastructure, application, and specialist certifications. Understanding of how CREST accreditation differentiates testing services in the market.
Professional security certifications strongly preferred including OSCP (Offensive Security Certified Professional), GPEN (GIAC Penetration Tester), GWAPT (GIAC Web Application Penetration Tester), CEH (Certified Ethical Hacker), or CREST certifications. Multiple certifications demonstrating breadth of expertise are highly valuable.
Experience with compliance-driven security testing including PCI DSS penetration testing requirements (Requirement 11.4), PCI DSS Approved Scanning Vendor (ASV) program, SOC 2 security testing, ISO 27001 testing requirements, and other regulatory frameworks.
Familiarity with penetration testing tools and platforms including Burp Suite, Metasploit, Cobalt Strike, Nmap, Nessus, OWASP ZAP, Kali Linux, and emerging automated testing tools. Understanding of when automation adds value versus when manual testing is required.
Experience with AI-augmented security testing, managing the security of AI/ML pipelines, prompt engineering for security testing, and use of AI agents in automated vulnerability discovery.
Knowledge of the EU AI Act, NIST AI Risk Management Framework, and other emerging AI regulations
Experience with PTaaS platforms or building security testing delivery platforms. Understanding of modern testing workflows including continuous testing, API-driven integrations, real-time reporting, and collaborative remediation tracking.

The Senior Product Manager will be responsible for working with software, design, operations, and other teams to expand the magic of JWO technology to a wide array of new selection offered in Amazon's physical stores. jobs.descriptionHtmlOrText:
At FourKites we have the opportunity to tackle complex challenges with real-world impacts. Whether it's medical supplies from Cardinal Health or groceries for Walmart, the FourKites platform helps customers operate global supply chains that are efficient, agile and sustainable.

Industry Context: AI-driven supply chain innovations reduce logistics costs by 15%+, inventory by 35%+, and improve service efficiency by 65%+. Companies prioritize AI-enabled automation as the key enabler for customer experience, sustainability, and resilience.

Join a team of curious problem solvers that celebrates differences, leads with empathy and values inclusivity.

FourKites is looking for a sharp, curious and execution-focused Product Manager to join the Visibility team and own our Over-the-Road (OTR) portfolio: Truckload, LTL, Parcel and Last Mile. This is FourKites' flagship product line. Some of the world's largest shippers use it to track billions of dollars of freight every day.

This is not a PM support role. You will own real product outcomes from day one. You'll work hands-on with data, build your own prototypes, talk directly with enterprise customers, and partner with engineering and design to ship features that improve adoption, retention and tracking quality.

The role sits where supply chain operations meet modern software product development, and you'll need both. You need deep empathy for how freight actually moves across modes, and the analytical rigor to turn that into product bets worth making.

What you'll be doing

Product Ownership & Outcomes

Own product outcomes for one or more OTR modes (Truckload, LTL, Parcel or Last Mile), including tracking quality, ETA accuracy and carrier coverage.
Track and analyze adoption, engagement and retention KPIs for your area.
Find friction points and adoption gaps using usage data, customer interviews and feedback from Customer Success and Sales.
Build and prioritize a backlog that measurably improves customer stickiness, and bring well-reasoned prioritization recommendations to roadmap planning.

Data & AI-Assisted Product Development

Write your own SQL to explore feature usage, tracking performance and customer behavior, without waiting on an analyst.
Use AI coding tools (Claude, Cursor and similar) to build working prototypes, internal tools and quick analyses that make a requirement concrete before engineering picks it up.
Work hands-on in product analytics platforms like Pendo, and maintain dashboards that track adoption trends across customer segments.
Turn quantitative findings into clear product hypotheses and actionable backlog items.
Partner with Data Science and Engineering on instrumentation and event tracking.

Customer Engagement

Run discovery sessions and join onboarding calls, QBRs and support escalations to understand shipper and carrier workflows firsthand.
Work with Customer Success Managers to surface systemic product gaps and recurring pain points.
Represent the voice of the customer in internal planning and sprint reviews.

Cross-Functional Execution

Work with Engineering and Design through scoping, development and post-launch monitoring, partnering directly with squads across time zones.
Support Product Marketing with onboarding materials, release notes and adoption playbooks.
Contribute to presales conversations and market requirements gathering with Solutions teams.

Who You Are

We're hiring at two levels:

Associate Product Manager: 2–4 years in product management or a related role. Strong BA, analyst, solutions or implementation backgrounds in logistics tech are welcome.
Product Manager: 5+ years, including end-to-end ownership of a product area and a track record of shipping with measurable business impact.

For both levels:

Practical experience in supply chain or logistics. You understand shipper pain points, carrier dynamics and how freight moves day to day.
Comfort working hands-on with data: strong SQL, familiarity with analytics tools, and the ability to build a data-driven story on your own.
Proven use of AI tools to speed up PM work beyond drafting documents, such as building prototypes, scripts and internal tools yourself. Be ready to walk us through something you've built this way.
Strong customer engagement skills. You've run discovery calls, written user stories, and can turn qualitative feedback into crisp requirements.
Experience working with distributed engineering teams across time zones.
Ability to work with significant overlap with US Central Time.

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience with two or more of truckload, LTL, parcel and last mile.
Prior work on SaaS onboarding flows, feature adoption programs or customer health scoring.
Experience with Pendo, Amplitude or similar product analytics tools.
Familiarity with agile development and working directly with engineering squads.
Bachelor's degree in engineering, operations, supply chain, economics or another quantitative field.

What success looks like in year 1:

You independently own a product area within OTR visibility, with clear adoption and engagement KPIs.
You've shipped customer-facing improvements end to end, from discovery through post-launch analysis, with significant business impact.
You use data to find insights before anyone has to ask for them.
You've built prototypes or internal tools that changed how a requirement was scoped or how your team works.
Customer Success and Engineering see you as a reliable, high-signal partner.

Who we are:

FourKites, the leader in AI-driven supply chain transformation for global enterprises and pioneer of real-time visibility, turns supply chain data into automated action. FourKites Intelligent Control Tower® breaks down enterprise silos by creating a real-time digital twin of orders, shipments, inventory and assets. This comprehensive view, combined with AI-powered digital workers, enables companies to prevent disruptions, automate routine tasks and optimize performance across their supply chain. FourKites processes over 3.2 million supply chain events daily — from purchase orders to final delivery — helping 1,600-plus global brands prevent disruptions, make faster decisions and move from reactive tracking to proactive supply chain orchestration. For more information, visit www.fourkites.com.

FourKites provides competitive compensation with stock options, outstanding benefits and a collaborative culture for all employees around the globe. To help you be your best, we have 5 global recharge days, in addition to generous PTO and standard holidays. Parental leave for all parents, an annual wellness stipend and volunteer days also provide you with time and resources for self care and to care for others. Throughout the year, FourKites sets aside time during the workday to learn and celebrate diversity. We're always listening for new ways to support everyone in and out of the office.
