Organization OverviewCompany Description

QAD is a leading provider of ERP solutions purpose-built for manufacturing industries — automotive, life sciences, food & beverage, high tech, and industrial. Serving thousands of global manufacturers, QAD's Adaptive Manufacturing Cloud helps companies operate with greater precision, agility, and intelligence.

QAD's AI Platform is the domain intelligence layer that sits between the ERP and autonomous AI agents. It encodes what manufacturing data means, governs what agents are permitted to do, and makes every autonomous decision traceable and accountable — transforming QAD from a system of record into a system of action.

Job Description

This role owns the full product lifecycle for QAD's Copilot, Search, and Conversational Analytics capabilities — from architecture through to market launch. You will define what gets built, why it matters to manufacturing users, and how it reaches them: shaping the product vision, driving engineering delivery, and partnering with GTM to ensure adoption.

The intelligence that powers these surfaces — how queries are understood, how manufacturing context is assembled, how data is retrieved, and how responses are generated — is where QAD's AI moat is built. You will need to engage deeply with these layers, not as an engineer but as the product owner who defines the contracts, quality standards, and sequencing decisions that determine whether they work in production at enterprise scale.

You will report to the Head of Platform Product, with day-to-day direction from the Director of the AI Platform org. This role is evaluated through the quality of your product thinking, your influence on engineering direction, and the outcomes you drive in the market.

The Opportunity

Manufacturing users today cannot query their own operations without analysts, BI tools, or pre-built reports. QAD's AI platform changes this — but only if the Copilot and Search layer is built correctly and lands with users. You will own both sides of that equation.

Define the semantic search and conversational analytics product that allows manufacturing users to query operational data — orders, inventory, suppliers, quality records — in natural language, without SQL or BI expertise
Own the intelligence contract: how queries are understood, how manufacturing context is assembled, how retrieval is orchestrated, and how responses are grounded in governed data — the foundational decisions that determine product quality at scale
Drive the Copilot from concept to customer — including the contextual layer architecture, the grounding contract against the platform's Semantic Layer, and the GTM motion that gets it adopted in manufacturing workflows
Build the feedback loops that make the product smarter over time: how recurring query patterns surface ontology gaps, how session analytics drive prioritisation, and how discovery findings translate into product improvements
Establish QAD's conversational analytics presence in market — working with GTM to define positioning, enablement, and the narrative that differentiates QAD's intelligence layer from horizontal AI tools

Key Responsibilities

Copilot & Conversational Analytics

Own the product definition for QAD's Copilot: how queries are understood, context assembled, data retrieved, and responses generated — specifying the contracts that engineering builds against
Define the grounding contract: the rules that ensure every Copilot response cites governed manufacturing data, not hallucinated inference — including confidence signalling and graceful fallback behaviour
Drive the conversational analytics strategy: how natural language queries translate into analytical results across manufacturing data domains without exposing SQL or BI complexity to the user
Specify the disambiguation model: how the Copilot handles ambiguous queries, missing context, and conflicting data signals in real manufacturing workflows

Search

Own the product definition for QAD's semantic search layer: indexing strategy, query understanding, entity recognition, ranking, and result structure across manufacturing data domains
Define the search intent taxonomy — operational (find order, trace shipment), analytical (show trends, compare periods), and diagnostic (why is this delayed, what caused this variance) — and specify result formats by intent type
Drive the federated search architecture: how results from ERP operational data, analytical stores, and the knowledge graph are ranked and merged into a coherent, useful response

Discovery, Delivery & GTM

Maintain a structured customer discovery programme — extracting real manufacturing query patterns and translating findings into specific product and architecture implications
Own the product backlog: writing stories to Staff Engineer level of specificity — API contracts, state machines, data flows, edge cases — that engineering can build without verbal clarification
Partner with GTM to define the launch and adoption strategy for Copilot and Search: positioning, sales enablement, onboarding playbooks, and the narrative that lands with manufacturing buyers
Define the quality framework for these surfaces: what signals matter for product performance — retrieval relevance, grounding rate, latency distribution — and how they inform roadmap decisions

Stakeholder Management & Managing Up

Proactively surface dependencies, risks, and scope changes to the Director and Head of Platform Product — with a resolution proposal, not just an escalation
Communicate product and architecture decisions clearly to non-technical stakeholders — translating trade-offs into business implications without jargon
Build credibility with Engineering, Architecture, and GTM through the quality and precision of written work

Qualifications

Product Experience

7–12 years in product management, with significant time owning AI-powered, search, or analytics products in enterprise B2B environments — from definition through production launch
Proven track record owning the full product lifecycle: customer discovery, specification, engineering delivery, and GTM — not just one slice
Experience working in matrixed organisations — driving outcomes across Platform, Engineering, Architecture, and GTM without direct authority
Evidence of structured discovery practice applied to a technical product surface — ability to extract product implications from user research, not just UX insights

Core Technical Depth — Required

These are the primary technical domains this role owns. Strong command is expected from day one.

Semantic search architecture: indexing strategy, query understanding, entity recognition, ranking models, and relevance evaluation at enterprise scale
Conversational AI product design: how natural language queries are translated into structured analytical results across complex, domain-specific data without exposing backend complexity to users

Create clear ownership, operating rhythms, metrics, and accountability for adoption initiatives.

Develop a deep understanding of customer needs, workflows, pain points, and reasons for non-adoption.
Combine quantitative product data with qualitative customer insights to identify root causes.
Partner with customer-facing teams to establish systematic feedback loops into Product.
Benchmark adoption and customer experience against relevant SaaS and technology platforms.

What Success Looks Like

Increase activation and adoption of strategic product capabilities.
Improve time-to-value for new and existing customers.
Increase feature penetration and depth of product usage.
Improve engagement and repeat usage of high-value workflows.
Reduce adoption-related friction and early customer drop-off.
Establish measurable relationships between product adoption and retention, expansion, and customer value.
Build a scalable operating model for measuring and improving adoption across HighLevel.

Influence effectively at the senior level — building trust and alignment even when delivering difficult or unpopular decisions.
Communicate priorities, trade-offs, and rationale in a way that earns confidence from leadership.

Operate effectively and consistently in a complex, matrixed environment with many stakeholders and long-running technical complexity.
Maintain strong engagement, energy, and standards over sustained periods, including in phases that are less visible or less immediately rewarding.

Required Experience & Skills

7+ years in Product Management, with substantial experience owning complex, technically deep, or platform-style product areas.

Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills, particularly with senior and cross-functional audiences.

What We Are Looking For

Is energized by scope and ownership, and comfortable being the person a wide range of stakeholders rely on for judgment calls.
Treats complex, technically deep systems as a craft to master.
Brings AI-native thinking as a default instinct.

Priority Criteria

2. Strong, credible influence with senior stakeholders — able to align and hold a position at the leadership level.
3. Sustained high performance in complex environments — consistent delivery and engagement over time, not just in short sprints.

Success in This Role

What We're Looking For

We're seeking an experienced Senior Product Manager to join the Presentment value stream within Arcadia's Utility Data Platform (UDP) pillar. Presentment owns the customer-facing layer of the utility data pipeline, Plug, UDS, DELI, and DICE, that lets customers and downstream systems manage, retrieve, and consume utility data. This person will help define and drive product requirements for Plug's presentment capabilities — the APIs, delivery workflows, and customer-facing tools that make Arcadia's unified data model usable at scale — partnering closely with the Presentment product lead, who sets overall roadmap direction.

This person will collaborate frequently with engineering (India and US), other Presentment and UDP product leads, and cross-functional teams like Customer Success and Operations to ensure the success of their product. Define, prioritize, and ship features that scale Plug across new and existing customer use cases.
Partner with engineering to evolve the data delivery architecture, including cloud infrastructure (AWS) decisions that affect scale, reliability, and cost.

Collaborate with front-end engineering and design on customer-facing tools (delivery configuration, status/breadcrumb visibility, self-serve workflows).

Own day-to-day management of KTLO and balance run-the-business work and tech-debt reduction against new capability delivery, including evaluating where AI can reduce run-the-business load (without shifting the role's core mandate to AI product work).

Description

As part of the AWS Applied AI Solutions organization, we have a vision to provide business applications, leveraging Amazon's unique experience and expertise, that are used by millions of companies worldwide to manage day-to-day operations. We blend vision with curiosity and Amazon's real-world experience to build opinionated, turnkey solutions. Where customers prefer to buy over build, we become their trusted partner with solutions that are no-brainers to buy and easy to use.

Just Walk Out (JWO) enables shopping in retail stores with no lines and no checkout. You simply use a credit card to enter the store, take what you want from our selection of fresh, delicious meals and grocery essentials, and leave the store. This checkout-free shopping experience is made possible by Just Walk Out Technology, which automatically detects whether products are taken or returned, and enables shoppers to grab and go from stores ranging from small airport kiosks to massive university stores.

The Merchant In-Store Operations team, within JWO, owns the tools, systems, and workflows that enable merchants and their store associates to operate autonomous retail environments at scale. The role spans directly working with two engineering teams that are responsible for unattended store operations, planogram and product layout tooling, and in-store associate experience and education; Together, these teams serve JWO's growing global footprint, supporting diverse retail configurations—from fully staffed locations to completely unattended kiosks and micro-markets—enabling merchants across Sports, Education, Travel, Healthcare, and Hospitality verticals to run Just Walk Out stores efficiently and confidently. This Senior Product Manager-Tech will own the product vision spanning both teams, defining how merchants and store teams interact with, monitor, and maintain their autonomous retail environments day-to-day, and how customer support and tech operations teams diagnose and resolve issues at speed.

You will define the product roadmap spanning two engineering teams—In-Store Operations —covering unattended store operations, store associate tooling, planogram management, store availability, and customer support experience capabilities that scale from hundreds to thousands of stores with vastly different operational models. You will work with Enterprise Customers, System Integrators, Engineering, Solution Architects, Customer Support, and Tech Operations teams to drive the long-term Merchant In-Store Operations vision as JWO expands from 350+ stores today to thousands of stores globally. This role requires deep understanding of physical retail operations, store-level workflows, customer support systems, and the ability to design intuitive tools that empower merchants, frontline associates, and support teams to succeed in autonomous retail environments.

As a tenured Product Manager, you are familiar with the product development lifecycle. You exhibit high proficiency and efficacy in core product management disciplines such as defining user stories, priorities, success metrics, presenting vision that works backwards from customers, and are comfortable driving clarity across multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced and ambiguous environment. A successful candidate will combine an ability to Think Big with keen attention to detail. We are looking for a passionate, data-driven decision maker who likes building from scratch, experimenting with emerging technologies like generative AI and AI-powered agents, and setting high standards. You have a high degree of ownership, deep retail operations and customer support expertise, and are an excellent written and verbal communicator who thrives in an entrepreneurial environment.

Key job responsibilities

Define and evangelize the long-term vision for Merchant In-Store Operations, developing strategic roadmaps for unattended operations, planogram tooling, and in-store associate experience that align with Just Walk Out's goal of scaling from 400 to 7,000+ stores by 2028
Own the unattended operations strategy, designing and delivering the systems, workflows, and merchant-facing capabilities that enable fully unmanned JWO stores (micro-markets, kiosks, grab-and-go locations) to operate reliably at scale with minimal human intervention, including remote monitoring, automated alerting, and self-service recovery mechanisms
Lead the planogram tools vision and execution, owning the end-to-end product experience that enables merchants and solution architects to design, configure, validate, and update store layouts and product placements across diverse physical formats, reducing planogram setup time and improving accuracy for new store launches and seasonal resets
Own the JWO In-Store Associate Experience and Education strategy, building intuitive tools, dashboards, and training resources that empower store associates to understand autonomous retail operations, troubleshoot common issues, manage day-to-day store tasks, and deliver excellent customer service in a checkout-free environment
Partner with engineering leadership to deliver scalable, enterprise-grade in-store operations capabilities, making technical decisions that balance merchant needs across diverse verticals (Sports, Education, Travel, Healthcare, Hospitality) with engineering constraints, platform stability, and the ability to support stores with vastly different physical layouts and operational requirements
Own the operational playbook for unattended store formats, defining standard operating procedures, escalation paths, and automated remediation workflows that ensure consistent store uptime and customer experience across geographies and merchant types
Define and track key metrics including store uptime, mean-time-to-resolution, associate task completion rates, planogram accuracy, and merchant satisfaction to drive continuous improvement and inform product investment decisions
Build and maintain relationships with enterprise customers and cross-functional stakeholders, gathering requirements from merchants operating at scale, understanding in-store operational constraints, and ensuring Merchant In-Store Operations capabilities meet current needs while anticipating future requirements as the business scales globally

jobs.sourceTitle: Senior Staff Product Manager - Data Protection
jobs.descriptionHtmlOrText:
Our Company 

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI. 

What You’ll Do 

In this role, you will serve as a product leader driving Teradata’s data protection product management strategy and execution across our global portfolio. You will define and influence how Teradata delivers resilient data protection for the world’s most sensitive enterprise data; spanning backup and recovery, replication, disaster recovery, business continuity, and cyber resilience. 

Your impact will be shaping how customers meet aggressive RTO and RPO targets at Petabyte scale ensuring reliable backup, rapid recovery, and continuous data availability across hybrid and multi-cloud environments. You will accelerate the delivery of the Enterprise data protection and resilience roadmap, balancing innovation with performance, reliability, and compliance. 

Success in this role will be measured by delivering enterprise-grade data protection and resilience solutions for hybrid and multi-cloud deployments, differentiating Teradata and unlocking measurable customer value while preserving scalability, reliability, and cost-efficiency. 

Who You Will Work With

On our team, we collaborate with customers, engineering, cloud infrastructure, security operations, governance, field teams, and UX functions to bring next-generation data protection and resilience capabilities into Teradata’s enterprise ecosystem. We are responsible for the product vision, roadmap, and execution of backup, recovery, and resilience initiatives, ensuring they meet both business and technical objectives. 

What Makes You a Qualified Candidate

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, engineering, or related field. 
12+ years of product management experience, including 6+ years leading data protection, backup and recovery, or disaster recovery products at enterprise scale, including Managed Service Providers 
Deep technical expertise across the data protection stack: backup software and storage platforms, deduplication and compression, snapshot management, replication topologies, immutable and air-gapped storage, ransomware recovery, DR orchestration, and RPO/RTO optimization across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments. 
Proven success embedding backup, recovery, and resilience capabilities into enterprise data platforms at petabyte scale, with measurable improvements to customer SLA attainment and recovery confidence. 
Demonstrated knowledge of hybrid and multi-cloud architectures and their impact on backup strategy, data residency, sovereignty, storage tiering, and cost optimization. 
Exceptional communication skills with the ability to articulate data protection product strategy to both technical and executive audiences. 
Track record of customer engagement, market analysis, and competitive benchmarking against leading backup and data protection vendors and native cloud provider capabilities. 

What You Will Bring

Expertise architecting enterprise backup topologies, cyber resiliency and Agentic AI data protection strategies across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments, with a focus on minimizing recovery time 
Hands-on knowledge of leading backup and recovery platforms (e. g. , Rubrik, Veeam, Cohesity, Commvault, Zerto, NetBackup) and cloud-native backup services (AWS Backup, Azure Backup, Google Cloud Backup and DR). 
Ability to connect backup and recovery strategy to modern AI/ML and analytics workloads, including protecting training datasets, model checkpoints, feature stores, and data pipelines against corruption, accidental deletion, and ransomware. 
A strong understanding of backup retention policy design, covering lifecycle management, legal hold, eDiscovery readiness, and compliance-driven retention schedules for regulated data classes (PII, PHI, PCI) across tiered and archival storage. 
Vision to anticipate industry trends, next-generation backup architectures, AI-driven anomaly detection for data corruption, and data sovereignty mandates and position Teradata’s data protection offerings as differentiated and enterprise-ready. 



Why We Think You’ll Love Teradata

We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are an anti-racist company because our dedication to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is more than a statement. It is a deep commitment to doing the work to foster an equitable environment that celebrates people for all of who they are.

Teradata invites all identities and backgrounds in the workplace. We work with deliberation and intent to ensure we are cultivating collaboration and inclusivity across our global organization. ​ We are proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, ancestry, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related conditions), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, gender identity or expression, military and veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

About Pocket FM
At our core, we are an AI-powered entertainment company with a human-first philosophy: technology should amplify creativity, not replace it. Our proprietary AI works with writers, voice artists, and creative teams to help stories scale faster, smarter, and with cultural and emotional integrity.
We move with a startup mindset, curious, fast, and deeply owner-driven even as we operate at massive scale.

Grow a healthy connector ecosystem by reducing time to build and publish connectors, improving quality, and enabling partners to reach customers across Microsoft Copilot experiences. 
Partner with security, privacy, compliance, and responsible AI teams to ensure connectors are trustworthy, permission-aware, auditable, resilient, and appropriate for enterprise use. 
Define how connector data and tools are grounded, ranked, cited, and invoked so Copilot delivers relevant, accurate, and explainable outcomes. 
Drive platform capabilities for connector observability, diagnostics, reliability, throttling, freshness, quality measurement, and lifecycle management at hyperscale. 
Work closely with customers and partners to understand their highest-value systems and scenarios, identify adoption barriers, and translate insights into platform investments. 
Define success metrics across connector coverage, developer velocity, onboarding completion, reliability, content freshness, discovery, activation, usage, answer quality, and customer value. 
Lead cross-company initiatives to align product experiences, technical architectures, governance models, and investment priorities across Microsoft.

The Chart Data & ChartSync team focuses on making fragmented patient information available and useful within athenaOne. Patient information can exist across organizations, documents, and external data sources. The team is focused on creating a more complete and useful patient record without creating additional work for the people caring for the patient. As part of our commitment to diversifying our workforce, we do not discriminate on the basis of age, race, sex, gender, gender identity, color, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, marital status, citizenship, veteran status, or disability status, and we operate in compliance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

About Glean

Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles.

At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level.

Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality.

If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more - deeply embedded where people get things done. You’ll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company.

About The Role

Glean is seeking a Product Manager to help solve a ubiquitous problem that all knowledge workers in the world struggle with on a daily basis. You’ll deliver best-in-class products for finding, curating, sharing, discovering, and managing knowledge. We’ve only taken the first step towards our long-term vision of an intelligent work assistant, and we need great product leaders to take us the rest of the way.

We’re currently a very lean product team, so you’ll have an outsized role in shaping both the product roadmap and the product team itself. You’ll collaborate closely with our stellar Design, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, and Success partners to understand our customers and build category-defining tools. You’ll wear many hats and gain both breadth and depth of experience. As Glean’s PM for Protect ( Security and Governance) you’ll develop new technologies and product features spanning explainable / transparent AI systems, identification and prevention of various vectors of AI risks, and the observability, security and privacy features around AI agents and underlying data for our customers.

You Will

Spending a lot of time with our customers to deeply understand their knowledge needs
Developing key parts of our product roadmap, marrying customers’ needs with our product vision
Empowering your team by giving context, setting direction, and building alignment
Driving customer-focused decisions, clear prioritization, and efficient execution
Coordinating cross-functionally with with leadership, go-to-market teams, and other key stakeholders across the company
Building processes that will scale as our team and company go through rapid growth

About You

You have 8+ years of experience in product management at SaaS companies, primarily serving large enterprises with responsibilities spanning security, governance, trust, identity, data integrations.
You have a strong technical background and experience with both UX and API driven products, integration paths, and 3rd party product partnerships.
You are an excellent written and verbal communicator.
You have a proven track record of taking ownership, taking initiative, and delivering results.
You collaborate effectively with cross-functional partners.
You have a learning and growth mindset.
You are mission-first and understand that your success is measured by your product and team’s success.

Location:

This role is hybrid (3 days a week in our Bangalore office)

Compensation & Benefits

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

We are a diverse bunch of people and we want to continue to attract and retain a diverse range of people into our organization. We're committed to an inclusive and diverse company. We do not discriminate based on gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race.

AI-First Mindset At Glean

At Glean, AI fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating AI into their everyday work. As part of the interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about, design, and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today — prior Glean experience isn't required.

Welcome to Warner Bros. Discovery… the stuff dreams are made of.
Who We Are… 
When we say, “the stuff dreams are made of,” we’re not just referring to the world of wizards, dragons and superheroes, or even to the wonders of Planet Earth. Behind WBD’s vast portfolio of iconic content and beloved brands, are the storytellers bringing our characters to life, the creators bringing them to your living rooms and the dreamers creating what’s next…
From brilliant creatives, to technology trailblazers, across the globe, WBD offers career defining opportunities, thoughtfully curated benefits, and the tools to explore and grow into your best selves. Here you are supported, here you are celebrated, here you can thrive.
Senior Staff Product Manager – Technical (Data & Audience Platform Team), Hyderabad
About Warner Bros. Discovery:
Warner Bros. Discovery, a premier global media and entertainment company, offers audiences the world's most differentiated and complete portfolio of content, brands and franchises across television, film, streaming and gaming. The new company combines Warner Media’s premium entertainment, sports and news assets with Discovery's leading non-fiction and international entertainment and sports businesses.
For more information, please visit www.wbd.com.

Meet our team
The Data and Audience Platform team sits within the Data & Analytics organization in WBD's Global Tech division. We build the data platform behind our streaming services and content businesses - the pipelines, data lakes, and serving infrastructure that turn billions of events into audience insights, personalization, and intelligent products.

About the Role
The Senior Staff Product Manager-Tech, AI/ML Roadmap and Platform Strategy, will define and drive the Data & Audience Platform (DAP) AI roadmap across predictive ML, GenAI, agentic workflows, AI-enabled analytics, data activation, and AI-native platform capabilities. This role is intentionally AI-centric: it exists to elevate DAP from a data and analytics platform organization into a product-led AI enablement function that identifies the highest-value AI opportunities, chooses the right technologies, and converts experimentation into durable business outcomes.
This role will be accountable for disciplined AI product strategy: selecting the right problems, validating that the newest technology is actually the best fit, defining measurable business value up front, and ensuring platform investments are reusable, governed, cost-aware, and scalable. The role will work across DAP, engineering, analytics, data science, architecture, product, operations, privacy/legal, AI governance, and senior leadership to make AI investments actionable, safe, and outcome driven.

Roles & Responsibilities:
Shape AI product strategy and roadmap priorities across DAP platform areas.
Evaluate AI/ML opportunities through value, feasibility, cost, data readiness, governance, and reuse lenses.
Write AI-focused PRDs, product briefs, model/agent behavior requirements, evaluation criteria, and launch readiness requirements.
Partner with engineering, data science, and architecture to compare model, platform, vendor, and implementation tradeoffs.
Define KPIs and decision frameworks that connect AI outputs to business outcomes.
Run AI roadmap, prioritization, value review, and post-launch measurement forums.
Translate complex AI/ML concepts into clear executive narratives and actionable decisions.
Identify when AI work should be standardized as a shared platform capability versus delivered as a bespoke solution.
Work with cross-functional teams to intake, define, identify risks, and schedule work to develop key features.
Formulate a point of view on how proposed features align with business goals and our tech strategy.

What to Bring:
12+ years of product management, technical product management, AI/ML product strategy, data platform, analytics, or related experience.
Deep experience defining and delivering AI/ML, GenAI, data platform, customer intelligence, analytics, activation, or enterprise platform products at scale.
Strong working knowledge of AI/ML product concepts including model lifecycle, experimentation, model evaluation, MLOps, data quality, governance, semantic layers, feature/data products, and post-launch performance measurement.
Practical fluency in modern AI patterns such as LLMs, RAG, agentic systems, AI orchestration, prompt and agent lifecycle management, human-in-the-loop workflows, and AI observability.
Demonstrated ability to set product vision and direction across multiple teams and highly ambiguous technical domains.
Strong ability to evaluate technology tradeoffs across capability, quality, scalability, privacy, security, cost, maintainability, and business value.
Excellent executive communication skills with the ability to translate technical AI concepts into clear decisions, narratives, and value cases.
Proven ability to influence without authority across engineering, architecture, data science, TPM, analytics, operations, business, governance, and senior leadership teams.
Track record of delivering measurable customer, business, operational, or platform impact from technical product investments.

The Nice to Haves
Experience with streaming media, digital video, Customer 360, personalization, recommendations, content intelligence, advertising analytics, audience activation, commerce analytics, marketing analytics, or global platform products.
Experience with AI governance, responsible AI, model risk review, privacy/security requirements, or compliance needs for AI-powered products.
Experience creating scalable intake, prioritization, value management, and post-launch measurement mechanisms for AI portfolios.
Experience with AI cost management, cloud/data platform FinOps, model inference cost tradeoffs, vendor evaluation, or build/buy/reuse decisioning.
Experience mentoring senior PMs / PM-Ts and raising product craft across a matrixed organization.

What We Offer:
A Great Place to work.
Equal opportunity employer
Fast track growth opportunities

How We Get Things Done…
This last bit is probably the most important! Here at WBD, our guiding principles are the core values by which we operate and are central to how we get things done. You can find them at www.wbd.com/guiding-principles/ along with some insights from the team on what they mean and how they show up in their day to day. We hope they resonate with you and look forward to discussing them during your interview.
Championing Inclusion at WBD
Warner Bros. Discovery embraces the opportunity to build a workforce that reflects a wide array of perspectives, backgrounds and experiences. Being an equal opportunity employer means that we take seriously our responsibility to consider qualified candidates on the basis of merit, regardless of sex, gender identity, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, religion or belief, marital status, pregnancy, parenthood, disability or any other category protected by law.
If you’re a qualified candidate with a disability and you require adjustments or accommodations during the job application and/or recruitment process, please visit our accessibility page for instructions to submit your request.

The group you’ll be a part of

Product Management in Lam India, specifically Deposition Product Group.

The impact you’ll make

As a Product Manager at Lam, you play a crucial role in defining the strategy, roadmap, and features of the product. You are both strategic and tactical. You will span the entire product life cycle, from definition and planning to production release, upgrades, and end-of-life. Your leadership skills will be vital in ensuring cross-functional collaboration across different departments to drive the success of the portfolio of products. With your expertise in both business and technical domains, you’ll bring the product vision to life for Lam and our customers.

What You’ll Do

Responsibilities Strategic

Drive product roadmap, strategy, vision for enhancements of existing products to meet requirements for target applications and customers.
Work in conjunction with product marketing, product line GM, technology development, customer interface to define the portfolio of products offered, including setting product life cycle strategy and ensuring execution to the defined plan of record for each product.
Facilitate review of market, technology, and competitive trends leading to development and revision of product strategy/roadmap and organizational priorities.
Functions as a central resource with design, manufacturing, quality, test, marketing and distribution as the product(s) move through their lifecycle.
Directs those involved in the design, modification and evaluation of all phases of a specific product or group of products.
Formulates and executes long-term plans for cost/profit control.
Promotes use of new technologies and industry-leading trends.
Define and institutionalize new processes to improve effectiveness, leverage synergies and enable maturity of the organization.
Be the change agent, driving process excellence, ownership of products, responsiveness to customer problems and leading by example.

Required Skills

Who we’re looking for

Minimum of 8 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 6 years and a Master’s degree; or a PhD with 3 years experience; or equivalent experience.
Familiarity with one or more families of semiconductor equipment, in either deposition or etch; ideally direct exposure to customer fabs.
In-depth and/or breadth of expertise in own discipline and broad knowledge of other disciplines within the function.
Exercises independent judgement in methods, techniques and evaluation criteria for obtaining results. 
A confident, intellectually curious individual with a demonstrated leadership capability.
Bias for action, Drive to completion with conviction and courage.
Excellent collaboration & communication; form cross-functional partnerships to enable successful execution.
Ability to communicate complex ideas to persuade a different point of view.
Ability to bring clarity and guidance during uncertainty, Data backed decision making.
Ability to lay out clear messages and value propositions in clean and concise collateral.
Ability to solve unique and complex problems with broad impact on the business in a fast moving environment.
Leading projects with notable risk and complexity; developing strategy for project execution.
Effective management of stakeholder expectations - Business process and Operational focus, Leadership, Agility.

Preferred Qualifications

Have knowledge of best practices and how product management function integrates with others areas.
Awareness of the competition and the factors that differentiate them in the market.
General/functional understanding of business processes.
Ability to anticipate business and regulatory issues.

Our commitment

We believe it is important for every person to feel valued, included, and empowered to achieve their full potential. By bringing unique individuals and viewpoints together, we achieve extraordinary results.

Lam Research ("Lam" or the "Company") is an equal opportunity employer. Lam is committed to and reaffirms support of equal opportunity in employment and non-discrimination in employment policies, practices and procedures on the basis of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions), gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, or military and veteran status or any other category protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. It is the Company's intention to comply with all applicable laws and regulations. Company policy prohibits unlawful discrimination against applicants or employees.

Lam offers a variety of work location models based on the needs of each role. Our hybrid roles combine the benefits of on-site collaboration with colleagues and the flexibility to work remotely and fall into two categories – On-site Flex and Virtual Flex. ‘On-site Flex’ you’ll work 3+ days per week on-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, with the opportunity to work remotely for the balance of the week. ‘Virtual Flex’ you’ll work 1-2 days per week on-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, and remotely the rest of the time.

About Chargebee:
Chargebee is a subscription billing and revenue management platform powering some of the fastest-growing brands around the world today, including Calendly, Hopin, Pret-a-Manger, Freshworks, Okta, Study.com and others. Thousands of SaaS and subscription-first businesses process over billions of dollars in revenue every year through the Chargebee platform.

Headquartered in San Francisco, USA, our 500+ team members work remotely throughout the world, including India, the Netherlands, Paris, Spain, Australia, and the USA.
Chargebee has raised over $480 million in capital and is funded by Accel, Tiger Global, Insight Partners, Steadview Capital, and Sapphire Ventures. And we’re on a mission to push the boundaries of subscription revenue operations. Not just ours, but every customer and prospective business on a recurring revenue model.

Our team builds high-quality and innovative software to enable our customers to grow their revenues powered by the state-of-the-art subscription management platform

About the Team
We own the core of Chargebee's billing platform: the mission-critical system of record that 6,500 customers across the globe rely on to run billions of dollars in revenue.
Our customers range from startups to global enterprises, across B2B and B2C, and diverse go-to-market motions including PLG, SLG, and reseller. All of them bill on the same core platform.

About the Role
We are looking for a Staff Product Manager with a platform mindset to own Billing and Subscription Management, one of Chargebee's most foundational product areas. You will lead the evolution of the core billing platform, making it more flexible, scalable, and intelligent.
The work is a balance. You will support thousands of existing businesses with urgent, high-stakes requirements, while simultaneously evolving the platform for AI-native monetization models, reimagining billing workflows, and creating dramatically better customer experiences.

What You'll Do
Shape the roadmap: Understand customer requirements, market needs, competitive movements, and emerging trends; synthesize these into clear themes that inform and prioritize the roadmap.
Drive cross-functional execution: Core billing workflows span multiple modules and teams. Partner closely with Engineering, Design, and dependent squads to drive execution with clarity and alignment.
Make hard prioritization calls: Navigate competing priorities, make clear trade-offs, and communicate decisions effectively with stakeholders.
Reimagine billing with AI: Drive innovation across core billing workflows by exploring what is now possible with AI and translating those possibilities into meaningful customer value.
Build for flexibility and scale: Understand complex billing scenarios and apply a platform mindset to ensure capabilities are designed to flexibly support the needs of a diverse customer base.

What You'll Bring
8+ years of experience in B2B enterprise product management; experience with billing is highly desirable.
High agency: Operate as the product anchor for your charter, driving cross-functional alignment and owning outcomes end to end.
Technical fluency: Understand system design concepts and APIs well enough to collaborate effectively with senior engineers and make architecture-aware product decisions.
Collaborative mindset: Thrive in a highly collaborative environment and enjoy working across teams to solve complex problems.
AI-first mindset: Excited by the productivity and process improvements that new AI tools can unlock for product management and product development.
Structured and data-driven: Break down complex problems, go deep into the details, and make decisions grounded in data.

Why This Role Matters
Work on a mission-critical platform at truly global scale, supporting billions of dollars in processed revenue. The decisions you make will directly influence thousands of businesses
Work alongside a highly talented team of experts shaping the billing and monetization landscape for a category leading product.
Build the infrastructure for what's next in billing, monetization, and AI-powered business models.
If you are excited by complex platform problems, thrive at the intersection of customer needs and technical depth, and want to shape how businesses monetize in an AI-driven world, this is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact.

We are Globally Local
With a diverse team across four continents, and customers in over 60 countries, you get to work closely with a global perspective right from your own neighborhood.

We value Curiosity
We believe the next great idea might just be around the corner. Perhaps it’s that random thought you had ten minutes ago. We believe in creating an ecosystem that fosters a desire to seek out hard questions, and then figure out answers to them.

Customer! Customer! Customer!
Everything we do is driven towards enabling our customers’ growth. This means no matter what you do, you will always be adding real value to a real business problem. It’s a lot of responsibility, but also a lot of fun.

Role Overview...

At IDfy, privacy isn’t paperwork — it’s power. We’re using AI to decode contracts, classify PII, and help businesses stay ahead of fast-changing privacy laws. To pull this off, we need someone who can straddle worlds: fluent in privacy, sharp with tech, and confident in boardrooms.

We are the match if...

Atleast 2 years of core product management experience in B2B SaaS
Ability to bring structure to messy problems and run sharp prioritisation.
Prior experience building LOS, LMS, HRMS, CRM, or equivalent workflow-heavy products that now need AI agents to that solve for outcomes
Comfort with AI-led product patterns: LLMs, summarisation, retrieval.
Bonus: experience in AI based risk ,fraud, or compliance products.

How you will work -

Understand customer problems, collaborate with developers and designers for a robus solution
Write PRDs that people actually read.
Sit with customers. Watch them use the product. Listen more than you talk.
Partner with engineering on trade-offs. Decide fast. Document faster with our agentic software development

Here’s what your day will look like...

Global scale from day one. This is not an India-only product. You will ship to markets across Asia, the Middle East, and beyond.
Privy has already gartenered 50+ Enterprise customers and inching towards 100 and this comes with a need for speed across functions.
Real ownership. APM at IDfy owns a roadmap decided and prioritised by the product team, not a backlog.You will work directly with engineering, design, and leadership.
Build at the intersection of AI, risk, and workflow. Few PM roles let you touch all three. This one does.
Customers who care. Our users are risk analysts, ops leaders, and CXOs at top financial institutions. Their feedback will shape what you build.
Craft matters here. We care about PRDs that think clearly, dashboards that answer the right question, and UX that respects the reviewer's time.

Why Join Accellor

This is an opportunity to play a meaningful role in shaping real enterprise AI products, not just internal experiments or slideware. At Accellor, you will work on cutting-edge AI applications for global clients, solve complex business problems, and build products that matter in real operating environments.

Circle (NYSE: CRCL) is one of the world’s leading internet financial platform companies, building the foundation of a more open, global economy through digital assets, payment applications, and programmable blockchain infrastructure. Circle’s platform includes the world’s largest regulated stablecoin network anchored by USDC, Circle Payments Network for global money movement, and Arc, an enterprise-grade blockchain designed to become the Economic OS for the internet. Enterprises, financial institutions, and developers use Circle to power trusted, internet-scale financial innovation. Learn more at circle.com.

What You’ll Be Part Of

Circle is committed to visibility and stability in everything we do. As we grow as an organization, we're expanding into some of the world's strongest jurisdictions. Speed and efficiency are motivators for our success and our employees live by our company values: High Integrity, Future Forward, Multistakeholder, Mindful, and Driven by Excellence. We have built a flexible work environment where new ideas are encouraged and everyone is a stakeholder.

What you'll be responsible for

You will own product areas within Managed Payments, Circle’s regulated payments infrastructure that enables PSPs, financial institutions, banks, and enterprises to use stablecoin-powered payment rails without operating crypto infrastructure themselves. You will define and evolve product capabilities that support managed pay-ins, payouts, conversion, and transaction lifecycle management across stablecoin and fiat endpoints. Working closely with Engineering, Compliance, Operations, Treasury, and commercial teams, you will translate complex customer and business needs into clear product priorities, lead cross-functional execution, and deliver measurable improvements to how customers move money across geographies and payment rails.

What you'll work on

Own the roadmap for product areas across managed pay-ins, payouts, fiat endpoints, conversion, and transaction lifecycle management, aligning priorities with customer needs and Circle’s goals.
Define and launch capabilities that expand Managed Payments across Circle’s regulated hubs, including new entities, corridors, payout methods, and geographic coverage.
Shape simple, reliable customer experiences for accepting funds, converting value, and disbursing globally across stablecoin and fiat rails, including integrations with CPN and other Circle systems.
Improve customer and operator workflows across onboarding, account setup, transaction visibility, reporting, exception handling, reconciliation, refunds, RFIs, and bulk payments.
Use customer, product, payment, and operational data to identify friction, prioritize investments, and measure improvements in reliability, efficiency, adoption, and customer experience.
Evaluate opportunities to support new payment rails, payout use cases, and digital assets based on customer demand, regulatory requirements, technical feasibility, and business priorities.
Lead complex cross-functional initiatives with Engineering, Compliance, Operations, Legal, Treasury, BD, and Product, navigating technical and business trade-offs and driving alignment from definition through launch.

What you'll bring to Circle

Core requirements

4+ years of relevant experience, including product management experience building payments, fintech, financial infrastructure, or similarly complex B2B products.
Experience owning product vision, roadmaps, and execution for B2B capabilities such as payments, pay-ins, payouts, settlement, treasury infrastructure, APIs, or financial operations.
Demonstrated ability to independently lead complex cross-functional initiatives spanning Engineering and partners such as Compliance, Operations, Legal, Treasury, or commercial teams.
Strong analytical and technical fluency, with experience using customer, product, payment, and operational data to identify opportunities and guide product decisions.
Track record of delivering measurable improvements to customer experience, product adoption, operational efficiency, reliability, or business performance.
Ability to evaluate technical and business trade-offs, resolve ambiguity, and translate complex requirements into clear product priorities and execution plans.

Preferred Requirements

Knowledge of cross-border payments, PSP infrastructure, settlement systems, correspondent banking, or other payment network concepts.
Familiarity with stablecoins, blockchain-based financial infrastructure, or crypto-enabled payment systems.
Experience with enterprise APIs, payment networks, or compliance-forward systems involving payment lifecycle states, reconciliation, exception handling, sanctions screening, RFIs, or SLAs.

Why this role matters

Managed Payments is a core part of Circle’s strategy to make stablecoin-powered payments accessible to businesses beyond crypto-native customers. Customers increasingly need complete payment programs that allow them to accept funds, manage balances, convert across assets, and disburse globally without assembling wallets, banking partners, liquidity providers, compliance systems, and payout networks themselves. As Senior Product Manager, you will help turn that complexity into an integrated customer experience and scale Managed Payments into a reliable, global, enterprise-grade product.

JOB DESCRIPTION
Location: Bengaluru
Track: Individual contributor
Experience: 0–2 years
Team: Product, Onsurity Engineering

The Role

We're hiring an Associate Product Manager to own well-scoped features end to end,
with guidance from senior PMs. This isn't a coordination role — you'll talk to members,
look at the data, write the spec, argue for it in review, and stay with the feature after it
ships. The problems you'll work on sit close to things that matter: a member's claim,
their teleconsultation, their premium. Small features here have real consequences, and
we want someone who feels that.

You'll report to a Senior/Group PM and work daily with engineering, design, and data.

What You'll Do
● Own a feature or small product area end to end — discovery through launch and iteration
● Write PRDs, user stories and acceptance criteria clear enough that engineering doesn't need to guess
● Talk to members directly: interviews, surveys, usability sessions — and bring back what you actually heard, not what you expected to hear
● Read your own data — funnels, retention, adoption — and use it to make and
defend decisions
● Sit in sprint planning, standups and reviews as a working partner to design and
engineering, not a status-taker
● Track competitors and the healthcare-benefits market, and turn it into something the team can act on
● Coordinate launches with marketing, sales and support
● Triage feedback and bugs and push them to resolution
● Report progress and risk to stakeholders without needing to be asked

What We're Looking For

Required
● 0–2 years in product, business analysis, consulting, engineering or similar
(internships count)
● Bachelor's degree in any discipline
● Comfort with data — SQL, Excel/Sheets, or Mixpanel/Amplitude/GA
● Clear written and verbal communication
● Structured problem-solving on ambiguous problems
● Genuine curiosity about users and how products actually work
● Ability to get things done cross-functionally without formal authority
● Comfortable using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude) daily for research, writing and analysis — you know how to prompt well and how to check the output

Nice to have
● Basic grasp of software development and Agile/Scrum
● Jira, Figma, Notion or Confluence
● Exposure to A/B testing
● A side project or case study that shows how you think about product
● Fintech, insurtech or healthtech exposure

How We Work
High ownership. Fast, but not reckless. Direct and low-ego — disagree in the review,
not after. You find the next useful thing to do without being told, and you say clearlywhen something's off track.

This Role Isn't for You If
You want a fully-specified ticket queue instead of an ambiguous problem. You'd rather
hand a feature off at launch than watch what happens to it after. You're not interested in
talking to members directly.

Purplle is hiring a Product Manager to own the post-order experience — everything a customer

back.

maintained, and be accountable for the metrics that show they're working — reachability of support,

resolution quality, and a smooth experience even when things go wrong.

Make customer support reachable and effective: improve discoverability of help across key

journeys, strengthen self-service and automation, and ensure clean escalation to a human

agent when needed.

Reduce avoidable contacts (WISMO, status checks) by fixing root-cause friction in tracking and

communication — without making support harder to reach.

Raise resolution quality, measured by repeat contacts, reopens, and post-resolution satisfaction

— not just the volume of cases closed.

Monitor behavioural analytics regularly, spot abnormal changes, and turn insights into a

prioritised set of product fixes.

Partner across Engineering, Design, Customer Support Operations, Logistics, and Finance to

ship improvements and align on SLAs, policies, and delivery realities.

What We're Looking For

3–4+ years in a product role, ideally in e-commerce, marketplaces, or consumer tech.
Experience owning customer-facing journeys or post-order / order-management / customer-

support flows.

Hands-on with data — comfortable with SQL and analytics tools (e.g., Mixpanel, Looker,

Tableau) to frame hypotheses, run experiments, and measure impact.

A systems thinker who maps complex end-to-end flows and finds the highest-leverage fixes.
Customer-obsessed, with strong written communication and the ability to influence cross-

functional teams without authority.

Our impact 

Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact.

We’re proud to be a part of that.Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

Role Overview

HighLevel is a powerful platform containing hundreds of interconnected capabilities across CRM, marketing, communications, automation, commerce, websites, calendars, reporting, and AI. That breadth creates enormous value - but it also introduces complexity. Users should not need to know which menu contains a capability, how every object in HighLevel is modelled, or which sequence of screens is required to complete a business task. They should be able to describe what they want to accomplish, receive an accurate answer, and safely complete the work.

Ask AI is the natural-language operating layer designed to make that possible. It allows agencies and businesses to ask questions, understand customer and operational data, generate content and assets, create product configurations, invoke specialised agents, execute supported actions, automate recurring work, and interact with HighLevel through text, voice, structured artefacts, and guided workflows.

Who we are
ParkourSC is a Silicon Valley-based company building a vertical AI platform for life sciences supply chains. Pharma, biologics, and CDMO teams use us to prevent exceptions that put temperature-sensitive, regulated products at risk, and to resolve the ones that remain before they become a crisis. When a cold-chain excursion happens, our platform takes it from stability calculation through disposition and regulatory documentation, within defined guardrails and without manual intervention, and it fits how each customer's network runs. Our customers include top-10 pharmaceutical companies, so the problems we take on are dense: regulatory, operational, and technical at the same time.

About the role
We are looking for a Product Manager / Business Analyst to sit between those customers and our development team. You will take business problems and turn them into technical requirements, epics and stories that engineers can build from without a second round of interpretation.
This is a hands-on requirements and backlog role, not a people-management role. You will own the clarity of what gets built.

What you will do
Requirements and analysis
Elicit business requirements directly from customers, internal SMEs (quality, manufacturing, supply chain) and support/escalation channels.
Translate them into unambiguous technical requirements: functional behaviour, data model implications, edge cases, non-functional expectations, and explicit out-of-scope statements.
Model current-state and target-state processes (BPMN-style flows, state diagrams, data mappings) so that everyone is arguing about the same picture.
Challenge requirements that are workarounds for a deeper process problem and say so.

Backlog ownership
Write and maintain Jira epics, features and user stories with testable acceptance criteria — Given/When/Then or equivalent, covering negative and boundary cases, not just the happy path.
Groom and prioritise the backlog with engineering and QA; run refinement sessions and keep stories "ready" ahead of sprint commitment.
Sequence work into coherent feature sets and keep a forward view of what the next two to three increments contain and what they depend on.
Be the day-to-day answer to "what did you mean by this?" for developers and testers and sign off that what was built is what was specified.

Validation and GxP documentation support
Contribute to computerised-system validation artefacts: user requirement specifications, functional specifications, requirement-to-test traceability.
Maintain traceability between customer requirement, story, acceptance criteria and test evidence so that an audit trail exists by construction rather than by archaeology.
Work within change-control and documentation practices appropriate to a regulated product.

Customer-facing discovery
Join customer workshops, discovery calls and demos; run requirement walkthroughs and playback sessions.
Document and circulate decisions, open questions and assumptions — and chase the open questions closed.

What we are looking for
Required
7–10 years in product ownership, business analysis or a closely related requirements role, with a substantial portion in enterprise or B2B software delivery.
Demonstrable experience in pharmaceutical, biotech, medical device or another regulated life-sciences setting — you understand why GxP, data integrity and audit trails change how software must be specified.
Working knowledge of pharmaceutical manufacturing concepts: batch and lot handling, bill of materials, production orders, deviations and quality events, release processes.
Proven ability to write technical requirements and Jira artefacts that a development team can build from with minimal clarification.
Fluency with Agile delivery (Scrum or Kanban) and the tooling around it — Jira and Confluence as a minimum.
Strong written English. Much of this role is writing precisely for an audience that will act on what you wrote.
Ability to work independently: you take a vague problem, structure it, decide what needs deciding, and escalate the rest with a recommendation rather than an open question.
Comfortable managing several parallel workstreams and shifting priorities without dropping threads.
Overlap of at least four hours daily with Central European (CET/CEST) working hours.

Advantageous — we will teach the rest
Cold chain and temperature-controlled logistics: excursion handling, mean kinetic temperature, stability budgets, time-out-of-refrigeration, lane qualification, packaging and shipper qualification.
Familiarity with GDP, Annex 1/Annex 11, 21 CFR Part 11, or GAMP 5.
Exposure to ERP/MES/WMS or other related systems (SAP, Oracle, Track & Trace platforms) and to how they exchange master and transactional data.
Reading-level comfort with APIs, JSON, SQL and data integration patterns — enough to specify an interface, not to implement it.
Experience supporting a computerised system through validation or a customer audit.
Prior work with distributed or offshore engineering teams.

How we will know you can learn quickly
Our domain is deep and no candidate arrives knowing all of it. What we look for is evidence that you have entered an unfamiliar technical domain before, become credible in it within a few months, and can point to what you did to get there.

How we work
Small, senior product and engineering team; low process overhead, high documentation standards.
Requirements are written down and reviewed. Verbal-only decisions do not survive here.
You will get context, access to SMEs and customer exposure — and then you will be expected to run with it.

What we offer
Salary: Competitive, commensurate with experience (discussed openly during the interview process)
Statutory benefits as per country labour law
Remote-first working with [equipment / co-working allowance]
Direct exposure to pharmaceutical customers and to the regulatory reality of the products we build

How to apply
Send your CV along with a short note covering a product or feature area you owned end to end, and how you specified it.

About Digantara:

Digantara is a leading Space Surveillance and Intelligence company focused on ensuring orbital safety and sustainability. With expertise in space-based detection, tracking, identification, and monitoring, Digantara provides comprehensive domain awareness across various regimes, allowing end-users to gain actionable intelligence on a single platform. At the core of its infrastructure lies a sophisticated integration of hardware and software capabilities aligned with the key principles of situational awareness: perception (data collection), comprehension (data processing), and prediction (analytics). This holistic approach empowers Digantara to monitor all Resident Space Objects (RSOs) in orbit, fostering comprehensive domain awareness.

About the Role 

We're looking for a Product Lead to own Digantara's SDA and conjunction-analysis product line — from problem definition through global rollout. You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with algorithms, data science and engineering teams to turn hard orbital and sensor-fusion problems into product decisions that customers will pay for and rely on.

You do not need to understand the underlying physics or astrodynamics. You do need to get to first principles fast, translate customer and business context into ruthless, defensible prioritisation, and own outcomes with real independence. You will be the primary product voice in front of defence, government and commercial customers worldwide, and you will largely determine not just execute — the roadmap and strategy for one of Digantara's most important products.

Roles & Responsibilities 

Product Strategy & Prioritisation 

Own the vision, strategy and multi-quarter roadmap for STARS Intelligence products, and defend it independently to leadership, customers and engineering.
Drive prioritisation using customer needs, business impact and first-principles reasoning — not engineering interest or research novelty alone.
Make explicit trade-off calls between depth (algorithmic sophistication) and speed-to-value for customers and be accountable for the outcomes of those calls.

Customer & Market Engagement 

Serve as the primary product interface to global customers — defence and government agencies, commercial satellite operators, and insurers/regulators — running discovery, validating problems, and shaping scope directly with them.
Partner with Sales and Business Development on positioning, pricing and packaging of Intelligence products across government/defence and commercial segments, including support for proposals and technical/commercial conversations.

Working With Algorithms & Engineering 

Partner day-to-day with algorithms and data science teams to scope SDA capabilities into shippable product increments — asking the right questions without needing to derive the underlying models yourself.
Write clear PRDs and specs that translate complex technical trade-offs into unambiguous customer and business requirements.
Define success metrics (accuracy, latency, coverage, customer outcomes) jointly with engineering and hold the roadmap accountable to them.
Run planning and prioritisation forums, track delivery against roadmap, and unblock cross-team dependencies.

What We're Looking For 

6+ years in product management, having owned a product's strategy and roadmap (ideally 0-to-1 or through a major scale-up) in a technical, data- or analytics-heavy domain serving enterprise, government or defence customers.
Roadmap and prioritisation: A demonstrated ability to drive prioritisation from customer and business impact and first-principles reasoning, without needing subject-matter depth (physics, orbital mechanics) to do it credibly.
Stakeholder management: A track record of earning trust and driving decisions with highly technical teams — scientists, algorithm engineers, PhDs — as an equal partner rather than a backlog administrator.
Real autonomy in prior roles: comfortable setting direction, making the call, and owning the outcome rather than waiting for it to be handed down.

Job Title: Product Lead Data Management Services

HSBC Data & Analytics Office (DAO) promotes a data-driven culture across HSBC through our strategy of:

Protect: To protect our data we need robust policies for data management and enhanced governance e.g. data that is consumed from a trusted source, meets quality standards, and complies with regulatory obligations. 
Connect: Move to a data-led culture through enhanced training including on the job opportunities. Our talent is the glue between protecting our data and unlocking value for our customers. 
Unlock. Value is unlocked when we deliver on the opportunities our well-managed data presents e.g. improving customer / colleague experience, increasing revenue, commercialising our data, optimising capital, enhancing risk management or reducing costs. 

We are hiring a Product Lead - DMS within Data Management Services (part of Data & Analytics Office)

The Data function owns the bank’s data controls and the ecosystem of tools that allows every business and function to implement and evidence those controls. That ecosystem is being rebuilt: legacy tools are being redesigned, new platforms are being brought in, and the target state is a fully automated, control-by-design data estate, where data quality, lineage, metadata, classification, retention, access and issue management are largely machine-executed rather than manually attested.

We are hiring a Product Lead to own that estate end to end. This is a build-and-scale mandate on a compressed timeline, not a steady-state product management role. The successful candidate will set the product strategy, consolidate a fragmented tooling landscape into a coherent platform, lead the product community, and be personally accountable for landing the target state within an aggressive delivery window.

Governance and Committee Memberships 

The jobholder will continually reassess the operational risks associated with the role and inherent in the business, taking account of changing economic or market conditions, legal and regulatory requirements, operating procedures and practices, management restructurings, and the impact of new technology. 
The jobholder will also adhere to and be able to demonstrate adherence to internal controls. This will be achieved by adherence to all relevant procedures, keeping appropriate records and, where appropriate, by the timely implementation of internal and external audit points, including issues raised by external regulators. 
The jobholder will implement the Group compliance policy by containing compliance risk in liaison with Global Head of Compliance, Global Compliance Officer, Area Compliance Officer or Local Compliance Officer. The term ‘compliance’ embraces all relevant financial services laws, rules and codes with which the business has to comply 

In This Role, You Will

Own the DMS product vision and multi-year roadmap to deliver the bank-wide automated data control journey (control-by-design, scalable and measurable). Convert control outcomes into deliverable increments (epics/features) with clear acceptance criteria and benefits tracking (e.g., automation rate, evidence quality, adoption, cycle-time reduction). 
Partner with Data Technology and Architecture to define the target state and make explicit buy / build / configure / retire decisions, including legacy rationalisation and decommissioning. Create platform consistency by setting common product standards/patterns across DMS (e.g., workflow, APIs, integration patterns, MI/metrics, auditability) so tools operate as one coherent estate. 
Lead and develop the Product Owner community across the DMS portfolio, setting direction, ways of working and a consistent bar for discovery, prioritisation and outcome delivery. Orchestrate delivery through matrix technology teams (without direct line management), aligning priorities, managing dependencies, removing blockers and ensuring shared accountability for outcomes. 
Run portfolio-level prioritisation and capacity allocation to ensure engineering effort is focused on the highest-risk/highest-value control outcomes, with realistic sequencing and transparent trade-offs. Establish and operate strong delivery governance to maintain delivery momentum and quality. 
Drive adoption and change at scale (training, communications, migrations) ensuring DMS tooling becomes the “path of least resistance” for Data Owners, Data Stewards and control teams. Ensure risk, regulatory and control-by-design compliance: DMS products must meet HSBC standards for security, resilience, data privacy/records management and third-party risk, and provide defensible evidence/MI for Risk, Compliance and Internal Audit. 
Lead a team of Product Owners and create a high-performing product community with consistent standards, shared patterns, and a bias to shipping incremental value. Build strong partnerships across Data Technology, Data Operations, Architecture, Cyber Security, Risk, Compliance, CCO and Internal Audit. Drive collaboration across geographies and functions; manage competing priorities through transparency, evidence-based trade-offs and clear decisions 

To Be Successful You Will

Strong knowledge of data management capabilities and controls: metadata management, data governance, data quality, lineage, classification, privacy and retention, and how they enable evidence-based control execution. Strong product leadership experience across enterprise platforms and tooling, ideally within a large regulated organisation. 
Proven ability to lead delivery through matrix technology teams and multiple Product Owners, shaping work without relying on formal reporting lines. Understanding of regulatory drivers and control frameworks relevant to data management

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Engineering/Technology (B.E./B.Tech) or Computer Applications (BCA) or Science (BSc – Computer Science/Statistics/Mathematics) from a recognised university. 
Track record of delivering complex tooling/platform change with measurable outcomes (automation, adoption, risk reduction, cost/efficiency).
