Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

QV.AC is a general purpose AI assistant that runs locally on your devices, it gives users greater control over their data and how they use artificial intelligence. Our focus is on local, on-device, and privacy-preserving AI, with opportunities to connect these experiences across Tether’s peer-to-peer ecosystem.

We’re looking for a Product Manager with a strong interest in AI and a practical understanding of how to turn emerging capabilities into useful products.

You will work closely with the Product Lead to help advance the QV.AC vision: identifying valuable use cases, defining AI features, exploring product concepts, and working with engineering and design to bring them to users. You’ll contribute to product direction and take responsibility for moving assigned features from discovery through delivery and iteration.

This role suits someone who knows how to leverage AI to the maximum and enjoys experimenting with new AI technologies, understands its possibilities and limitations, and cares about making complex technology easy to use.

Responsibilities

Help shape AI features: Work with the Product Lead to translate the QV.AC vision into concrete use cases, feature proposals, and product requirements. Bring ideas grounded in user needs, research, and hands-on experimentation.
Understand users and their problems: Gather feedback, conduct research, and explore how people use AI in their everyday workflows. Identify where AI can solve a meaningful problem and where a simpler solution may work better.
Turn ideas into clear specifications: Write product briefs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and user flows that help engineering and design understand the intended experience, constraints, and measures of success.
Prototype and explore: Create wireframes, mockups, and working prototypes to test ideas and communicate product behavior. Use AI-assisted tools to explore concepts quickly and refine them with the team.
Collaborate on technical trade-offs: Work with engineers to understand what is feasible across devices and models. Help assess the impact of response quality, latency, memory usage, battery consumption, and privacy on the user experience.
Support prioritization and planning: Help the Product Lead evaluate opportunities, clarify scope, identify dependencies, and maintain a focused backlog aligned with product priorities.
Drive feature delivery: Follow assigned features through development, resolve product questions, review the experience, and coordinate feedback and release readiness with relevant teams.
Stay close to AI developments: Explore new AI products, models, tools, and interaction patterns, and explain their practical relevance to QV.AC. Share clear recommendations about what is worth testing or adopting and why.

Mandatory:

7+ years of product management experience, ideally working on AI software products with technical engineering teams.
Practical experience building, shipping, or prototyping AI-powered features, with the ability to explain your contribution and what you learned.
A working understanding of AI concepts such as inference, harnesses, model capabilities and limitations, context, and evaluation, alongside an interest in local and on-device AI.
The ability to translate an ambiguous idea into a clear user problem, proposed solution, and actionable requirements.
Strong product judgment, with attention to usability, scope, and measurable user value.
Confidence creating prototypes using design or coding tools
Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to discuss technical trade-offs with engineers and explain them to non-technical colleagues.
A proactive, collaborative approach: comfortable taking responsibility for your work, asking questions early, and incorporating feedback.
Familiarity with product analytics, user research, and iterative software development.

Preferred:

Experience with local AI, on-device inference, or open-source models.
Experience building AI assistants, conversational interfaces, or multimodal features.
Familiarity with desktop or mobile product development.
An understanding of peer-to-peer technologies and decentralized applications.
Experience evaluating AI output quality and designing user experiences that account for uncertainty and errors.
Experience working in a distributed team.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/
Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @tether.to or @tether.io
We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

Who We Are

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

What You'll Do

BCG’s Enterprise Services organization is undergoing a bold transformation to become a truly tech-first, AI-powered organization. We aim for structural reinvention and are reimagining how Enterprise Services operates, delivers value, and partners with the business by embedding technology, data, and AI at the core of every service and process.

In our journey to power end-to-end user experiences, our Enterprise Services Digital organization is moving away function-led service delivery to experience-led, platform-enabled capabilities that are scalable, intelligent, and continuously improving. This means:

Creating seamless user journeys across functions, geographies, and tools
Designing services as digital products, with clear ownership, roadmaps, and measurable outcomes
Leveraging AI, automation, and advanced analytics to augment human expertise and unlock productivity
Building interoperable, API-enabled platforms that reduce fragmentation and technical debt
Shifting from reactive service provision to proactive, data-driven orchestration

Within this broader transformation, Smart Office is a flagship domain focused on redefining the end-to-end Street-to-Seat and Workplace experience: the seamless journey that begins when an employee or visitor approaches a BCG office and continues through arrival, workspace usage, collaboration, and departure. Our ambition is to create a fully connected, intelligent workplace ecosystem that integrates physical space, digital tools, and operational services into one cohesive experience.

As the Smart Office Global Product Manager, you will play a critical role in defining and delivering this connected workplace vision — ensuring that technology enhances employee productivity, improves operational efficiency, and provides data-driven decision support, while maintaining enterprise-grade reliability, security, and scalability. This role will be responsible for helping to define, build and implement the Smart Office Digital Product use cases and roadmap

Among your responsibilities, you will:

Determine business requirements to shape the BCG Smart Office product journey and Street-to-Seat user experience
Serve as a Liaison between the Workplace Experience business partners and the Smart Office Product squad to ensure that key business objectives are met
Working with key senior stakeholders to gather and document business requirements
Defining the form, content, and capabilities provided in our Smart Office products and solutions
Identify key changes and impacts to our existing reporting capabilities and products
Understanding multiple data sources and putting together practical and viable models for the analytics reports being prepared
Developing comprehensive implementation plans along with delivering the output as defined in the project’s goals and objectives
Assessing the gaps between the prioritized requirements and the Product capabilities, current and upcoming. Generating solution options and, with the use of an agreed set of design principles, selecting the preferred option to move forward
Acting as a functional subject matter expert for partnering to troubleshooting Smart Office data issues, redesign processes and develop reports
Developing training materials and delivering trainings to end-users
Curating backlog of requested enhancements
Develop and track technical roadmap for feature enhancements
Assist with validation of Smart Office data and product builds

What You'll Bring

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Business, Product Management or Economics. Advanced degree preferred, but not required
6-8+ years of experience in Digital Products, Digital Workplace Experience, Data & Space analytics or equivalent field; less experience considered for exceptional performers
End-to-end product management experience owning roadmap, discovery, delivery, and measurable outcomes for digital or technology-enabled products.
Smart office / IoT expertise, including connected devices (sensors, access control, HVAC, lighting) and workplace platforms (desk booking, visitor management, hybrid work tools).
Strong technical fluency, with experience in system integrations, APIs, cloud platforms, data analytics, and collaboration with engineering teams.
Data-driven decision making, leveraging occupancy, utilization, and energy analytics to inform product improvements and business cases.
Enterprise stakeholder management, working cross-functionally with IT, Real Estate, Workplace Experience, and executive leadership.
Change management and adoption leadership, driving employee engagement, training, and successful rollout of workplace technologies.

Who You'll Work With

Smart office Product Owner and squad members to ensure a shared understanding of the work
Cross-functional digital product team members in Enterprise Services, Workplace Experience to deliver innovative Smart Office solutions and insights to drive action
BCG employees and managers as internal customers to inform and shape the Smart Office and Street-to-Seat journey
Other Digital Portfolio members within BCG, on solutions, workflows, product roadmap, and collaborate on best practices to ensure alignment between squads
Agile Coaches for guidance on Agile ways of working and to promote agility within your team
Chapter Leads and Tech Area Leaders for technical solutioning and delivery

Natural curiosity to understand how things work and why; our data, our processes, and our reports. Desire to comprehend root causes when issues arise

Work Management, organization, and planning

Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

Tether Wallet is our self-custodial wallet, built to bring USDT and XAUT directly to the people who rely on Tether every day, especially in markets where access to stable money and savings is hardest. For that to work, getting into these assets has to be simple, fast and affordable. Our goal is to give every Tether Wallet user the best option to exchange any local currency or token into USDT and XAUT, wherever they are.

In this role, you will define and own the strategy for buying and swapping into USDT and XAUT across our target markets. You will work hand in hand with our expansion teams to map the payment landscape in each market: which payment methods people actually use, which card schemes and bank rails dominate, and which on-ramp and swap providers can serve them. Based on that, you will identify the best partner for each market and bring them on board as a service partner of Tether Wallet.

This role sits at the intersection of product, payments and partnerships. You will own the outcome end to end, from the first partner evaluation through integration and the in-app experience to the conversion numbers after launch. If you enjoy turning a fragmented global payments landscape into a buy button that just works, we want to hear from you.

Key responsibilities:

Buy & Swap Strategy: Define and own the strategy and roadmap for buying and swapping into USDT and XAUT in Tether Wallet, covering fiat on-ramps, card payments, local payment methods and token-to-token swaps.
Market & Payment Landscape: Work with our expansion teams to build a deep understanding of each target market, including dominant payment methods, card schemes, bank transfer and instant payment rails, mobile money, local regulation, and the on-ramp and swap providers active there.
Partner Evaluation & Selection: Define clear evaluation criteria such as market and payment method coverage, fees and FX spreads, approval and conversion rates, KYC experience, settlement speed, reliability and compliance standing, and use them to select the best on-ramp or swap partner for each market.
Partner Onboarding: Lead selected partners from evaluation to go-live as service partners of Tether Wallet, coordinating with Legal, Compliance and Business Development on due diligence, commercial terms and contracts.
Integration & Delivery: Translate partner capabilities and APIs into clear product requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria, and work with engineering and design to deliver a seamless in-app buy and swap experience.
Routing & Optimization: Define the logic that decides which partner and payment method a user is offered based on country, currency, amount, price and availability, so every user gets the best available option.
Performance & Partner Management: Define and track KPIs across the buy and swap funnel, such as conversion, payment approval rates, KYC drop-off, total cost to the user and volume by market and partner. Use the data to improve the experience, manage partner performance and incidents, and regularly review whether each market still has the right partner.

Mandatory:

5+ years of product management experience in the financial industry (banking, payment service provider, FinTech)
3+ years of product management experience in DeFi or crypto industry
Good understanding of crypto wallets and DeFi features, including token swaps, DEX aggregators and on-chain transaction flows.
Good understanding of global payment systems and credit card schemes (e.g. Visa, Mastercard), including authorization, 3-D Secure and chargebacks, as well as local payment methods such as bank transfers, instant payment rails and mobile money.
Hands-on experience with fiat on-ramp, off-ramp or swap providers, or with integrating third-party payment providers and gateways into a consumer product.
Proven experience evaluating, selecting and onboarding external partners, and managing their performance after launch.
Working knowledge of KYC/AML requirements and how they affect user onboarding and conversion.
Technical enough to read partner API documentation, assess integration options and work closely with engineering teams.
Data-driven: experience defining funnel KPIs and using data to improve conversion and make partner decisions.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with partners, expansion teams and engineers across time zones in a remote environment.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/
Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @tether.to or @tether.io
We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

Experience balancing customer needs, business priorities, and technical considerations to inform product decisions.

*What Success Looks Like*

* The Founder

Product Manager - myRico

HSR, Bangalore, India

Mission

The best teams spend too much time keeping work moving. Context is scattered across conversations, documents and tools. Decisions get lost. Dependencies go unnoticed. Someone has to remember what matters, connect the dots and follow through.

We’re building myRico to help carry that work.

Our ambition is an AI teammate that understands your company—its goals, people, decisions and ways of working—and uses that understanding to help the team get things done. A teammate that earns trust through useful work, sound judgment and dependable follow-through.

Our starting point is helping software teams move projects from intent to delivery. Success means less effort spent coordinating and correcting work, and a shorter path to an outcome the team can stand behind.

The role

We’re hiring our founding Product Manager to help turn that ambition into a product that teams rely on every day.

You’ll work closely with the founders, engineers and early customers to figure out where Rico creates the most value, what we should build next and whether it actually works. You’ll own the loop from understanding a problem to shipping a solution, watching people use it and making it better.

Some of the hardest questions are also the most interesting. When should Rico act on its own? When should it ask? What should it remember? How does it earn permission to take on more responsibility? How do we know it has saved someone time once we account for the effort of directing, reviewing and correcting it?

In practice, you might spend a morning watching a customer run a project, prototype a better workflow that afternoon, and work with engineering to put it in their hands that week. You’ll read conversations, investigate failures, challenge assumptions and make the small product decisions that determine whether an AI teammate feels useful or exhausting.

You’ll help shape both the product and how we build it. That means choosing a few problems worth solving deeply, making clear tradeoffs and staying accountable for what happens after launch.

This role is based in Bangalore and would require 5 days in office.

What we’re looking for

Customer obsession. You get close enough to users to understand how their work actually happens, including the workarounds they’ve stopped noticing.

Product judgment. You can turn an ambiguous problem into a clear decision about what to build, what to leave out and what evidence would change your mind.

A builder’s instinct. You use prototypes, experiments and AI tools to make ideas tangible and learn quickly.

Technical fluency. You can reason with engineers about AI behavior, memory, integrations, permissions and the tradeoffs between quality, latency and cost.

Care for the details. You notice when an interaction creates confusion, a notification interrupts at the wrong time or a confident answer hasn’t earned that confidence.

Ownership. You follow a problem through discovery, delivery and adoption. You stay with it when the first solution falls short.

Clear communication. You write precisely, explain your reasoning and disagree thoughtfully.

Experience

You’ve helped take a product or meaningful feature from an unclear problem to real usage. You can explain the decisions you made, the tradeoffs you accepted and what you learned when users surprised you.

Your background might be product management, engineering, design or founding a company. We care about evidence of good judgment and useful things you’ve shipped.

This role will be a poor fit if

You need a fully defined roadmap before you can make progress.

You prefer handing off requirements to staying involved through implementation and adoption.

You’re uncomfortable spending substantial time with customers or examining where the product fails.

You find it difficult to change direction when the evidence challenges your original idea.

Bonus

You’ve built an AI product and dealt with its behavior in real use.

You’ve worked on collaboration tools, developer products or complex business workflows.

You’ve been a founder or an early employee at a startup.

You can build working prototypes yourself.

Tala is the AI-native credit infrastructure that connects global capital to the global majority. We combine proprietary risk intelligence with an expanding network of capital and distribution partners to power credit access at scale. To date, Tala has distributed more than $9 billion in capital to more than 14 million customers across Africa, Latin America, and Asia, building the definitive contextual dataset on thin-file borrowers in emerging markets. The company has been named to the Fortune Impact 20 list, CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies twice, CNBC Disruptor 50 for five years, and Forbes’ Fintech 50 list for ten years running.

Given the global nature of our team, we operate on a remote-first approach with office hubs in Santa Monica, CA (HQ); Nairobi, Kenya; Mexico City, Mexico; Manila, the Philippines; and Bangalore, India.

The Role

Tala is on a mission to unleash the economic power of the global majority. We’re building financial services that give people greater access, control, and agency over their financial lives.

As Tala continues to scale, protecting our customers while creating a seamless experience is more important than ever. We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager, Fraud & Authentication to lead the strategy and execution of the systems that keep our customers and platform safe.

As the Senior Product Manager, Fraud & Authentication, you’ll own Tala’s product strategy for fraud prevention, customer authentication, and identity-related experiences across the customer journey.

You’ll tackle complex problems at the intersection of fraud, risk, machine learning, data, engineering, and customer experience.

Your goal will be to help Tala identify and prevent fraudulent activity while minimizing unnecessary friction for legitimate customers.

You’ll work closely with Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, Lending, Finance, Customer Care, Marketing, Legal, and other global teams to turn complex fraud patterns and ambiguous problems into scalable products and systems.

This is a highly cross-functional role for someone who enjoys solving difficult problems with data, moving quickly, and building products that have a measurable impact on both customers and the business.

What You'll Do
Own Fraud & Authentication Product Strategy
Define and own Tala’s multi-year product strategy and roadmap for fraud prevention, customer authentication, identity, and related risk capabilities.
Identify opportunities to improve fraud prevention across signup, login, account management, and other high-risk customer actions.
Balance fraud prevention with customer experience by reducing fraud losses and false positives while minimizing unnecessary friction.
Translate complex fraud patterns, emerging attack vectors, and business needs into clear product strategies and priorities.
Build Data-Driven Fraud Products
Partner closely with Data Science and Analytics to define model objectives, evaluate model and feature performance, and identify opportunities to improve detection.
Help determine appropriate fraud decision thresholds and rules based on data and business objectives.
Establish and monitor key metrics such as fraud loss rates, detection accuracy, false-positive rates, customer conversion, and authentication success.
Identify data gaps and work with technical teams to improve the data and infrastructure needed to make effective fraud decisions.
Collaborate on fraud detection models, rules, feature infrastructure, and decisioning systems.
Lead Product Execution
Translate ambiguous fraud and authentication problems into clear product requirements that Engineering teams can execute against.
Lead a cross-functional team of engineers and partners to deliver the roadmap.
Prioritize initiatives based on customer impact, fraud exposure, business value, technical complexity, and data.
Partner with Engineering to understand Tala’s fraud and authentication infrastructure and identify opportunities to improve scalability and reliability.
Drive initiatives from strategy and discovery through launch, measurement, and iteration.
Manage Fraud & Risk Events
Partner with Data Science, Analytics, Engineering, and Operations to investigate fraud incidents and emerging fraud patterns.
Turn lessons from fraud events into proactive product and system improvements.
Develop approaches that allow Tala to respond quickly as fraud patterns and attack vectors evolve.
Collaborate Across Tala
Build strong partnerships across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, Lending, Finance, Customer Care, Marketing, and Legal.
Communicate complex fraud and risk concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Manage relationships with external vendors and technology partners supporting fraud, authentication, identity, or risk capabilities.
Create alignment across distributed global teams and drive decisions in an environment where information may be incomplete or ambiguous.
What You'll Need
5+ years of Product Management experience, with experience owning complex technical products or platforms.

Experience using data and metrics to make product decisions and measure outcomes.

DESCRIPTION

Amazon’s Selection Monitoring team builds software to improve customer experience by : (1) Enabling Agentic Shopping experiences through World Product Catalog that contains all shoppable products sold anywhere in the world, (2) Growing number of customer relevant brands and products on Amazon, and (3) enriching product and brand information in Amazon catalog. We build state-of-the-art information retrieval infrastructure, extracting structured-data from unstructured-content, automatic item classification, storage systems to hold the massive catalog and distributed systems of cloud-scale. We apply parallel processing, Generative AI solutions, and machine learning algorithms to evaluate millions of products every day and to identify and prioritize new additions to Amazon’s selection efficiently. If you are customer obsessed, driven, tenacious and analytical, you will have fun solving our business problems of unprecedented scale. You will develop deep technical expertise and learn designing large scale distributed, service-oriented systems. Come join us in our journey to improve our customer experience at Amazon !

Our ideal candidate will have launched multiple, impactful consumer products, have demonstrated the ability to lead high-performance teams, and have deep understanding of product management, user experience, and software development processes (especially agile). Amazon carries the world’s largest catalog of products and in order to maintain this lead, we are constantly exploring and understanding the global e-commerce landscape. Job Summary

As a Product Owner you are the primary link between stakeholders and delivery teams, balancing business priorities, customer expectations, operational realities, and technical feasibility. You will work closely with CTO’s org, Engineering Leadership, product management and cross-function teams.

The role calls for a highly motivated, independent thinker who is organized, detail-oriented, adaptable, and effective at building relationships across diverse teams and stakeholder groups.

Maximize product value by owning the definition, prioritization, and delivery of product capabilities — translating customer, business, operational, and regulatory needs into clear, actionable requirements and measurable outcomes.

Essential Job Responsibilities

Product Vision, Strategy & Roadmap

Define and communicate a product vision aligned with Epiq's strategic objectives and client needs.
Create, maintain, and prioritize the product roadmap to deliver maximum business value.
Partner with Product Management and Senior Product Owners to align delivery priorities with the broader product strategy.
Define minimum viable products, experiments, and incremental delivery approaches that get value to business and customers early.

Backlog Ownership & Agile Delivery

Own, maintain, and continuously refine the product backlog, prioritizing on value, risk, dependencies, and technical feasibility.
Translate business needs into epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional requirements. Lead backlog refinement and participate in sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives, and release planning.
Provide day-to-day requirement clarification and timely product decisions to engineering, QA, and UX, resolving impediments as they arise.

Hands-On AI Fluency & Tooling

Use AI tools hands-on in daily product work — requirement drafting, story refinement, discovery synthesis, research, meeting summarization, usage analysis — and maintain reusable prompt patterns for those workflows.
Stay current on AI capabilities and emerging patterns, and translate that awareness into concrete product decisions.
Build lightweight prototypes and clickable concepts using AI-assisted and low-code tools to validate ideas before committing engineering capacity.
Identify and prioritize AI use cases on customer value, feasibility, data readiness, risk, and measurable impact, including where AI can remove manual effort from operational and client-facing workflows.
Define evaluation criteria for AI-enabled features — accuracy, groundedness, latency, cost, confidence thresholds — with human-in-the-loop checkpoints and fallback paths for non-deterministic output.
Ensure AI usage meets privacy, security, client-confidentiality, auditability, and responsible-use requirements, and never treat unvalidated AI output as a final decision or deliverable.

Stakeholder & Customer Leadership

Serve as the voice of the customer and the liaison between business stakeholders, technical teams, operations, and clients.
Gather and document business and customer requirements, and facilitate discovery workshops, demonstrations, and feedback sessions.
Convert customer feedback, usage trends, and operational insight into actionable backlog changes.
Communicate priorities, roadmap progress, delivery status, risks, and key decisions with clarity.
Build trusted relationships and influence decisions across organizational levels, from delivery squads to senior leadership.

Quality, Risk & Continuous Improvement

Embed security, privacy, compliance, information governance, and operational readiness into the product lifecycle.
Identify and communicate delivery risks, assumptions, dependencies, and constraints early.
Define success metrics and track adoption, utilization, and business value to guide roadmap and investment decisions.
Support product documentation, release communications, and enablement materials.
Validate delivered functionality, lead feature acceptance, and support UAT, release readiness, and deployment.

Sprinto is an Autonomous Trust Platform that centralizes trust requirements across security frameworks, vendors, and customers.

Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks.

Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we've raised $31.8M in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over 4,000 organizations across 75 countries, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With 300+ native integrations and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports 200+ global security standards natively, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks.

Founded in 2020 by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more.

Life as a Sprinter -
Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane.

We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in.

Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction.

We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching.

And while we move with urgency, we never move alone.

Where you'll leave your mark?
Own Sprinto's AI browser extensions and AI features end to end — one of several streams within our AI pod, alongside accuracy baselining and automations — as its business owner, not just its product manager.
Define the problem statement from first principles — figure out what's worth building, why, and for whom, before a line of code is written.
Build the product and take it to first customers — work hands-on with an initial set of customers, one on one, to get it to a successful POC stage.
Drive distribution and adoption — partner with CX, Sales, and Marketing to take what worked in POCs to wider launch and measurable adoption across the customer base.
Own accuracy and quality for AI-driven features — set the bar, know the pitfalls of building on non-deterministic systems, and keep improving output reliability post-launch.
Operate with senior-level autonomy — set direction for this stream, make calls without waiting for a mandate, and be accountable for outcomes, not deliverables.
The kind of builder we're looking for -
3–5 years of product management experience, ideally in B2B SaaS.
A business-owner mindset — you think in terms of customer outcomes, adoption, and impact, not tickets shipped.
A strong first-principles, structured thinker — able to break down an ambiguous problem space and build a clear path from idea to launch.
Hands-on with customers — comfortable running discovery, POCs, and feedback loops directly with early users to make them successful.
A strong cross-functional collaborator — you've taken products from build to go-to-market by working closely with CX, Sales, and Marketing.
AI product experience is a strong plus, not a requirement — if you've built AI-powered features, you know how to improve accuracy and avoid the common pitfalls; if you haven't, you should be able to reason your way there.
Comfortable with a fast, high-ownership environment — this role exists because we need someone who can pick up a stream and run with it.

How we care for our Sprinters?

Work wherever you are: We are 100% remote, so you get to choose if you want to work from home, a cafe, the hills, or the beach.
Co-working, on the house: If co-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowance.
We care about your learning: We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1,000 annually to help you level up your skills.
We count your spark, not your leaves: Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need to.
Your Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salary.
Workspace setup of your dreams: We chip in INR 35,000 to help you build a setup that works for you.

Inclusion & Diversity -
At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed—not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful.

Data-driven approach to KPIs, adoption measures, funnel metrics, attribution and business-value targets.

Experience managing vendors, implementation partners, contracts and technology evaluations.

Job description
Requisition ID: 1739762

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

Product Owner

EY Enterprise Technology

EY Enterprise Technology group specific in the Digital Experience area is working on implementing EY Specific products on the EYDxP powered by Adobe platform that consists of the Adobe CX Stack including but not limited to Adobe Workfront; AEM; AEP; Target; Analytics; AJO.

The opportunity

As a member of the Digital Experience Product Team will be working in an agile methodology. The role would support the Products aligned to the EY Global platforms implementing with our Global Delivery teams. The role will work close to the business creating and understanding requirements for development. You will own and manage the Azure DevOps backlog to support rapid development.

Your key responsibilities

Day-to-day, this role will:

Develop and maintain a deep contextual understanding of the services areas to which assigned and the underlying business objectives of those service areas
Serve the assigned service areas by representing their business objectives when interfacing with the other project team members and by ensuring that their business objectives are a primary component of the delivery
Build the foundation for the development effort by capturing the business context - problem, current state, desired future state, objectives, business needs and impacted user groups
Develop requirements (business, user and technical requirements — functional and non-functional) and establish traceability to the business vision
Manage requirements through the project lifecycle by establishing and maintaining agreements between the customer and the project team
Play a critical communications role by interacting with user (business domain) and with IT and testing personnel
Ensure requirements are specified in a manner suitable for the intended audience and are understandable, unambiguous and capable of being implemented and tested
Navigate the IT team and business sponsors through a level of ambiguity including business process change; build organization and structure to requirements to drive out and define detailed requirements efficiently
Work with project manager and the business customer(s) to define stakeholder requirements
Understand project technology and define how the requirements gathering will be conducted (i.e. elicitation, analysis, specification and validation)
Facilitate requirement meetings; demonstrate extensive experience in facilitating sessions (20+ people). Use techniques to define scope and requirements during the lifecycle of the project
Write and review business, user and non-functional/system level requirements in the form of Use Cases and similar structured requirements documentation
Ensure change control and change management procedures are followed within the project team as they relate to requirements
Understand business case and project scope
Ensure high quality business analysis standards are met as prescribed by Information Security through the effective implementation or use of approved processes, methodologies and deliverables

Skills and attributes for success

To be successful in this role, candidates should possess the following core skills:

Strong ability to communicate fluently in English and adapt communications to various audiences, including Executives, Sponsors, Management, overall organization and project teams – includes verbal, written and presentation skills
Breakdown barriers of delivery with well thought out challenges and escalations, if necessary
Personal accountability to adhere and comply of all required business analyst deliverables and requirements
Ability to collaborate across functional teams, cultures and geographies and to build trust virtually
Strong working knowledge or experience with Identity and Access Management
Track record of customer focus that is based on openness, trust, and delivering on promises
Extensive experience writing and reviewing business, user, and non-functional/system level requirements
Highly adept at obtaining alignment and approval of business requirements (functional and supplemental) from user community
Extensive experience in selecting and executing elicitation techniques such as Interviews, Exploratory Prototypes, Facilitated Workshops, Focus Groups, Observation, User Task Analysis, Documentation Study and Surveys and overall Process Re-engineering
Development and deployment of formal business analysis methods and tools to govern and control programs
Solid understanding of the following requirements models: Stakeholder Categories, Actor Tables, Glossary, Context Diagram, Data Model, Class Model, Data Dictionary, Event Response Tables, State Diagrams, Business Rules, Decision Tables, Process Maps, Use Cases, and Activity Diagrams
Leader in the use of IT methodologies, processes and standards for business analysis

To qualify for the role, you must have

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Project Management or Business Administration, or equivalent work experience
7 years in a large corporate IT environment
5+ years as a business analyst across various IT disciplines; InfoSec a plus, but also, infrastructure deployment, application development, large RFP’s, proofs of concept, etc. 10 to 15 years in a corporate IT environment
SAFe Agile Certification
Adobe DX product experience
Other relevant experience in a related technical field (application development, deployment/implementation and infrastructure)
Work experience in a professional services industry, or global teams preferred
Significant work experience IT infrastructure and security projects
Flexibility to work outside typical hours, as required of a global team
Flexibility to travel on a very limited basis

Ideally, you’ll also have

CBAP certification
Familiarity with ITIL v2 or 3
AEM Certificated or other Adobe products - Desired
Experience in supporting a professional service and/or global IT organization
An understanding of Information Security tenets and priorities
Familiarity with the IIBA (BABOK) Practice Standards
Enterprise Search Implementation Experience – Desired.

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.
